label: Ser(Gly)-tRNA(Ala) hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ser-tRNA(Ala) and Gly-tRNA(Ala).

label: active borate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transport of borate across a membrane against the concentration gradient.

label: 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate + H2O = (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + H+ + succinate.

label: L-galactose-1-phosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-galactose-1-phosphate + H2O = L-galactose + phosphate.

label: diaminopropionate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-diaminopropionate + H2O = pyruvate + 2 NH3.

label: ADP-glucose pyrophosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP-glucose + H2O = AMP + glucose-1-phosphate.

label: parthenolide 3beta-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + parthenolide + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = 3beta-hydroxyparthenolide + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-CH group of donors
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH-CH group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a hydrogen or electron acceptor.

label: hydro-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a carbon-oxygen bond by elimination of water.

label: juvenile hormone response element binding
definition: Binding to a juvenile hormone response element (JHRE), a conserved sequence found in the promoters of genes whose expression is regulated in response to juvenile hormone.

label: saccharopine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of N6-(L-1,3-dicarboxypropyl)-L-lysine to release an amino acid (lysine or glutamate), with the concomitant reduction of an electron acceptor.

label: trithionate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + trithionate = H+ + sulfate + thiosulfate.

label: oxalyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + oxalyl-CoA = CO2 + formyl-CoA.

label: linoleate 11-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: linoleate + O2 = (9Z,11S,12Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadeca-9,12-dienoate.

label: medium-chain fatty acid omega-1 hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an (omega-1)-ethyl medium-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = an (omega-1)-hydroxy-medium-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons.

label: nicotinamide-nucleotide adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-nicotinamide D-ribonucleotide + ATP + H+ = diphosphate + NAD+.

label: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + pyruvate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-acetyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CO2.

label: histone H4 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a modified lysine residue of the histone H4 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

label: 2-phenylethylamine receptor activity
definition: Combining with the biogenic amine 2-phenylethylamine to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: phosphoribokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP = D-ribose 1,5-diphosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

label: delta(3)-delta(2)-enoyl-CoA isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: a (3Z)-enoyl-CoA = a 4-saturated (2E)-enoyl-CoA or a (3E)-enoyl-CoA = a 4-saturated (2E)-enoyl-CoA.

label: UDP-N-acetylmuramoylalanyl-D-glutamyl-2,6-diaminopimelate-D-alanyl-D-alanine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate + D-alanyl-D-alanine = ADP + phosphate + UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine.

label: 5'-(N(7)-methylguanosine 5'-triphospho)-[mRNA] hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end phospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + N7-methyl-GDP + H+.

label: all-trans-retinyl-ester hydrolase, 11-cis retinol forming activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + all-trans-retinyl ester = 11-cis-retinol + fatty acid.

label: cis-stilbene-oxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-stilbene oxide + H2O = (+)-(1R,2R)-1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diol.

label: 2-methylbutanal reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methylbutan-1-ol + NADP+ = 2-methylbutanal + NADPH + H+.

label: beta-glucoside kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + cellobiose = ADP + 6-phospho-beta-D-glucosyl-(1,4)-D-glucose.

label: N-glycolylneuraminic acid (Neu5Gc) cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + Neu5Gc = diphosphate + CMP-Neu5Gc.

label: platelet-derived growth factor alpha-receptor activity
definition: Combining with platelet-derived growth factor isoform PDGF-AA, PDGF-BB or PDGF-AB to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: ABC-type oligopeptide transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + oligopeptide(out) = ADP + phosphate + oligopeptide(in).

label: TFIID-class transcription factor complex binding
definition: Binding to a general RNA polymerase II transcription factor belonging to the TFIID complex, one of the factors involved in formation of the preinitiation complex (PIC) by RNA polymerase II.

label: urocanate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-imidazolone-5-propanoate + H+ = trans-urocanate + H2O.

label: histone H1-4S27 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H1-4-serine (position 187) + ATP = histone H1-4-phosphoserine (position 187) + ADP.

label: transmitter-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific neurotransmitter has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: ubiquitin activating enzyme binding
definition: Binding to a ubiquitin activating enzyme, any of the E1 proteins.

label: proteoglycan sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + proteoglycan = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + proteoglycan sulfate. A proteoglycan is a glycoprotein whose carbohydrate units are glycosaminoglycans.

label: acridone synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-methylanthranilyl-CoA + 3 H+ + 3 malonyl-CoA = 1,3-dihydroxy-N-methylacridone + 3 CO2 + 4 CoA + H2O.

label: ferric iron binding
definition: Binding to a ferric iron ion, Fe(III).

label: Enterobacter ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage to 3'-phosphomononucleotides and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

label: altronate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-altronate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

label: phosphoglycerate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glycerate + ATP = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + ADP + H+.

label: beta-galactoside (CMP) alpha-2,3-sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl-R = CMP + alpha-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl-R.

label: acetylcholine receptor activity
definition: Combining with an acetylcholine receptor ligand and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: fluoride channel activity
definition: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a fluoride ion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel.

label: erythropoietin receptor binding
definition: Binding to an erythropoietin receptor.

label: isopentadecanoic acid binding
definition: Binding to isopentadecanoic acid.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on other nitrogenous compounds as donors, cytochrome as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a nitrogenous group, excluding NH and NH2 groups, acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a cytochrome.

label: nicotinate-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate + UDP-D-glucose = O-D-glucosylnicotinate + UDP.

label: lipopolysaccharide immune receptor activity
definition: Combining with a lipopolysaccharide and transmitting the signal across the cell membrane to initiate an innate immune response. Lipopolysaccharides (LPS) are major components of the outer membrane of Gram-negative bacteria, making them prime targets for recognition by the immune system.

label: protein-glutamine glutaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein L-glutamine + H2O = protein L-glutamate + NH3.

label: methotrexate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of methotrexate, 4-amino-10-methylformic acid from one side of a membrane to the other. Methotrexate is a folic acid analogue and a potent competitive inhibitor of dihydrofolate reductase.

label: 4-chloro-allylglycine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chloro-L-lysine + AH2 + O2 = A + formaldehyde + H2O + L-2-amino-4-chloropent-4-enoate + NH4(+).

label: 5'-(N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-[mRNA] diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N2,N2,N7-trimethyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA + H2O = a 5'-end diphospho-ribonucleoside in mRNA + 2 H+ + N7-methyl-GMP. Can also use (N7-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA as a substrate.

label: icosanoid binding
definition: Binding to icosanoids, any C20 polyunsaturated fatty acids or their derivatives, including the leukotrienes and the prostanoids.

label: MHC class I protein binding, via antigen binding groove
definition: Binding to a major histocompatibility complex class I molecules via the antigen binding groove.

label: alpha-zingiberene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = zingiberene + diphosphoric acid.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which NADH or NADPH acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a hydrogen or electron acceptor.

label: xanthan lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xanthan = oligosaccharide with 4-deoxy-alpha-L-threo-hex-4-enuronosyl end + pyruvylate mannose. This reaction is the eliminative cleavage of the terminal beta-D-mannosyl-beta-D-1,4-glucuronosyl linkage of the side-chain of the polysaccharide xanthan, leaving a 4-deoxy-alpha-L-threo-hex-4-enuronosyl group at the terminus of the side-chain.

label: centromeric DNA binding
definition: Binding to a centromere, a region of chromosome where the spindle fibers attach during mitosis and meiosis.

label: 2,3-dihydroxy-p-cumate dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxy-p-cumate + O2 = 2-hydroxy-3-carboxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate.

label: NAD+-protein-serine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-seryl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + nicotinamide + O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-seryl-[protein].

label: RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding
definition: Binding to a sequence-specific DNA binding RNA polymerase II transcription factor, any of the factors that interact selectively and non-covalently with a specific DNA sequence in order to modulate transcription.

label: glyoxalase (glycolic acid-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glyoxal + H2O = glycolic acid. Catalysis occurs in the absence of a cofactor.

label: diethyl 2-methyl-3-oxosuccinate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: diethyl (2R,3R)-2-methyl-3-hydroxysuccinate + NADP+ = diethyl 2-methyl-3-oxosuccinate + H+ + NADPH.

label: potassium ion uniporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the active transport of a potassium ion across a membrane by a mechanism involving conformational change, where energy for active transport is derived from membrane potential if the solute is charged.

label: octanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-octanol + NAD+ = 1-octanal + H+ + NADH.

label: myosin light chain binding
definition: Binding to a light chain of a myosin complex.

label: 2-(acetamidomethylene)succinate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H2O + 2-(acetamidomethylene)succinate = CO2 + NH3 + succinate semialdehyde + acetate.

label: nitric oxide reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 2 ferricytochrome c + nitrous oxide = 2 H+ + 2 ferrocytochrome c + 2 nitric oxide.

label: transcription regulator activity
definition: A molecular function that controls the rate, timing and/or magnitude of gene transcription. The function of transcriptional regulators is to modulate gene expression at the transcription step so that they are expressed in the right cell at the right time and in the right amount throughout the life of the cell and the organism. Genes are transcriptional units, and include bacterial operons.

label: ribonucleotide binding
definition: Binding to a ribonucleotide, any compound consisting of a ribonucleoside that is esterified with (ortho)phosphate or an oligophosphate at any hydroxyl group on the ribose moiety.

label: peroxisome matrix targeting signal-2 binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 peroxisome targeting signal, a nonapeptide with a broad consensus sequence of (R/K)-(L/V/I)-(XXXXX)-(H/Q)-(L/A/F).

label: 1-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 3-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,4-bisphosphate + ADP + H+.

label: insulin-like growth factor II binding
definition: Binding to insulin-like growth factor II.

label: piRNA cluster binding
definition: Binding to piRNA clusters, double-stranded DNA regions that give rise to PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs).

label: pheromone binding
definition: Binding to a pheromone, a substance, or characteristic mixture of substances, that is secreted and released by an organism and detected by a second organism of the same or a closely related species, in which it causes a specific reaction, such as a definite behavioral reaction or a developmental process.

label: vitexin 2''-O-rhamnoside 7-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + vitexin 2''-O-beta-L-rhamnoside = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 7-O-methylvitexin 2''-O-beta-L-rhamnoside.

label: choline sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + choline = adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + choline sulfate + H+.

label: 2,5-diketocamphane 1,2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1R,4R)-bornane-2,5-dione + FMNH2 + O2 = (1R,4R)-5-oxo-1,2-campholide + FMN + H+ + H2O.

label: o-aminophenol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 2-aminophenol + 3 O2 = 2 isophenoxazine + 6 H2O.

label: streptomycin 3''-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + streptomycin = ADP + 2 H+ + streptomycin 3''-phosphate.

label: 5'-3' RNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' terminus of an RNA molecule.

label: 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan + H+ = CO2 + serotonin.

label: rRNA (pseudouridine) methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to a pseudouridine residue in an rRNA molecule.

label: benomyl:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + benomyl(in) = H+(in) + benomyl(out).

label: 3D-(3,5/4)-trihydroxycyclohexane-1,2-dione hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3D-3,5/4-trihydroxycyclohexane-1,2-dione + H2O = 5-deoxy-D-glucuronate + H+.

label: interleukin-19 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-19 receptor.

label: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = homogentisate + NADP+ + H2O.

label: diglucosylglycerate octanoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2-O-[alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->6)-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl]-glycerate + octanoyl-CoA = (2R)-2-O-[6-O-octanoyl-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->6)-alpha-D-glucopyranosyl]-glycerate + CoA.

label: mitochondrial promoter sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to a DNA region that controls the transcription of the mitochondrial DNA.

label: triglyceride-sterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-beta-hydroxysterol + triacylglycerol = a 3-beta-hydroxysterol ester + 1,2-diacylglycerol.

label: leak channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a solute across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that is open even in an unstimulated or 'resting' state.

label: MADS box domain binding
definition: Binding to a MADS box domain, a protein domain that encodes the DNA-binding MADS domain. The MADS domain binds to DNA sequences of high similarity to the motif CC[A/T]6GG termed the CArG-box. MADS-domain proteins are generally transcription factors. The length of the MADS-box is in the range of 168 to 180 base pairs.

label: 6-methylsalicylic acid synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + 3 H+ + 3 malonyl-CoA + NADPH = 6-methylsalicylate + 3 CO2 + 4 CoA + H2O + NADP+.

label: transcription regulatory region RNA binding
definition: Binding to a RNA region within the transcript that regulates the transcription of a gene, cistron, or operon.

label: ferric triacetylfusarinine C:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ferric triacetylfusarinine C(out) + H+(out) = ferric triacetylfusarinine C(in) + H+(in).

label: ceramide glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acylsphing-4-enine + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = a beta-D-glucosyl-(1<->1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + H+ + UDP.

label: methylquercetagetin 6-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3',4',5,6-tetrahydroxy-3,7-dimethoxyflavone + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) = 3',4',5-trihydroxy-3,6,7-trimethoxyflavone + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: D-Ala-D-Ala dipeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-alanyl-D-alanine + H2O = 2 D-alanine.

label: clathrin heavy chain binding
definition: Binding to a clathrin heavy chain.

label: AP-1 adaptor complex binding
definition: Binding to an AP-1 adaptor complex. The AP-1 adaptor complex is a heterotetrameric AP-type membrane coat adaptor complex that consists of beta1, gamma, mu1 and sigma1 subunits and links clathrin to the membrane surface of a vesicle. In at least humans, the AP-1 complex can be heterogeneric due to the existence of multiple subunit isoforms encoded by different genes (gamma1 and gamma2, mu1A and mu1B, and sigma1A, sigma1B and sigma1C).

label: type 5B serotonin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 5B serotonin receptor.

label: arachidonate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the incorporation of one atom from molecular oxygen into arachidonic acid and the reduction of the other atom of oxygen to water.

label: chemoattractant activity
definition: Providing the environmental signal that initiates the directed movement of a motile cell or organism towards a higher concentration of that signal.

label: sphingolipid floppase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of a sphingolipid from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

label: arylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phenyl acetate + H2O = a phenol + acetate.

label: leukotriene-E4 20-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + leukotriene E(4) + NADPH + O2 = 20-hydroxy-leukotriene E(4) + H2O + NADP+.

label: midchain alkane hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the conversion of an alkane to a secondary alcohol.

label: choline binding
definition: Binding to choline, the amine 2-hydroxy-N,N,N-trimethylethanaminium.

label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-mannose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + mannose(out) = protein histidine + mannose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

label: phosphorylase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 ATP + 2 phosphorylase b = 4 ADP + phosphorylase a.

label: 3-oxoadipyl-CoA thiolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA = CoA + 3-oxoadipyl-CoA.

label: 2-deoxyglucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + a 2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucoside = 2-deoxy-D-glucose + an alcohol.

label: carnitine 3-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carnitine + NAD+ = 3-dehydrocarnitine + H+ + NADH.

label: trihydroxybenzophenone synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoyl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA + 3 H+ = 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzophenone + 4 coenzyme A + 3 carbon dioxide.

label: carboxylic acid binding
definition: Binding to a carboxylic acid, an organic acid containing one or more carboxyl (COOH) groups or anions (COO-).

label: carbonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogencarbonate + H+ = CO2 + H2O.

label: interleukin-13 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-13 receptor.

label: brain-derived neurotrophic factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a brain-derived neurotrophic factor receptor.

label: histone H4K12 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H4 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 12). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 12 of the histone H4 protein.

label: beta-1,4-mannosylglycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + beta-D-mannosyl-R = UDP + 4-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl)-beta-D-mannosyl-R.

label: apolipoprotein A-I receptor activity
definition: Combining with an apolipoprotein A-I receptor ligand and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: insulin receptor substrate binding
definition: Binding to an insulin receptor substrate (IRS) protein, an adaptor protein that bind to the transphosphorylated insulin and insulin-like growth factor receptors, are themselves phosphorylated and in turn recruit SH2 domain-containing signaling molecules to form a productive signaling complex.

label: nuclear steroid receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by steroid binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

label: interleukin-15 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-15 receptor.

label: thalian-diol desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a thalian-diol = a desaturated thalian-diol. This reaction is the introduction of a double bond to a thalian-diol molecule at carbon 15.

label: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase.

label: 2-dehydro-3-deoxygluconokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + ATP = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + ADP + 2 H+.

label: averantin hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalyzes the reaction: (1'S)-averantin + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (1'S,5'S)-5'-hydroxyaverantin + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O. Involved in aflatoxin biosynthesis.

label: 23S rRNA pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA = pseudouridine(955/2504/2580) in 23S rRNA.

label: cellobiose epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cellobiose = D-glucosyl-D-mannose.

label: paracellular tight junction channel activity
definition: Enables size- and charge-selective transport of solutes through a tight junction barrier paracellularly, across the epithelium.

label: molybdopterin adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction ATP + molybdopterin = diphosphate + adenylyl-molybdopterin.

label: D3 dopamine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a D3 dopamine receptor.

label: low molecular weight kininogen binding
definition: Binding to a kininogen of low molecular mass.

label: 3-oxosteroid 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-oxosteroid + acceptor = a 3-oxo-D1-steroid + reduced acceptor.

label: homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: homogentisate + O2 = 4-maleylacetoacetate + H+.

label: steroid 21-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A C(21) steroid + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = a 21-hydroxy-C(21)-steroid + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O.

label: aromatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3 O2 + 3 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + testosterone = 17beta-estradiol + formate + 4 H+ + 4 H2O + 3 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. Also converts androst-4-ene-3,17-dione into estrone.

label: isocitrate O-dihydroxycinnamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: caffeoyl-CoA + isocitrate = 2-caffeoylisocitrate + CoA.

label: C-rich single-stranded DNA binding
definition: Binding to C-rich, single-stranded DNA.

label: tRNA methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from a donor to a nucleoside residue in a tRNA molecule.

label: peptidoglycan transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of peptidoglycans, a class of glycoconjugates found in bacterial cell walls, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: 15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + prostaglandin E(1) = 15-dehydro-prostaglandin E1 + H+ + NADPH.

label: peptide chain release factor N(5)-glutamine methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutaminyl-[peptide chain release factor] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(5)-methyl-L-glutaminyl-[peptide chain release factor] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: phytyl-P kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + phytyl phosphate = a ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + phytyl diphosphate.

label: protein kinase C inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of protein kinase C, an enzyme which phosphorylates a protein.

label: guanosine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine + phosphate = alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + guanine.

label: dCMP deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dCMP + H2O = dUMP + NH3.

label: jasmonyl-Ile conjugate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: jasmonyl-Ile + H2O = jasmonic acid + L-isoleucine.

label: chondroitin 6-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + chondroitin = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + chondroitin 6'-sulfate.

label: sodium channel regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a sodium channel.

label: adenosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine + H2O = inosine + NH3.

label: rifamycin-B oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 H+ + O2 + rifamycin B = H2O2 + rifamycin O.

label: methanethiol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methanethiol + O2 + H2O = formaldehyde + hydrogen sulfide + hydrogen peroxide.

label: menadiol geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: menadiol + (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = menaquinol-4 + diphosphate.

label: phosphatase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a phosphatase.

label: inositol phosphorylceramide phospholipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: inositol phosphorylceramide + H2O = C26-phytoceramide + phosphorylinositol.

label: 3-oxoadipate enol-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxoadipate enol-lactone + H2O = 3-oxoadipate.

label: catalytic activity, acting on a rRNA
definition: Catalytic activity that acts to modify a ribosomal RNA.

label: alpha-bisabolene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = (E,R)-alpha-bisabolene + diphosphate.

label: histone H2A acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2A L-lysine = CoA + histone H2A N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

label: histone H3K79 trimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3 H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl79-[histone H3] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the successive addition of up to three methyl group to the lysine residue at position 79 of the histone H3 protein, producing H3K79me3.

label: protein kinase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein kinase.

label: L-malate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NAD+ = oxaloacetate + NADH + H+.

label: diguanylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 GTP = cyclic di-3',5'-guanylate + 2 diphosphate + 2 H+.

label: ribose 1,5-bisphosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate = D-ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate.

label: beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminide alpha-2,3- sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl derivative + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl derivative + CMP + H+.

label: DNA-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group to a DNA molecule.

label: glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl-CoA + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CoA.

label: dopaminechrome tautomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dopaminechrome = 5,6-dihydroxyindole.

label: oxygen sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of oxygen (O2).

label: mannitol 2-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol + NADP+ = D-fructose + H+ + NADPH.

label: thiamine:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: thiamine(out) + H+(out) = thiamine(in) + H+(in).

label: aldonate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of aldonate from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: 4-hydroxy-L-isoleucine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S,3R,4S)-4-hydroxy-L-isoleucine + NAD = (2S,3R)-2-amino-3-methyl-4-ketopentanoate + NADH + H+.

label: pheophytinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pheophytin + H2O = phytol + pheophorbide.

label: hydroxyphytanate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S)-2-hydroxyphytanate + O2 = 2-oxophytanate + H2O2.

label: dihydroceramide fatty acyl 2-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-(1,2-saturated acyl)sphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = an N-[(2'R)-hydroxyacyl]sphinganine + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O.

label: first spliceosomal transesterification activity
definition: Catalysis of the first transesterification reaction of spliceosomal mRNA splicing. The intron branch site adenosine is the nucleophile attacking the 5' splice site, resulting in cleavage at this position. In cis splicing, this is the step that forms a lariat structure of the intron RNA, while it is still joined to the 3' exon.

label: ribonuclease P4 activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 3'-extranucleotides from tRNA precursor.

label: agmatine:putrescine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine(out) + putrescine(in) = agmatine(in) + putrescine(out).

label: progesterone 21-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + progesterone + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = 21-hydroxyprogesterone + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

label: indole-3-acetyl-isoleucine synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-acetate + L-isoleucine + ATP(4-) = H+ + indole-3-acetyl-isoleucine + AMP(2-) + diphosphoric acid.

label: single-strand break-containing DNA binding
definition: Binding to damaged DNA containing single-strand breaks (SSBs).

label: mRNA m(6)A methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an adenosine in mRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = an N(6)-methyladenosine in mRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This activity is the methylation of adenines in mRNA with the consensus sequence RRACH, where R is a purine, and H is C, A, or U.

label: beta-elemene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = beta-elemene + diphosphoric acid.

label: inulin binding
definition: Binding to inulin.

label: limonoid glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + limonin = glucosyl-limonin + UDP.

label: ABC-type vitamin B12 transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: vitamin B12(out) + ATP + H2O = ADP + an vitamin B12(in) + H+ + phosphate. Vitamin B12 is alkylcob(III)alamin.

label: aryl-aldehyde oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aromatic aldehyde + O2 + H2O = an aromatic acid + hydrogen peroxide.

label: metal-dependent deNEDDylase activity
definition: An metal-dependent isopeptidase activity that cleaves NEDD8 from a target protein to which it is conjugated.

label: 11-cis-retinal 3,4-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 11-cis-retinal + 2 H+ + O2 + 2 reduced [adrenodoxin] = 11-cis-3,4-didehydro-retinal + 2 H2O + 2 oxidized [adrenodoxin].

label: CGG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a CGG codon.

label: esculin beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of glucosidic link in esculin.

label: alkylglycerophosphate 2-O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-alkyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = 1-alkyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + CoA.

label: 2-ketobutyrate formate-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxobutanoate + coenzyme A = propionyl-CoA + formate.

label: inositol hexakisphosphate 1-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol hexakisphosphate + ATP = 1-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol 2,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate + ADP.

label: homospermidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 putrescine = NH3 + sym-homospermidine.

label: IgA receptor activity
definition: Combining with an immunoglobulin of an IgA isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: hydrolase activity, acting on carbon-carbon bonds
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any carbon-carbon bond.

label: ganglioside binding
definition: Binding to a ganglioside, a ceramide oligosaccharide carrying in addition to other sugar residues, one or more sialic acid residues.

label: peptide-N4-(N-acetyl-beta-glucosaminyl)asparagine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-N-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-protein + H2O = N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminylamine + peptide L-aspartate. This reaction is the hydrolysis of an N4-(acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl)asparagine residue in which the N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue may be further glycosylated, to yield a (substituted) N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminylamine and the peptide containing an aspartic residue.

label: threonine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-threonine = 2-oxobutanoate + NH4.

label: ATP-dependent DNA/DNA annealing activity
definition: An ATP-dependent activity that facilitates the formation of a complementary double-stranded DNA molecule.

label: proton motive force dependent protein transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of proteins from one side of a membrane to the other. Transportation is dependent on pH gradient across the membrane.

label: allantoin racemase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-(+)-allantoin = (R)-(-)-allantoin.

label: gap junction channel activity involved in atrial cardiac muscle cell-AV node cell electrical coupling
definition: A wide pore channel activity that enables a direct cytoplasmic connection from an atrial cardiomyocyte to an AV node cell. The gap junction passes electrical signals between the cells contributing to cardiac conduction.

label: 8-oxo-dADP diphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8-oxo-dADP + H2O = 8-oxo-dAMP + hydrogenphosphate + H+.

label: tRNA modification guide activity
definition: Specifies the site of a posttranscriptional modification in a tRNA molecule by base pairing with a short sequence around the target residue.

label: dicoumaroyl monocaffeoyl spermidine meta-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dicoumaroyl monocaffeoyl spermidine + NADPH + O2 = monocoumaroyl dicaffeoyl spermidine + NADP+ + H2O.

label: protein-arginine C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group to the carbon atom of an arginine residue in a protein. This modification has been detected in anaerobic bacteria.

label: transmitter-gated monoatomic ion channel activity involved in regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential
definition: Any transmitter-gated ion channel activity that is involved in regulation of postsynaptic membrane potential.

label: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + oxaloacetate = phosphoenolpyruvate + CO2 + other reaction products.

label: glycine betaine:sodium:chloride symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glycine betaine(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out)= glycine betaine(in) + Na+(in) + Cl-(in).

label: tungstate binding
definition: Binding to tungstate.

label: raffinose alpha-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: raffinose + H2O = alpha-D-galactose + sucrose.

label: magnesium ion binding
definition: Binding to a magnesium (Mg) ion.

label: structural constituent of cytoskeleton
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a cytoskeletal structure.

label: cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to a specific upstream regulatory DNA sequence (transcription factor recognition sequence or binding site, located in cis relative to the transcription start site (i.e., on the same strand of DNA) of a gene transcribed by some RNA polymerase. Cis-regulatory sites are often referred to as a sequence motifs, enhancers, or silencers.

label: tRNA-uracil-4 sulfurtransferase activity
definition: Catalyzes the reaction: ATP + [ThiI sulfur-carrier protein]-S-sulfanyl-L-cysteine + uracil in tRNA + 2 reduced ferredoxin [iron-sulfur] cluster = AMP + diphosphate + 4-thiouracil in tRNA + [ThiI sulfur-carrier protein]-L-cysteine + 2 oxidized ferredoxin [iron-sulfur] cluster.

label: 4-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA = vinylacetyl-CoA + H2O.

label: hydroxycyclohexanecarboxylate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1S,3R,4S)-3,4-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxylate + NAD+ = (1S,4S)-4-hydroxy-3-oxocyclohexane-1-carboxylate + H+ + NADH.

label: NADH dehydrogenase (quinone) (non-electrogenic) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADH + H+ + a quinone = NAD+ + a quinol.

label: 9-cis-beta-carotene 9',10'-cleavage oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9-cis-beta-carotene + O2 = 9-cis-10'-apo-beta-carotenal + beta-ionone.

label: apyrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + 2 H2O = a ribonucleoside 5'-phosphate + 2 phosphate. This reaction consists of two distinct successive phosphate-releasing steps, with NDPs as intermediates. Apyrases are active against both di- and triphosphate nucleotides (NDPs and NTPs) and hydrolyze NTPs to nucleotide monophosphates (NMPs).

label: gamma-glutamylhistamine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histamine + L-glutamate + ATP = N(alpha)-gamma-L-glutamylhistamine + products of ATP breakdown.

label: fructose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of fructose from one side of a membrane to the other. Fructose exists in a open chain form or as a ring compound. D-fructose is the sweetest of the sugars and is found free in a large number of fruits and honey.

label: tRNA (guanine(37)-N1)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + guanine(37) in tRNA = N(1)-methylguanine(37) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: type 3 somatostatin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 3 somatostatin receptor.

label: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate binding
definition: Binding to 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate (PAPS), a naturally occurring mixed anhydride. It is an intermediate in the formation of a variety of sulfo compounds in biological systems.

label: Gq/11-coupled serotonin receptor activity
definition: Combining with serotonin and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activation of the Gq/11 subunit of an associated cytoplasmic heterotrimeric G protein complex. The Gq/11 subunit subsequently activates phospholipase C and results in an increase in inositol triphosphate (IP3) levels.

label: vinorine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 16-epivellosimine + acetyl-CoA = CoA + vinorine.

label: microtubule severing ATPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate. Catalysis of the severing of a microtubule at a specific spot along its length, coupled to the hydrolysis of ATP.

label: uridine-rich cytoplasmic polyadenylylation element binding
definition: Binding to a U-rich sequence in the 3'-end of nuclear-transcribed mRNAs; required for cytoplasmic polyadenylylation.

label: UDP-D-glucose:delphinidin 3-O-glucosyl-5-O-caffeoylglucoside -O-beta-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + delphinidin 3-O-glucosyl-5-O-caffeoylglucoside = H+ + delphinidin 3-O-glucosyl-5-O-(caffeoylglucoside-3'-O-glucoside) + UDP.

label: histone pre-mRNA stem-loop binding
definition: Binding to a conserved stem-loop structure found in histone pre-mRNAs.

label: interleukin-1, type I receptor binding
definition: Binding to a Type I interleukin-1 receptor.

label: flap-structured DNA binding
definition: Binding to a flap structure in DNA. A DNA flap structure is one in which a single-stranded length of DNA or RNA protrudes from a double-stranded DNA molecule.

label: hydroxy-nicotine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-hydroxynicotine + H2O + O2 = 1-(6-hydroxypyrid-3-yl)-4-(methylamino)butan-1-one + hydrogen peroxide.

label: interleukin-1, type II, blocking receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-1 to initiate a change in cell activity by inhibiting the activity of type I interleukin receptors.

label: pregnan-21-ol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + pregnan-21-ol = H+ + NADH + pregnan-21-al.

label: BBSome binding
definition: Binding to a BBSome complex.

label: lanosterol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene = lanosterol. This is a cyclization reaction that forms the sterol nucleus.

label: O-acetyl-ADP-ribose deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction O-acetyl-ADP-ribose + H2O = ADP-ribose + acetate. Removes the acetyl group from either the 2'' or 3'' position of O-acetyl-ADP-ribose.

label: low-affinity tryptophan transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the low-affinity transfer of L-tryptophan from one side of a membrane to the other. Tryptophan is 2-amino-3-(1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

label: retinyl-palmitate esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: retinyl palmitate + H2O = retinol + palmitate + H+.

label: DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of ATP-hydrolyzing DNA topoisomerase. ATP-hydrolyzing DNA topoisomerase catalyzes the DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving a pair of complementary DNA strands to form a gate through which a second double-stranded DNA segment is passed, after which the severed strands in the first DNA segment are rejoined; product release is coupled to ATP binding and hydrolysis; changes the linking number in multiples of 2.

label: N-acetyl-beta-glucosaminyl-derivative 4-beta-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosamine = an N-acetyl-beta-D-galactosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP + H+.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-OH group of donors, oxygen as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH-OH group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces an oxygen molecule.

label: oligopeptide binding
definition: Binding to an oligopeptide.

label: histone H2A kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H2A.

label: long-chain (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain (3S)-3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA + NAD+ = a long-chain 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA + H+ + NADH. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

label: naringenin 7-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-naringenin(1-) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = sakuranetin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: microtubule binding
definition: Binding to a microtubule, a filament composed of tubulin monomers.

label: chalcone 4'-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + 2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxychalcone = UDP + 2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxychalcone 4'-O-beta-D-glucoside + H+. Also converts 2',3,4,4',6'-pentahydroxychalcone + UDP-alpha-D-glucose into 2',3,4,4',6'-pentahydroxychalcone 4'-O-beta-D-glucoside.

label: CAC codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a CAC codon.

label: sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to DNA of a specific nucleotide composition, e.g. GC-rich DNA binding, or with a specific sequence motif or type of DNA e.g. promotor binding or rDNA binding.

label: (+)-beta-barbatene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = (-)-beta-barbatene + diphosphate.

label: adenine/cytosine mispair binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing an A/C mispair.

label: benzoyl acetate-CoA thiolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoyl acetyl-CoA + CoA = acetyl-CoA + benzoyl-CoA.

label: endo-1,3(4)-beta-glucanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->3)- or (1->4)-linkages in beta-D-glucans when the glucose residue whose reducing group is involved in the linkage to be hydrolyzed is itself substituted at C-3. Substrates include laminarin, lichenin and cereal D-glucans.

label: type 1 melanin-concentrating hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 melanin-concentrating hormone receptor.

label: adipokinetic hormone binding
definition: Binding to an adipokinetic hormone. Adipokinetic hormones (AKHs) are peptide hormones that are involved in the mobilization of sugar and lipids from the insect fat body during energy-requiring activities such as flight and locomotion. They also contribute to hemolymph sugar homeostasis.

label: adenosine-phosphate deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an adenosine-phosphate + H20 = an inosine phosphate + NH3. Catalyzes the deamination of AMP, ADP or ATP.

label: ornithine N5-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine + O2 + H+ = N5-hydroxy-L-ornithine + H2O.

label: CCC codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a CCC codon.

label: hydrogen-sulfide S-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + S(2-) = CoA + thioacetate.

label: type 4 melanocortin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 4 melanocortin receptor.

label: peroxynitrite reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [protein]-dithiol + ONOO- = [protein]-disulfide + NO2- + H2O.

label: cyclic-GMP-AMP hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclic GMP-AMP + 2 H2O = AMP + GMP.

label: glucose sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of glucose.

label: tRNA (cytidine(32)-2'-O)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(32) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: 3'-flap-structured DNA binding
definition: Binding to a 3'-flap structure in DNA. A DNA flap structure is one in which a single-stranded 3'-end of DNA or RNA protrudes from a double-stranded DNA molecule.

label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-trehalose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + trehalose(out) = protein histidine + trehalose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

label: cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cyclic-GMP-AMP from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: xyloglucan 1,6-alpha-xylosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of xyloglucan side chains so as to remove unsubstituted D-xylose residues attached to the glucose located at the non-reducing terminus.

label: deoxynucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalyzes transport of all four deoxy (d) NDPs, and, less efficiently, the corresponding dNTPs, in exchange for dNDPs, ADP, or ATP.

label: 5-methyldeoxycytidine-5'-phosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxy-5-methyl-5'-cytidylate + ATP = 5-methyldeoxycytidine diphosphate + ADP + H+.

label: cohesin unloader activity
definition: Facilitating a conformational change to unload a cohesin complex from sister chromatids.

label: deoxysarpagine hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-deoxysarpagine + H+ + NADPH + O2 = H2O + NADP+ + sarpagine.

label: clathrin-uncoating ATPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate. Catalysis of the removal of clathrin from vesicle membranes, coupled to the hydrolysis of ATP.

label: aminoglycoside 3''-adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + streptomycin = 3''-adenylylstreptomycin + diphosphate + H+.

label: serine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a substrate by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine).

label: DIMBOA glucoside beta-D-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-DIMBOA glucoside + H2O = H+ + DIMBOA + beta-D-glucose.

label: H1 histone chaperone activity
definition: A histone chaperone that carries a H1 histone.

label: lysolecithin acylmutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine = 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine.

label: diarylpropane peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)methanol + H2O2 = 3,4-dimethoxybenzaldehyde + 2 H2O.

label: D-nopaline dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-nopaline + NADP+ + H2O = L-arginine + 2-oxoglutarate + NADPH + H+.

label: cis-1,2-dihydro-1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol + NAD+ = naphthalene-1,2-diol + NADH + H+.

label: all-trans-beta-apo-10'-carotenal cleavage oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10'-apo-beta-carotenal + O2 = 13-apo-beta-carotenone + 4-methylocta-2,4,6-trienedial.

label: exon-exon junction complex binding
definition: Binding to an exon-exon junction complex, a protein complex deposited by the spliceosome upstream of messenger RNA exon-exon junctions. The exon-exon junction complex provides a binding platform for factors involved in mRNA export and nonsense-mediated mRNA decay.

label: ACA codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes an ACA codon.

label: protein disulfide isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the rearrangement of both intrachain and interchain disulfide bonds in proteins.

label: peptidoglycan glycosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [GlcNAc-(1->4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)](n)-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate = [GlcNAc-(1->4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-gamma-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)](n+1)-di-trans-octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + H+.

label: acyl-lipid (8-3)-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O. Also converts an (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-eicosatetraenoyl-containing glycerolipid into a (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-eicosapentaenoyl-containing glycerolipid.

label: ligase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a ligase.

label: transmembrane-ephrin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a transmembrane ephrin to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: interleukin-6 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-6 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: peroxisome membrane class-1 targeting sequence binding
definition: Binding to a class I peroxisomal membrane targeting sequence, any of several sequences of amino acids within a protein that can act as a signal for the localization of the protein into the peroxisome membrane in a PEX19-dependent manner.

label: type 1 neuropeptide Y receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 neuropeptide Y receptor.

label: N6-acetyl-beta-lysine transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + 3-amino-6-acetamidohexanoate = L-glutamate + 3-oxo-6-acetamidohexanoate.

label: vitamin D3 25-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: calciol (vitamin D3) + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = calcidiol + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H+.

label: (13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-ol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranylgeranyl diphosphate + H2O = (13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-ol + diphosphate.

label: oligopeptide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of oligopeptides from one side of a membrane to the other. Oligopeptides are molecules that contain a small number (2 to 20) of amino-acid residues connected by peptide linkages.

label: 3-hydroxypropionate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypropanoate + NAD+ = 3-oxopropanoate + H+ + NADH.

label: bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase (asymmetrical) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-nucleosyl)tetraphosphate + H2O = NTP + NMP. Acts on bis(5'-guanosyl)-, bis(5'-xanthosyl)-, bis(5'-adenosyl)- and bis(5'-uridyl)-tetraphosphate.

label: interleukin-25 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-25 receptor.

label: ABC-type guanine transporter activity
definition: Catalyses the reaction: ATP + H2O + guanine(out) = ADP + phosphate + guanine(in).

label: IgG receptor activity
definition: Combining with an immunoglobulin of an IgG isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: pre-mRNA binding
definition: Binding to a pre-messenger RNA (pre-mRNA), an intermediate molecule between DNA and protein that may contain introns and, at least in part, encodes one or more proteins. Introns are removed from pre-mRNA to form a mRNA molecule.

label: neurohypophyseal hormone activity
definition: The action characteristic of a neurohypophyseal hormone, any of a family of structurally and functionally related nonapeptides that are synthesized as part of a larger precursor molecule comprising a signal peptide, the nonapeptide hormone, and a neurophysin.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on hydrogen as donor, NAD or NADP as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which hydrogen acts as an electron donor and reduces NAD or NADP.

label: fructan beta-fructosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing 2,1- and 2,6-linked beta-D-fructofuranose residues in fructans.

label: 4-nitrotoluene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + 4-nitrotoluene + NADH + O2 = 4-nitrobenzyl alcohol + NAD+ + H2O.

label: folic acid receptor activity
definition: Combining selectively with extracellular folic acid and delivering it into the cell via endocytosis.

label: phosphoglucomutase (glucose-cofactor) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glucose-1-phosphate = glucose-6-phosphate; using D-glucose as a cofactor.

label: CP2 mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ethanolamine phosphate + Man-alpha-(1,2)-Man-alpha-(1,2)-Man-alpha-(1,6)-R = Man-alpha-(1,2)-Man-alpha-6-P-EtN-(1,2)-Man-alpha-(1,6)-R; R is Man-alpha(1,4)-GlcNH2-inositol-phosphate-lipid. This reaction is the transfer of ethanolamine phosphate to C6 of second mannose in the GPI lipid precursor CP2.

label: L-isoleucine-2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-isoleucine = (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid + L-glutamic acid.

label: isoprene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylallyl diphosphate = diphosphate + isoprene.

label: intracellularly ATP-gated ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when ATP has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the intracellular side of the plasma membrane.

label: complement component iC3b receptor activity
definition: Combining with the iC3b product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: exogenous lipid antigen binding
definition: Binding to an exogenous lipid antigen (examples include microbial lipids and glycolipids).

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-NH group of donors, flavin as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH-NH group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a flavin.

label: riboflavin kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + riboflavin = ADP + FMN + 2 H+.

label: arginase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + H2O = L-ornithine + urea.

label: cycloheximide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of cycloheximide from one side of a membrane to the other. Cycloheximide is an antibiotic produced by Streptomyces which interferes with protein synthesis in eukaryotes.

label: (4S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:(4S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate = pyruvate + glyoxylate. Specific for the (4S) enantiomer of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate.

label: inositol phosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: inositol phosphate + ATP = inositol phosphate + ADP.

label: hexose-phosphate:phosphate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: hexose phosphate(out) + phosphate(in) = hexose phosphate(in) +  phosphate(out).

label: monoatomic ion-gated channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a solute by a channel that opens in response to a specific ion stimulus.

label: voltage-gated potassium channel activity involved in atrial cardiac muscle cell action potential repolarization
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of an atrial cardiomyocyte contributing to the repolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: ligand-modulated transcription activator activity
definition: A DNA-binding transcription activator activity regulated by binding to a ligand and that activates the transcription of specific genes and gene sets.

label: quinoprotein glucose dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + ubiquinone = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + ubiquinol.

label: betaine reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [thioredoxin]-disulfide + acetyl phosphate + H2O + trimethylamine = [thioredoxin]-dithiol + glycine betaine + H+ + phosphate.

label: diphosphate-protein phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: microsomal-membrane protein + diphosphate = diphosphate + O-phospho-microsomal-membrane protein.

label: glycoprotein endo-alpha-1,2-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal alpha-glucosyl-(1,3)-mannosyl unit from Glc-Man(9)-(GlcNAc)(2) oligosaccharide component of the glycoprotein produced in the Golgi membrane.

label: rRNA methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to a nucleoside residue in an rRNA molecule.

label: (13S)-vitexifolin A synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:9alpha-copalyl diphosphate + H2O = (13S)-vitexifolin A + diphosphate.

label: FAD-dependent histone H3K9me/H3K9me2 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a di- or a monomethyl-lysine residue at position 9 of the histone H3 protein. This is a flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD)-dependent amine oxidation reaction.

label: procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: procollagen L-proline + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = procollagen trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline + succinate + CO2.

label: vitamin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a vitamin from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: interferon receptor activity
definition: Combining with an interferon and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: D-alanine-(R)-lactate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + ATP + D-alanine = ADP + D-alanyl-(R)-lactate + phosphate.

label: far-red light photoreceptor activity
definition: The function of absorbing and responding to electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength of approximately 730nm. The response may involve a change in conformation.

label: triphosphoric monoester hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a triphosphoester to give a triphosphate group and a free hydroxyl group.

label: 4-carboxymethyl-4-methylbutenolide mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-carboxymethyl-4-methylbut-2-en-1,4-olide = 4-carboxymethyl-3-methylbut-2-en-1,4-olide.

label: N-acetylglucosaminyldiphosphodolichol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-diphosphodolichol = UDP + N,N''-diacetylchitobiosyldiphosphodolichol.

label: protein prenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent addition of an isoprenoid group such as a farnesyl or geranylgeranyl group via thioether linkages to a cysteine residue in a protein.

label: trimethylamine monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N,N-trimethylamine + NADPH + H+ + O2 = N,N,N-trimethylamine N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O.

label: chloroplast photosystem I binding
definition: Binding to a chloroplast photosystem I.

label: oncostatin-M receptor binding
definition: Binding to an oncostatin-M receptor.

label: isocitrate epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-threo-isocitrate = D-erythro-isocitrate.

label: rRNA (pseudouridine-N3-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing N3-methylpseudouridine.

label: ent-isokaurene C2-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ent-isokaurene + O2 + NADPH + H+ = ent-2alpha-hydroxyisokaurene + H2O + NADP+.

label: long-chain fatty acid omega-1 hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an (omega-1)-ethyl long-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = an (omega-1)-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

label: protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of an amino acid residue in a protein, usually according to the reaction: a protein + ATP = a phosphoprotein + ADP.

label: diacylglycerol cholinephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-choline + 1,2-diacylglycerol = CMP + a phosphatidylcholine.

label: prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + AH2 + 2 O2 = A + H2O + prostaglandin H2.

label: methyl jasmonate methylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a jasmonate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methyljasmonate.

label: amylo-alpha-1,6-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic branch linkages in glycogen phosphorylase limit dextrin. Limit dextrin is the highly branched core that remains after exhaustive treatment of glycogen with glycogen phosphorylase. It is formed because these enzymes cannot hydrolyze the (1->6) glycosidic linkages present.

label: 3-methyl-5-hydroxy-6-(3-carboxy-3-oxopropenyl)-1H-2-pyridon hydratase-aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methyl-5-hydroxy-6-(3-carboxy-3-oxopropenyl)-1H-2-pyridon + H2O = 2-oxobut-3-enanoate + 2,5,6-trihydroxy-3-methylpyridine.

label: NEDD8 conjugating enzyme activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of NEDD8 from one protein to another via the reaction X-NEDD8 + Y = Y-NEDD8 + X, where both the X-NEDD8 and Y-NEDD8 linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal amino acid of NEDD8 and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue.

label: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-undecaprenyl-phosphate N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl phosphate = UMP + N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyldiphospho-ditrans,octacis-undecaprenol.

label: N,N'-diacetylbacilliosaminyl-1-phosphate transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate + UDP-N,N'-diacetylbacillosamine = N,N'-diacetyl-alpha-D-bacillosaminyl-diphospho-tri-trans,hepta-cis-undecaprenol + UMP.

label: cytokine receptor activity
definition: Combining with a cytokine and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: guanidinodeoxy-scyllo-inositol-4-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-guanidino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol 4-phosphate + H2O = 1-guanidino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol + phosphate.

label: lysophosphatidylserine flippase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of a lysophosphatidylserine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

label: L-DOPA binding
definition: Binding to L-DOPA, the modified amino acid (2S)-2-amino-3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid.

label: G protein-coupled glucose receptor activity
definition: Combining with an extracellular glucose molecule and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

label: 3-deoxy-D-glycero-D-galacto-2-nonulosonic acid hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2-keto-3-deoxynononic acid)n + H2O = (2-keto-3-deoxynononic acid)n-1 + 2-keto-3-deoxynononic acid. This reaction is the hydrolysis of a 2-keto-3-deoxynononic acid residue from a poly-2-keto-3-deoxynononic acid chain.

label: RNA stem-loop binding
definition: Binding to a stem-loop in an RNA molecule. An RNA stem-loop is a secondary RNA structure consisting of a double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) stem and a terminal loop.

label: oxygen binding
definition: Binding to oxygen (O2).

label: carbon dioxide binding
definition: Binding to carbon dioxide.

label: long-chain-fatty-acyl-CoA reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty aldehyde + CoA + NADP+ = a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + NADPH.

label: O-succinylbenzoate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-succinylbenzoate + H2O = 2-succinyl-6-hydroxy-2,4-cyclohexadiene-1-carboxylate.

label: tRNA (guanine(27)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(27) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(27) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: itaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: citramalyl-CoA = itaconyl-CoA + H2O.

label: haloalkane dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-haloalkane + H2O = a primary alcohol + halide.

label: insulin binding
definition: Binding to insulin, a polypeptide hormone produced by the islets of Langerhans of the pancreas in mammals, and by the homologous organs of other organisms.

label: indoleacetate-lysine synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (indol-3-yl)acetate + L-lysine + ATP = N(6)-[(indole-3-yl)acetyl]-L-lysine + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

label: deoxycytidyl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the insertion of a dCMP residue opposite a template abasic site in DNA.

label: NADH kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + NADH = ADP + 2 H+ + NADPH.

label: ice binding
definition: Binding to ice, water reduced to the solid state by cold temperature. It is a white or transparent colorless substance, crystalline, brittle, and viscoidal.

label: glycosaminoglycan galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycosaminoglycan + UDP-galactose = D-galactosylglycosaminoglycan + UDP.

label: quinoline 2-oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: quinoline + acceptor + H2O = isoquinolin-1(2H)-one + reduced acceptor.

label: ergosterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + ergosterol = CoA + ergosterol ester.

label: NAD-dependent protein decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

label: L-asparagine, sodium:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(in) + L-asparagine(out) + Na+(out) = H+(out) + L-asparagine(in) + Na+(in).

label: nitric oxide reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + NAD(P)+ + nitrous oxide = H+ + NAD(P)H + 2 nitric oxide.

label: undecaprenyl-phosphate glucose phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = alpha-D-glucosyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + UMP.

label: 4-hydroxy-L-threonine aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-L-threonine = glycolaldehyde + glycine.

label: p53 binding
definition: Binding to one of the p53 family of proteins.

label: 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene + O2 = 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate. C6 of the substrate molecular may have an NH2 group attached.

label: histone succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: succinyl-CoA + histone = CoA + succinyl-histone.

label: ornithine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + L-ornithine = phosphate + L-citrulline.

label: 2-methoxy-6-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-methoxy-6-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 6-methoxy-3-methyl-2-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: dGTP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dGTP + H2O = dGMP + H+ + diphosphate.

label: BMP receptor binding
definition: Binding to a BMP receptor.

label: cannabinoid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a cannabinoid receptor.

label: histone kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone.

label: glutaryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glutaryl-CoA + 2 H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + CO2 + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

label: N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an acetyl group to a nitrogen atom on the acceptor molecule.

label: guanine/guanine mispair binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing a G/G mispair.

label: sterol 14-demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 14alpha-methyl steroid + 3 O2 + 3 reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = a delta14 steroid + formate + 4 H+ + 4 H2O + 3 oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

label: beta-1,3-galactosyl-O-glycosyl-glycoprotein beta-1,6-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-R = UDP + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->6)]-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-R. This reaction is the addition of N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine to the core 1 structure of O-glycans forming core 2.

label: glutamine N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + L-glutamine = CoA + N-acyl-L-glutamine.

label: cytokinin riboside 5'-monophosphate phosphoribohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-(dimethylallyl)adenosine 5'-phosphate + H2O = N(6)-dimethylallyladenine + D-ribose 5-phosphate.

label: glutathione-homocystine transhydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: homocystine + 2 reduced glutathione = oxidized glutathione + 2 homocysteine.

label: NAD+-protein-lysine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = H+ + N(6)-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-lysyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

label: open form four-way junction DNA binding
definition: Binding to a DNA segment containing the open form of a four-way junction, also known as a Holliday junction, a structure where two DNA double strands are held together by reciprocal exchange of two of the four strands, one strand each from the two original helices. The open form of a four-way junction can be diagrammed without any of the strands crossing over.

label: peroxisome membrane targeting sequence binding
definition: Binding to a peroxisomal membrane targeting sequence, any of several sequences of amino acids within a protein that can act as a signal for the localization of the protein into the peroxisome membrane.

label: D-xylose 1-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-xylose + NADP+ = D-xylono-1,5-lactone + H+ + NADPH.

label: glycine C-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + glycine = L-2-amino-3-oxobutanoate + CoA.

label: sialate 4-O-acetylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N-acetyl-4-O-acetylneuraminate = acetate + H+ + N-acetylneuraminate.

label: GAC codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a GAC codon.

label: reverse gyrase activity
definition: Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving one DNA strand at a time to allow passage of another strand; changes the linking number by +1 per catalytic cycle, is driven by ATP hydrolysis.
