definition: Binding to a general transcription initiation factor, a protein that contributes to transcription start site selection and transcription initiation.

label: peptide noradrenalinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-noradrenaline + L-glutaminyl-[protein] = 5-(R)-noradrenalinyl-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4(+).

label: GDP-L-galactose phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-beta-L-galactose + phosphate = beta-L-galactose-1-phosphate + GDP.

label: cytokinin binding
definition: Binding to a cytokinin, any of a class of adenine-derived compounds that can function in plants as growth regulators.

label: trihydroxystilbene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3 malonyl-CoA + 4-coumaroyl-CoA = 4 CoA + 3,4',5-trihydroxy-stilbene + 4 CO2.

label: 5'-acylphosphoadenosine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5'-acylphosphoadenosine + H2O = AMP + a carboxylate.

label: protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein.

label: arachidonate 8(R)-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arachidonate + O2 = (5Z,8R,9E,11Z,14Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosa-5,9,11,14-tetraenoate.

label: 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + H+ = (4-hydroxyphenyl)acetaldehyde + CO2.

label: low-affinity IgE receptor activity
definition: Combining with low affinity with an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: L-arabinose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-arabinose from one side of a membrane to the other. Arabinose occurs free, for example in the heartwood of many conifers and in the combined states, in both furanose and pyranose forms, as a constituent of various plant hemicelluloses, bacterial polysaccharides, etc.

label: salutaridinol 7-O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (7S)-salutaridinol + acetyl-CoA = (7S)-O-acetylsalutaridinol + CoA.

label: palmitoyl-[glycerolipid] 3-(E)-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-2-hexadecanoyl-glycerolipid + 2 H+ + O2 + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = a 1-acyl-2-[(3E)-hexadec-3-enoyl]-glycerolipid + 2 H2O + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin]. The this activity introduces an unusual trans double bond at carbon 3 of a palmitoyl group attached to the sn-2 position of glycerolipids.

label: GC-box binding
definition: Binding to a GC-box, a DNA motif with the consensus sequence GGGCGG that is located upstream of the start point of eukaryotic transcription units. The GC-box may occur in multiple copies or in either orientation relative to the transcription start site.

label: ketoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reduction of a ketone group to form the corresponding alcohol.

label: tellurite methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tellurite + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = methanetellurite + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: parathyroid hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a parathyroid hormone receptor.

label: lipid-A-disaccharide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a lipid X + a UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine = a lipid A disaccharide + UDP + H+.

label: ACU codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes an ACU codon.

label: diacylglycerol-dependent, calcium-independent serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated by diacylglycerol but not by calcium.

label: DNA (6-4) photolyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyrimidine-pyrimidone (6-4) photoproduct (in DNA) = 2 pyrimidine residues (in DNA). Catalyzes the reactivation of ultraviolet-irradiated DNA.

label: CTPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + H2O = CDP + H+ + phosphate. May or may not be coupled to another reaction.

label: angelicin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: columbianetin + NADPH + O2 + H+ = angelicin + acetone + NADP + 2 H2O.

label: FMN adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + FMN = diphosphate + FAD.

label: high-density lipoprotein particle binding
definition: Binding to high-density lipoprotein particle, a lipoprotein particle with a high density (typically 1.063-1.21 g/ml) and a diameter of 5-10 nm that contains APOAs and may contain APOCs and APOE.

label: trimethyllysine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysine + O2 = 3-hydroxy-N(6),N(6),N(6)-trimethyl-L-lysine + CO2 + succinate.

label: levanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of 2,6-beta-D-fructofuranosidic linkages in 2,6-beta-D-fructans (levans) containing more than 3 fructose units.

label: maltodextrin phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-maltotetraose + phosphate = alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + alpha-maltotriose.

label: H3 histamine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a H3 histamine receptor.

label: citrate-L-glutamate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + citrate + L-glutamate = ADP + phosphate + beta-citryl-L-glutamate.

label: glycochenodeoxycholate sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + glycochenodeoxycholate = adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + glycochenodeoxycholate 7-sulfate + H+.

label: UUA codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a UUA codon.

label: 2,3-diaminopropionate N-oxalyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-amino-L-alanine + oxalyl-CoA = N(3)-oxalyl-L-2,3-diaminopropanoate + CoA.

label: L-arginine conjugated cholate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholate + L-arginine = L-arginocholate + H2O.

label: nickel cation transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of nickel (Ni) cations from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: methionine adenosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-methionine + H2O = phosphate + diphosphate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine.

label: acyl-phosphate-hexose phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-hexose + acyl phosphate = D-hexose phosphate + an acid.

label: prostaglandin J receptor activity
definition: Combining with prostaglandin J (PGJ(2)), a metabolite of prostaglandin D (PGD(2)) to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: N-acetylglucosamine 6-O-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-sulfate.

label: tetrahymanol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tetrahymanol = squalene + H2O.

label: tartrate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tartrate + NAD+ = oxaloglycolate + NADH + H+.

label: cocaine binding
definition: Binding to cocaine (2-beta-carbomethoxy-3-beta-benzoxytropane), an alkaloid obtained from dried leaves of the South American shrub Erythroxylon coca or by chemical synthesis.

label: carbamoyl-serine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-carbamoyl-L-serine + H2O + H+ = CO2 + 2 NH4 + pyruvate.

label: 3'(2'),5'-bisphosphate nucleotidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H2O = adenosine 5'-phosphate + phosphate.

label: complement component C3a receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C3a product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: 2-coumarate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate + NAD+ = trans-2-coumarate + H+ + NADH.

label: amidine-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of amides or amidines by the cleavage of a carbon-nitrogen bond or the reverse reaction with an amide or amidine as a substrate.

label: pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide receptor activity
definition: A G protein-coupled receptor that interacts with pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide.

label: decarboxylation-driven active transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Primary active transport of a solute across a membrane driven by decarboxylation of a cytoplasmic substrate. Primary active transport is catalysis of the transport of a solute across a membrane, up the solute's concentration gradient, by binding the solute and undergoing a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a primary energy source.

label: meso-tartrate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R,3S)-tartrate + NAD+ = dihydroxyfumarate + H+ + NADH.

label: histone H3K18 deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 18) + NAD+ + H2O = histone H3 L-lysine (position 18) + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group attached to a lysine residue in H3K18 to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

label: molecular condensate scaffold activity
definition: Binding and bringing together two or more macromolecules in contact, permitting those molecules to organize as a molecular condensate.

label: rhamnose binding
definition: Binding to the D- or L-enantiomer of rhamnose.

label: UCG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a UCG codon.

label: isoprenoid binding
definition: Binding to an isoprenoid compound, isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene) or compounds containing or derived from linked isoprene (3-methyl-2-butenylene) residues.

label: N-acetyllactosamine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = UDP + N-acetyllactosamine.

label: lysophospholipid acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of acyl groups from an acyl-CoA to a lysophospholipid.

label: L-lactate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + O2 = pyruvate + H2O2.

label: palmitoleoyl [acyl-carrier-protein]-dependent acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a palmitoleoyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + alpha-KDO-(2->4)-alpha-KDO-(2->6)-lipid IVA = KDO2-(palmitoleoyl)-lipid IVA + a holo-[acyl-carrier protein].

label: Delta4-3-oxosteroid 5beta-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-oxo-5beta-steroid + NADP+ = a 3-oxo-Delta(4)-steroid + H+ + NADPH. The enzyme from human efficiently catalyzes the reduction of progesterone, androstenedione, 17alpha-hydroxyprogesterone and testosterone to 5beta-reduced metabolites; it can also act on aldosterone, corticosterone and cortisol, but to a lesser extent. The bile acid intermediates 7alpha,12alpha-dihydroxy-4-cholesten-3- one and 7alpha-hydroxy-4-cholesten-3-one can also act as substrates.

label: co-receptor binding
definition: Binding to a coreceptor. A coreceptor acts in cooperation with a primary receptor to transmit a signal within the cell.

label: gibberellin A9 carboxyl methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gibberellin A9 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = gibberellin A9 methyl ester + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: intermediate-density lipoprotein particle binding
definition: Binding to a intermediate-density lipoprotein particle, a triglyceride-rich lipoprotein particle that typically contains APOB100, APOE and APOCs and has a density of 1.006-1.019 g/ml and a diameter of between 25-30 nm.

label: glutamate binding
definition: Binding to glutamate, the anion of 2-aminopentanedioic acid.

label: phosphatidylethanolamine:Kdo2-lipid A phosphoethanolamine transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Kdo2-lipid A + phosphatidylethanolamine = phosphoethanolamine-Kdo2-lipid A + diacylglycerol.

label: GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-mannose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-6-deoxy-D-mannose + NAD(P)+ = GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-mannose + NAD(P)H + H+.

label: ATPase-coupled urea transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + urea(out) = ADP + phosphate + urea(in).

label: hepoxilin-epoxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,9E,14Z)-(8x,11R,12S)-11,12-epoxy-8-hydroxyicosa-5,9,14-trienoate + H2O = (5Z,9E,14Z)-(8x,11x,12S)-8,11,12-trihydroxyicosa-5,9,14-trienoate.

label: metalloexopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a peptide bond not more than three residues from the N- or C-terminus of a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which water acts as a nucleophile, one or two metal ions hold the water molecule in place, and charged amino acid side chains are ligands for the metal ions.

label: anthocyanidin 3-glucoside rhamnosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: anthocyanidin 3-glucoside + UDP-rhamnose = anthocyanidin 3-rutinoside + UDP.

label: eukaryotic elongation factor-2 kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulates the activity of the enzyme eukaryotic elongation factor-2 kinase.

label: NADH dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADH + H+ + acceptor = NAD+ + reduced acceptor.

label: histone deacetylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-acetyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + NAD+ + H2O = L-lysyl-[protein] + 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide. This reaction transfers an acetyl group from a histone to NAD, producing nicotinamide.

label: 8-demethylnovobiocic acid C8-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + 8-desmethylnovobiocic acid = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + novobiocic acid + H+.

label: peptidyl-arginine 3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalyzes the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + [protein]-L-arginine + O2 = [protein]-(3R)-3-hydroxy-L-arginine + CO2 + succinate.

label: folic acid binding
definition: Binding to folic acid, pteroylglutamic acid. Folic acid is widely distributed as a member of the vitamin B complex and is essential for the synthesis of purine and pyrimidines.

label: adenosine-tetraphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 5'-tetraphosphate + H2O = phosphate + ATP + H+.

label: membrane destabilizing activity
definition: Binding to a membrane and increasing its permeability. This may lead to cell membrane lysis and cell content release.

label: peroxisome targeting sequence binding
definition: Binding to a peroxisomal targeting sequence, a sequence of amino acids within a protein that acts as a signal for the localization of a protein into the peroxisome.

label: collagen binding involved in cell-matrix adhesion
definition: Any collagen binding that occurs as part of cell-matrix adhesion.

label: 4-vinylphenol methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-vinylphenol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4-vinylanisole + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: mannitol-1-phosphate 5-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannitol 1-phosphate + NAD+ = D-fructose 6-phosphate + NADH + H+.

label: beta-3 adrenergic receptor binding
definition: Binding to a beta-3 adrenergic receptor.

label: flavonol-3-O-glycoside glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + a flavonol 3-O-beta-D-glucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucoside = UDP + a flavonol 3-O-beta-D-glucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-glucoside.

label: phospholipase D activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of the enzyme phospholipase D.

label: cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cAMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

label: ceramide transfer activity
definition: Removes a ceramide from a membrane or a monolayer lipid particle, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to an acceptor membrane or lipid particle.

label: amino acid kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to an amino acid substrate.

label: imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-erythro-1-(imidazol-4-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate = 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate + H2O.

label: protein-arginine N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginyl-[protein] + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine = H+ + N(omega)-(N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl)-L-arginyl-[protein] + UDP.

label: Rab GDP-dissociation inhibitor activity
definition: Prevents the dissociation of GDP from the small GTPase Rab, thereby preventing GTP from binding.

label: acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an acetyl group to an acceptor molecule.

label: precorrin-2 C20-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + precorrin-2 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + precorrin-3A.

label: 3-hydroxy-2-methylbutyryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA = NADH + H+ + 2-methylaceto-acetyl-CoA.

label: licodione 2'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + licodione = 2'-O-methyllicodione + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: U11 snRNA binding
definition: Binding to a U11 small nuclear RNA (U11 snRNA).

label: saccharopine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + L-saccharopine + O2 = (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoate + H2O2 + L-glutamate.

label: anthranilate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate + L-glutamine = anthranilate + pyruvate + L-glutamate.

label: NADPH phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H2O = NADH + hydrogenphosphate.

label: beta-glucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-glucuronoside + H2O = an alcohol + D-glucuronate.

label: phosphatidylcholine 12-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-acyl-2-(9Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = 1-acyl-2-[(R)-12-hydroxyoleoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + H2O.

label: succinate-citramalate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-citramalate + succinyl-CoA = citramalyl-CoA + succinate.

label: extracellular matrix constituent conferring elasticity
definition: A component of the extracellular matrix that enables the matrix to recoil after transient stretching.

label: ubiquitin-like protein-specific endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds between an alpha-carboxyl group and an alpha-amino group within a small protein such as ubiquitin or a ubiquitin-like protein (e.g. APG8, ISG15, NEDD8, SUMO).

label: apolipoprotein receptor binding
definition: Binding to an apolipoprotein receptor.

label: histone H3K36 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone H3 L-lysine (position 36) = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + histone H3 N6-methyl-L-lysine (position 36). This reaction is the addition of a methyl group to the lysine residue at position 36 of the histone H3 protein.

label: tRNA-uridine aminocarboxypropyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a uridine in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 3-[(3S)-3-amino-3-carboxypropyl]uridine in tRNA + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + H+.

label: bicarbonate binding
definition: Binding to bicarbonate ions (CHO3-).

label: chitin binding
definition: Binding to chitin, a linear polysaccharide consisting of beta-(1->4)-linked N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues.

label: dolichyl-phosphate beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + dolichyl phosphate = UDP + dolichyl beta-D-glucosyl phosphate.

label: capsular-polysaccharide endo-1,3-alpha-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->3)-alpha-D-galactosidic linkages in Aerobacter aerogenes capsular polysaccharide.

label: 6-methylsalicylate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-methylsalicylate + H+ = 3-cresol + CO2.

label: glucan 1,3-alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal (1->3)-alpha-D-glucosidic links in 1,3-alpha-D-glucans.

label: structural constituent of synapse-associated extracellular matrix
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the extracellular matrix of the perisynaptic space (the extracellular space adjacent to the synapse) and the synaptic cleft.

label: corticotropin-releasing hormone binding
definition: Binding to corticotropin-releasing hormone, a polypeptide hormone involved in the stress response. It is released by the hypothalamus and stimulates the release of corticotropin by the anterior pituitary gland.

label: transferase activity, transferring phosphorus-containing groups
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphorus-containing group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

label: high-affinity D-glucose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: glucose + H+ = glucose + H+. This activity is constitutive and therefore always present, regardless of demand. Symporter activity enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

label: EGF-domain serine glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + [protein with EGF-like domain]-L-serine = UDP + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine.

label: chromo shadow domain binding
definition: Binding to a chromo shadow domain, a protein domain that is distantly related, and found in association with, the chromo domain.

label: lithocholic acid binding
definition: Binding to lithocholic acid.

label: beta2-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of beta2-adrenergic receptors.

label: nuclear receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear receptor protein. Nuclear receptor proteins are DNA-binding transcription factors which are regulated by binding to a ligand.

label: oxaloacetate tautomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: oxaloacetate = <stereo>enol</stereo>-oxaloacetate.

label: amino-terminal vacuolar sorting propeptide binding
definition: Binding to an amino terminal propeptide, which functions as a sorting signal to sort away the soluble vacuolar protein from Golgi to lytic vacuole via clathrin-coated vesicles.

label: solute:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: solute(out) + H+(out) = solute(in) + H+(in).

label: voltage-gated monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a cation by a voltage-gated channel. A cation is a positively charged ion. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: cephalosporin-C transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (7R)-7-(5-carboxylato-5-oxopentanamido)deacetylcephalosporanate + D-glutamate = 2-oxoglutarate + cephalosporin C.

label: D-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of D-amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. D-amino acids are the D-enantiomers of amino acids.

label: nucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a nucleotide, any compound consisting of a nucleoside that is esterified with (ortho)phosphate, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: group II metabotropic glutamate receptor activity
definition: A G protein-coupled receptor that is activated by trans-1-aminocyclopentane-1,3-dicarboxylic acid (t-ACPD) and inhibits adenylate cyclase activity.

label: kappa-type opioid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a kappa-type opioid receptor.

label: scutellarein 7-methyl ether 6-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + scutellarein 7-methyl ether = cirsimaritin + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: D-arabinitol 2-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinitol + NAD+ = D-ribulose + H+ + NADH.

label: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate = 4-aminobenzoate + H+ + pyruvate.

label: histone H3K4me/H3K4me2/H3K4me3 demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from a tri, a di or a monomethyl-lysine residue at position 4 of the histone H3 protein. This is a dioxygenase reaction that is dependent on Fe(II) and 2-oxoglutarate.

label: active transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a specific substance or related group of substances from one side of a membrane to the other, up the solute's concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction.

label: hexose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a hexose sugar, a monosaccharide with 6 carbon atoms, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: purine imidazole-ring cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA 4,6-diamino-5-formamidopyrimidine = DNA adenine + H2O.

label: interleukin-35 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-35.

label: oligosaccharide 4-alpha-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of the non-reducing terminal alpha-D-glucose residue from a 1,4-alpha-D-glucan to the 4-position of an alpha-D-glucan, thus bringing about the hydrolysis of oligosaccharides.

label: GTP-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein or protein complex when at least one of the interacting partners is in the GTP-bound state.

label: decylhomocitrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + H2O + lauroyl-CoA = (3S,4S)-3-hydroxytetradecane-1,3,4-tricarboxylate + CoA + H+.

label: galactosamine-6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = D-tagatose 6-phosphate + NH3.

label: rRNA modification guide activity
definition: Specifies the site of a posttranscriptional modification in an rRNA molecule by base pairing with a short sequence around the target residue.

label: sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor activity
definition: Combining with the sphingolipid sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P), and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein.

label: acylphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl phosphate + H2O = a carboxylate + phosphate.

label: N-acetylgalactosamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + N-acetyl-D-galactosamine = ADP + N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate.

label: polygalacturonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-galactosiduronic linkages in pectate and other galacturonans.

label: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + oxaloacetate = phosphoenolpyruvate + HCO3-.

label: mRNA 5'-cap (guanine-N7-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + G(5')pppR-RNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + m7G(5')pppR-RNA. m7G(5')pppR-RNA is mRNA containing an N7-methylguanine cap; R may be guanosine or adenosine.

label: 4-hydroxymandelate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-4-hydroxymandelate + H+ + O2 = 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde + CO2 + H2O2.

label: snRNA methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group from a donor to a nucleoside residue in an snRNA molecule.

label: type II interferon binding
definition: Binding to type II interferon, also known as interferon-gamma.

label: prostaglandin H2 endoperoxidase reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin F2alpha + NADP+ = prostaglandin H2 + NADPH + H+.

label: structural constituent of presynaptic active zone
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a presynaptic active zone.

label: type 2 cannabinoid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 cannabinoid receptor.

label: ATP deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ITP + NH3.

label: polyprenol reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP + a ditrans,polycis-dolichol = NADPH + H+ + a di-trans, poly-cis-polyprenol.

label: macrophage colony-stimulating factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a macrophage colony-stimulating factor receptor.

label: rhamnetin 3-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: rhamnetin + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 3',4',5-trihydroxy-3,7-dimethoxyflavone + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: flap endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a flap structure in DNA, but not other DNA structures; processes the ends of Okazaki fragments in lagging strand DNA synthesis.

label: euchromatin-nuclear membrane anchor activity
definition: Binding to euchromatin and the nuclear inner membrane, in order to establish and maintain the euchromatin location and organization.

label: lactoylglutathione lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-S-lactoylglutathione = glutathione + methylglyoxal.

label: 3-demethylubiquinol 3-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-demethylubiquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a ubiquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: fluorescent chlorophyll catabolite monooxygenase (deformylase) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + primary fluorescent chlorophyll catabolite + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = formate + 2 H+ + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + primary fluorescent dioxobilin-type chlorophyll catabolite.

label: 21U-RNA binding
definition: Binding to a 21U-RNA, a 21-nucleotide RNA characterized by a uridine 5'-monophosphate and a modified 3' end resistant to periodate degradation. 21U-RNAs are derived from distinct, autonomously expressed loci within the genome.

label: xylitol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: xylitol + O2 = xylose + H2O2. Xylitol (five carbons) and sorbitol (6 carbons) are the preferred substrates.

label: tropinesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: atropine + H2O = H+ + tropate + tropine.

label: glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor activity
definition: Combining with glucagon-like peptide 1 and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein.

label: EP1 subtype prostaglandin E2 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an EP1 subtype prostaglandin E2 receptor.

label: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + oxaloacetate = ADP + CO2 + H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate.

label: O-palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a palmitoyl group to an oxygen atom on the acceptor molecule.

label: histone H4K20me3 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 trimethylated at lysine 20.

label: translation regulator activity
definition: Any molecular function involved in the regulation of initiation, activation, perpetuation, repression or termination of polypeptide synthesis at the ribosome.

label: polymyxin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of polymyxin, any of a group of related antibiotics produced by Bacillus polymyxa and active against most Gram-negative bacteria, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: protein histidine kinase binding
definition: Binding to a protein histidine kinase.

label: kolavenyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = (+)-kolavenyl diphosphate.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the aldehyde or oxo group of donors, iron-sulfur protein as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which an aldehyde or ketone (oxo) group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces an iron-sulfur protein.

label: phosphodiesterase activity, acting on 3'-phosphoglycolate-terminated DNA strands
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolytic removal of phosphoglycolate from the 3'-terminus of a 3'-phosphoglycolate-terminated DNA strand.

label: protoheme IX farnesyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protoheme IX + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + H2O = heme O + diphosphate.

label: L-fucose isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fucose = L-fuculose.

label: agmatine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: agmatine + ATP = N(4)-phosphoagmatine + ADP + 3 H+.

label: succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase binding
definition: Binding to succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase.

label: methyl jasmonate esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + methyl (-)-jasmonate = H+ + jasmonate + methanol.

label: tRNA (cytidine(56)-2'-O)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + cytidine56 in tRNA= S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2'-O-methylcytidine56 in tRNA.

label: nascent polypeptide-associated complex binding
definition: Binding to nascent polypeptide-associated complex, a heterodimeric protein complex that can reversibly bind to ribosomes and is located in direct proximity to newly synthesized polypeptide chains as they emerge from the ribosome.

label: enterobactin binding
definition: Binding to enterobactin.

label: very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a very-long-chain (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NADP+ = a very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA + H+ + NADPH. This reaction is the second (reduction) step of the four-step fatty acid elongation cycle in the endoplasmic reticulum that extends fatty acids of C-16 or longer with an additional 2-C unit.

label: single base insertion or deletion binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing a single base insertion or deletion.

label: alcohol binding
definition: Binding to an alcohol, any of a class of alkyl compounds containing a hydroxyl group.

label: alpha,alpha-trehalose phosphorylase (configuration-retaining) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose + phosphate = alpha-D-glucose + alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

label: L-glutamine binding
definition: Binding to L-glutamine, 2,5-diamino-5-oxopentanoic acid.

label: catalytic activity, acting on DNA
definition: Catalytic activity that acts to modify DNA.

label: steroid 7-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a steroid + AH2 + O2 = 7-alpha-hydroxysteroid + H2O.

label: mannose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: mannose + H+ = mannose + H+.

label: myosin XI tail binding
definition: Binding to the tail region of a myosin XI heavy chain.

label: ent-pimara-9(11),15-diene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ent-copalyl diphosphate = ent-pimara-9(11),15-diene + diphosphate.

label: gluconate 2-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-gluconate + NADP+ = 2-dehydro-D-gluconate + NADPH + H+.

label: type 2 somatostatin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2 somatostatin receptor.

label: [3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase (lipoamide)]-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + O-phospho-L-seryl-[3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase] = L-seryl-[3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase] + phosphate.

label: ABC-type manganese transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Mn2+(out) = ADP + phosphate + Mn2+(in).

label: pyrogallol 1,2-oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + pyrogallol = (Z)-5-oxohex-2-enedioate + 2 H+.

label: muscle alpha-actinin binding
definition: Binding to muscle isoforms of actinin. Muscle alpha-actinin isoforms are found in skeletal and cardiac muscle and are localized to the Z-disc.

label: TFIIB-class transcription factor binding
definition: Binding to a general RNA polymerase II transcription factor of the TFIIB class, one of the factors involved in formation of the preinitiation complex (PIC) by RNA polymerase II.

label: spermine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosylmethioninamine + spermidine = 5'-methylthioadenosine + spermine.

label: histone H2BS36 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2B-serine (position 36) + ATP = histone H2B-phosphoserine (position 36) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 36 of histone H2B.

label: red or far-red light photoreceptor activity
definition: The function of absorbing and responding to electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength of approximately 660-730nm. The response may involve a change in conformation.

label: guanine nucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of guanine nucleotides (GMP, GDP, and GTP) from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: peptidyl-lysine 3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein L-lysine + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = protein 3-hydroxy-L-lysine + succinate + CO2.

label: tRNA dihydrouridine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5,6-dihydrouridine in tRNA + NAD(P)+ = a uridine in tRNA + H+ + NAD(P)H.

label: Fas-activated serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + Fas-activated serine/threonine protein = ADP + Fas-activated serine/threonine phosphoprotein.

label: pterocarpan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + medicarpin = 4'-methoxyisoflavan-2',4,7-triol.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on X-H and Y-H to form an X-Y bond
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which X-H and Y-H form X-Y.

label: L-rhamnose 1-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-rhamnofuranose + NAD+ = L-rhamnono-1,4-lactone + H+ + NADH.

label: formimidoylaspartate deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formimidoyl-L-aspartate + H2O = N-formyl-L-aspartate + NH3.

label: glycolipid binding
definition: Binding to a glycolipid, any compound containing one or more monosaccharide residues bound by a glycosidic linkage to a hydrophobic group such as an acylglycerol, a sphingoid, a ceramide (N-acylsphingoid) or a prenyl phosphate.

label: peptidase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a peptidase.

label: cyanidin 3-O-[2''-O-(xylosyl)-6''-O-(p-coumaroyl) glucoside] 5-O-glucoside malonyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: anthocyanin A3 + malonyl-CoA = anthocyanin A5 + CoA.

label: alpha-ketoglutarate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of alpha-ketoglutarate from one side of a membrane to the other. Alpha-ketoglutarate (or oxoglutarate) is a compound with important roles in carbohydrate and amino acid metabolism, especially in transamination reactions and as a component of the TCA cycle.

label: lipid exchange activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a specific lipid molecule from one membrane to another, coupled with the simultaneous counter-transfer of a different lipid molecule in the opposite direction.

label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-sorbitol phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + sorbitol(out) = protein histidine + sorbitol phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

label: phenylacetyl-coenzyme A:glycine N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenylacetyl-CoA + glycine = H+ + phenylacetylglycine + coenzyme A.

label: galactogen 6-beta-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: galactogen + UDP-galactose = 1,6-beta-D-galctosylgalactogen + UDP.

label: geranylgeranyltransferase type III activity
definition: Catalyzes the covalent addition of a geranylgeranyl group to a mono-farnesylated substrate via a thioether linkage to a cysteine residue located within a conserved C-terminal tandem cysteine motif (CCAIM or CCIIM) that is used in substrate recognition. Known substrates include mono-farnesylated Golgi SNARE proteins.

label: histone decrotonylase activity, NAD-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[histone] + nicotinamide.

label: solute:potassium antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the active transport of a potassium ion across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported in opposite directions in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy.

label: galactosyl beta-1,3 N-acetylgalactosamine beta-1,3-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer, in a beta 1,3 linkage, of D-glucuronic acid (GlcUA) from UDP-GlcUA to the disaccharide galactosyl beta-1,3 N-acetylgalactosamine, a common component of glycoproteins and glycolipids.

label: flavonoid sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a flavonoid + 3'-phosphoadenosine-5'-phosphosulfate = sulfated flavonoid + adenosine-3',5'-diphosphate. This reaction is the transfer of a sulfate group to the hydroxyl group of a flavonoid acceptor, producing the sulfated flavonoid derivative.

label: histone H2AS139pho reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A phosphorylated at serine 139.

label: acetylspermidine deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(8)-acetylspermidine + H2O = acetate + spermidine.

label: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate dehydrogenase (ferredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + CoA + oxidized ferredoxin = S-(2-methylpropanoyl)-CoA + CO2 + reduced ferredoxin.

label: heme binding
definition: Binding to a heme, a compound composed of iron complexed in a porphyrin (tetrapyrrole) ring.

label: beta-D-fucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-fucose residues in beta-D-fucosides.

label: dextranase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of 1,6-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in dextran.

label: type 5 neuropeptide Y receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 5 neuropeptide Y receptor.

label: thioredoxin-disulfide reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thioredoxin-dithiol + NADP+ = thioredoxin-disulfide + H+ + NADPH.

label: L-phenylalaine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + L-phenylalanine + O2 = 3-phenylpyruvate + H2O2 + NH4(+).

label: omega-hydroxydecanoate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-hydroxydecanoate + NAD+ = 10-oxodecanoate + H+ + NADH.

label: prephenate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + prephenate = (4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH.

label: gamma-glutamyl carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-glutamate + reduced vitamin K + CO2 + O2 = peptidyl-gamma-carboxyglutamate + vitamin K epoxide.

label: hypoxanthine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hypoxanthine + NAD+ + H2O = xanthine + NADH + H+.

label: 5-ureido-4-imidazole carboxylate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-ureido-4-imidazole carboxylate + H2O = 5-amino-4-imidazole carboxylate + NH3 + CO2.

label: lavandulyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 dimethylallyl diphosphate = diphosphate + lavandulyl diphosphate.

label: melanocortin receptor activity
definition: Combining with melanocortin to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: cyclohexanol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexanol + NAD+ = cyclohexanone + NADH + H+.

label: neuromedin K receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neuromedin K receptor.

label: 3-ketopimelyl-CoA thiolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-ketopimeloyl-CoA + CoA = glutaryl-CoA + acetyl-CoA.

label: beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminides.

label: phosphatidylglycerol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) + NAD+ = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerone) + NADH + H+.

label: adrenomedullin binding
definition: Binding to adrenomedullin (AM).

label: ADP:phosphate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of ADP from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ADP(out) + phosphate(in) = ADP(in) + phosphate(out).

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on diphenols and related substances as donors, oxygen as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a diphenol, or related compound, acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces oxygen.

label: 5-methylthiopropyl glucosinolate S-oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methylthiopropyl-glucosinolate = 5-methylsulfinylpropyl-glucosinolate.

label: N-acetyllactosaminide alpha-2,3-sialyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = an N-acetyl-alpha-neuraminyl-(2->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + CMP + H+.

label: acetylsalicylate deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetylsalicylate + H2O = acetate + H+ + salicylate.

label: lipoarabinomannan immune receptor activity
definition: Combining with lipoarabinomannan and transmitting the signal to initiate an innate immune response.

label: cytoskeletal protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein component of a cytoskeleton (actin, microtubule, or intermediate filament cytoskeleton).

label: 3-(hydroxyamino)phenol mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxyaminophenol = aminohydroquinone.

label: RNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of a phosphodiester bond between a hydroxyl group at the end of one RNA chain and the phosphate group at the end of another.

label: (3S)-(+)-asterisca-2(9),6-diene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = (3S)-(+)-asterisca-2(9),6-diene + diphosphate.

label: eriodictyol 3'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-eriodictyol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = (S)-homoeriodictyol + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: acrosin binding
definition: Binding to acrosin, a protein that is found in the acrosomes of sperm and possesses protease and carbohydrate binding activities.

label: S-adenosyl-L-methionine lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine = L-homoserine lactone + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine.

label: phlorizin hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phlorizin + H2O = beta-D-glucose + phloretin.

label: cholest-4-en-3-one 26-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholest-4-en-3-one + NADH + H+ + O2 = 26-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one + NAD+ + H2O. This reaction involves the hydroxylation of the C26 carbon, followed by oxidation of the alcohol to the carboxylic acid via the aldehyde intermediate.

label: solute:monoatomic cation symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: solute(out) + cation(out) = solute(in) + cation(in).

label: ATPase-coupled polar amino acid-transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + polar amino acid(out) = ADP + phosphate + polar amino acid(in).

label: N-acetylglucosamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. The D isomer of N-acetylglucosamine is a common structural unit of glycoproteins in plants, bacteria and animals; it is often the terminal sugar of an oligosaccharide group of a glycoprotein.

label: aliphatic aldoxime dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aliphatic aldoxime = an aliphatic nitrile + H2O.

label: nucleoside-triphosphate-hexose-1-phosphate nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hexose 1-phosphate + nucleoside triphosphate = NDP-hexose + diphosphate.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-CH group of donors, oxygen as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH-CH group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces oxygen.

label: sulfiredoxin activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peroxiredoxin-(S-hydroxy-S-oxocysteine) + ATP + 2 R-SH = peroxiredoxin-(S-hydroxycysteine) + ADP + phosphate + R-S-S-R.

label: carbon-nitrogen lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of ammonia or one of its derivatives, with the formation of a double bond or ring. Enzymes with this activity may catalyze the actual elimination of the ammonia, amine or amide, e.g. CH-CH(-NH-R) = C=CH- + NH2-R. Others, however, catalyze elimination of another component, e.g. water, which is followed by spontaneous reactions that lead to breakage of the C-N bond, e.g. L-serine ammonia-lyase (EC:4.3.1.17), so that the overall reaction is C(-OH)-CH(-NH2) = CH2-CO- + NH3, i.e. an elimination with rearrangement. The sub-subclasses of EC:4.3 are the ammonia-lyases (EC:4.3.1), lyases acting on amides, amidines, etc. (EC:4.3.2), the amine-lyases (EC:4.3.3), and other carbon-nitrogen lyases (EC:4.3.99).

label: peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a reduced substrate + ROOH = an oxidized substrate + ROH + H2O.

label: neutral L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of neutral L-amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Neutral amino acids have side chains with no charge at pH 7.3.

label: phosphatidylserine floppase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of phosphatidylserine from the cytosolic to the exoplasmic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.

label: N-methylcoclaurine 3'-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-N-methylcoclaurine + H+ + NADPH + O2 = (S)-3'-hydroxy-N-methylcoclaurine + H2O + NADP+.

label: estrogen 16-alpha-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: estrogen + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = 16-alpha-hydroxyestrogen + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O.

label: SUMO polymer binding
definition: Binding to a polymer of the small ubiquitin-like protein SUMO.

label: 2-phytyl-1,4-naphthoquinone methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: demethylphylloquinol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + phylloquinol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a mannose residue to an oligosaccharide, forming an alpha-(1->3) linkage.

label: hyaluronoglucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of 1,3-linkages between beta-D-glucuronate and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in hyaluronate.

label: P-type calcium transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + Ca2+(in) = ADP + phosphate + Ca2+(out).

label: protein binding involved in heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
definition: Binding to a protein or protein complex contributing to the adhesion of two different types of cells.

label: capsorubin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-violaxanthin = all-trans-capsorubin.

label: nitrate:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: nitrate(out) + H+(out) = nitrate(in) + H+(in).

label: 6-oxocineole dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-oxocineole + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 1,6,6-trimethyl-2,7-dioxabicyclo[3.2.2]nonan-3-one + H2O + NADP+.

label: ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NADP+ + H+ = 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NADPH.

label: histone methacryllysine demethacrylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6-methacrylyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + H2O = 2-methylprop-2-enoate + L-lysyl-[histone].

label: alpha-ketoester reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-ketoester + H+ + NADPH = (R)-hydroxy ester + NADP+.

label: L-aspartate:fumarate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transport of L-aspartate and fumarate across a membrane according to the reaction L-aspartate (out) + fumarate (in) = L-aspartate (in) + fumarate (out).

label: anthranilate N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + anthranilate = N-methylanthranilate + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: fructokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose = ADP + D-fructose 6-phosphate.

label: phosphonoacetaldehyde hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phosphonoacetaldehyde = acetaldehyde + H+ + phosphate.

label: mRNA (adenine-N1-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + adenine in mRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + N(1)-methyladenine in mRNA.

label: CTP-dependent diacylglycerol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + CTP = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CDP + H+.

label: acireductone dioxygenase [iron(II)-requiring] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxy-5-(methylthio)pent-1-en-3-one + O2 = 4-methylthio-2-oxobutanoate + formate + H+.

label: (1,4)-alpha-D-glucan 1-alpha-D-glucosylmutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-[(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n-1)-D-glucose = 1-alpha-D-[(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n-1)-alpha-D-glucopyranoside.

label: hydroxyacid-oxoacid transhydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxybutanoate + 2-oxoglutarate = acetoacetate + (R)-2-hydroxyglutarate.

label: cystathionine gamma-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cystathionine + H2O = 2-oxobutanoate + L-cysteine + NH4+.

label: glucose-6-phosphate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glucose-6-phosphate from one side of a membrane to the other. Glucose-6-phosphate is a monophosphorylated derivative of glucose with the phosphate group attached to C-6.

label: nucleoside triphosphate adenylate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + AMP = nucleoside diphosphate + ADP.

label: oxysterol binding
definition: Binding to oxysterol, an oxidized form of cholesterol.

label: class II DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages immediately 5' to an apurinic/apyrimidinic (AP; also called abasic) site within a deoxyribonucleic acid molecule by creating internal breaks, generating a single-strand break with 5'-deoxyribose phosphate and 3'-hydroxyl ends.

label: placental growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with placental growth factor (PlGF) receptor ligand and transmitting the signal across the plasma membrane to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: high-affinity IgE receptor activity
definition: Combining with high affinity with an immunoglobulin of the IgE isotype via the Fc region, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: non-sequence-specific DNA binding, bending
definition: The activity of binding selectively and non-covalently to DNA in a sequence-independent manner and distorting the original structure of DNA, typically a straight helix, into a bend, or increasing the bend if the original structure was intrinsically bent due to its sequence.

label: phosphorylase kinase regulator activity
definition: Modulation of the activity of the enzyme phosphorylase kinase.

label: chlorogenate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chlorogenate + H2O = (-)-quinate + cis-caffeate + H+.

label: citrate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of citrate, 2-hydroxy-1,2,3-propanetricarboxylate, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: peptidoglycan N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta linkages of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (GlcNAc) from peptidoglycan.

label: glycosylceramide flippase activity
definition: Catalysis of the movement of glycosylceramide from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP. Glycosylceramides are ceramides containing a functional group derived from a sugar.

label: aspartate 1-decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = beta-alanine + CO2.

label: deoxynucleoside phosphate kinase activity, ATP as phosphate donor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-phosphate + ATP = a 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + ADP.

label: prostaglandin F2-alpha receptor binding
definition: Binding to a prostaglandin F2-alpha receptor.

label: mannose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: D-mannose(out) + Na+(out) = D-mannose(in) + Na+(in).

label: N-feruloylglycine deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-feruloylglycine + H2O = ferulate + glycine.

label: glucan endo-1,2-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->2)-glucosidic linkages in (1->2)-beta-D-glucans.

label: complement component C3b receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C3b product of the complement cascade and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: glutamate synthase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 L-glutamate + NADP+ = 2-oxoglutarate + L-glutamine + H+ + NADPH. This is a two-step reaction: (a) L-glutamate + NH3 = L-glutamine + H2O, (b) L-glutamate + NADP+ + H2O = NH3 + 2-oxoglutarate + NADPH + H+.

label: phosphate acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + phosphate = CoA + acetyl phosphate.

label: fructose 6-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-fructose-6-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone + D-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate.

label: double-stranded miRNA binding
definition: Binding to double-stranded miRNA. double-stranded miRNA is formed by processing of pre-miRNA stem-loop structures.

label: tRNA-specific adenosine-34 deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine-34 + H2O = inosine-34 + NH3, in a tRNA-Ala molecule.

label: nerve growth factor binding
definition: Binding to nerve growth factor (NGF).

label: retinol binding
definition: Binding to retinol, vitamin A1, 2,6,6-trimethyl-1-(9'-hydroxy-3',7'-dimethylnona-1',3',5',7'-tetraenyl)cyclohex-1-ene, one of the three components that makes up vitamin A. Retinol is an intermediate in the vision cycle and it also plays a role in growth and differentiation.

label: exoribonuclease H activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 5'-phosphomonoester oligonucleotides in both 5' to 3' and 3' to 5' directions.

label: ABC-type amino acid transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + amino acid(out/in) = ADP + phosphate + amino acid(in/out).

label: DNA N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of damaged bases by cleaving the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the target damaged DNA base and the deoxyribose sugar. The reaction releases a free base and leaves an apurinic/apyrimidinic (AP) site.

label: structural constituent of ribosome
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the ribosome.

label: neurotransmitter:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: neurotransmitter(out) + Na+(out) = neurotransmitter(in) + Na+(in).

label: alpha-santalene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-cis,6-cis-farnesyl diphosphate = (+)-alpha-santalene + diphosphoric acid.

label: NAD transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of NAD from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: ganglioside GP1c binding
definition: Binding to ganglioside GP1c.

label: uronate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galacturonate + H2O + NAD+ = galactarate + 2 H+ + NADH.

label: L-arabinose 1-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinose + NADP+ = L-arabinono-1,4-lactone + NADPH + H+.

label: beta-apiosyl-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7-[beta-D-apiofuranosyl-(1->6)-beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy]isoflavonoid + H2O = a 7-hydroxyisoflavonoid + beta-D-apiofuranosyl-(1->6)-D-glucose.

label: lipoprotein particle receptor activity
definition: Combining with a lipoprotein particle and delivering the lipoprotein particle into the cell via endocytosis. A lipoprotein particle, also known as a lipoprotein, is a clathrate complex consisting of a lipid enwrapped in a protein host without covalent binding in such a way that the complex has a hydrophilic outer surface consisting of all the protein and the polar ends of any phospholipids.

label: nuclear retinoid X receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear retinoid X receptor.

label: inward rectifier potassium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a potassium ion by an inwardly-rectifying voltage-gated channel. An inwardly rectifying current-voltage relation is one where at any given driving force the inward flow of K+ ions exceeds the outward flow for the opposite driving force. The inward-rectification is due to a voltage-dependent block of the channel pore by a specific ligand or ligands, and as a result the macroscopic conductance depends on the difference between membrane voltage and the K+ equilibrium potential rather than on membrane voltage itself.

label: C5-methylcytidine-containing RNA reader activity
definition: A protein adaptor that recognizes and binds an RNA molecule modified by C5-methylcytidine.

label: amorpha-4,11-diene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = amorpha-4,11-diene + diphosphate.

label: dimethylmaleate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R,3S)-2,3-dimethylmalate = dimethylmaleate + H2O.

label: enzyme-thiol transhydrogenase (glutathione-disulfide) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: oxidized glutathione + [xanthine dehydrogenase] = reduced glutathione + xanthine-oxidase.

label: rRNA (cytosine) methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing methylcytosine.

label: endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids by creating internal breaks.

label: calcium ion binding
definition: Binding to a calcium ion (Ca2+).

label: protein antigen binding
definition: Binding to a protein antigen.

label: netrin receptor activity involved in chemorepulsion
definition: Combining with a netrin signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to contribute to the directed movement of a motile cell away from a higher concentration of netrin.

label: putrescine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + putrescine = N-methylputrescine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: N-acetylglucosaminyl-proteoglycan 4-beta-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-O-{alpha-D-GlcNAc-[(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc](n)-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl}-L-seryl-[protein] + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = 3-O-{[(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc](n+1)-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcA-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->3)-beta-D-Gal-(1->4)-beta-D-Xyl}-L-seryl-[protein] + H+ + UDP.

label: phospholipid:diacylglycerol acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a glycerophospholipid + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol = a monoacylglycerophospholipid + a triacyl-sn-glycerol.

label: versiconal reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2S)-versicolorone + NADP+ = 1'-hydroxyversicolorone + H+ + NADPH.

label: N-acetylornithine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + carbamoyl phosphate = N(2)-acetyl-L-citrulline + H+ + phosphate.

label: long-chain fatty acyl-CoA binding
definition: Binding to a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA, any derivative of coenzyme A in which the sulfhydryl group is in a thioester linkage with a long-chain fatty-acyl group. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

label: stalled ribosome sensor activity
definition: A molecule that recognizes stalled ribosomes and initiates a signaling response.

label: histone H3K27 monomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6-methyl-L-lysyl27-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the unmethylated lysine residue at position 27 of histone H3, producing histone H3K27me.

label: histone H2B acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2B L-lysine = CoA + histone H2B N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

label: Ser-tRNA(Ala) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ser-tRNA(Ala).

label: dATP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dATP + H2O = dAMP + H+ + diphosphate.

label: cerebroside transfer activity
definition: Directly binding to a cerebroside and delivering it either to an acceptor molecule or to a specific location.

label: chloride:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(out) + proton(in) = chloride(in) + proton(out).

label: nucleosome array spacer activity
definition: A histone octamer slider activity that spaces nucleosomes along chromosomal DNA. This activity is involved in assembling chromatin in uniform nucleosome arrays to regulate transcription by RNA polymerases I, II, and III, as well as DNA replication, recombination and repair.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on diphenols and related substances as donors, with copper protein as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a diphenol, or related compound, acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces a copper protein.

label: quinaldate 4-oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + H2O + quinaldate = AH(2) + kynurenate.

label: galactarate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: galactarate = 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucarate + H2O.

label: nitrite reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrite + acceptor = product(s) of nitrate reduction + reduced acceptor.

label: signaling receptor regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of a receptor.

label: 3-deoxyglucosone dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-deoxyglucosone + H2O + NAD+ = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + 2 H+ + NADH.

label: azole transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of azoles, heterocyclic compound found in many biologically important substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: nicotinamide riboside hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinamide riboside + H2O = nicotinamide + D-ribose.

label: C-C chemokine receptor activity
definition: Combining with a C-C chemokine and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity. C-C chemokines do not have an amino acid between the first two cysteines of the characteristic four-cysteine motif.

label: ecdysone binding
definition: Binding to 20-hydroxyecdysone (ecdysone). Ecdysone is an ecdysteroid produced by the prothoracic glands of immature insects and the ovaries of adult females, which stimulates growth and molting.

label: isonocardicin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + nocardicin E = S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + H+ + isonocardicin A.

label: D-tryptophan N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-tryptophan + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-D-tryptophan + CoA + H+.

label: type 1F serotonin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1F serotonin receptor.

label: MHC class II protein binding, via lateral surface
definition: Binding to the lateral surface of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules.

label: 8-hydroxyquercitin 8-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,3',4',5,7,8-hexahydroxyflavone + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) = 3,3',4',5,7-pentahydroxy-8-methoxyflavone + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: iron ion transmembrane transporter inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents, or reduces the activity of an iron ion transmembrane transporter.

label: Ala-tRNA(Pro) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ala-tRNA(Pro).

label: dopamine neurotransmitter receptor activity, coupled via Gs
definition: Combining with the neurotransmitter dopamine and activating adenylate cyclase via coupling to Gs to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: volume-sensitive chloride channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a volume-sensitive channel. A volume-sensitive channel is a channel that responds to changes in the volume of a cell.

label: transmembrane receptor protein phosphatase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: a phosphoprotein + H2O = a protein + phosphate.

label: tRNA 2-(methylsulfanyl)-N(6)-isopentenyladenosine(37) hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methylsulfanyl-N(6)-dimethylallyladenosine(37) in tRNA + acceptor-H2 + O2 = N(6)-[(2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl]-2-(methylsulfanyl)adenosine(37) in tRNA + acceptor + H2O.

label: neuropeptide F receptor binding
definition: Binding to a neuropeptide F receptor.

label: URM1 conjugating enzyme activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of URM1 from one protein to another via the reaction X-URM1 + Y = Y-URM1 + X, where both the X-URM1 and Y-URM1 linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal amino acid of URM1 and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue.

label: exopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a peptide bond not more than three residues from the N- or C-terminus of a polypeptide chain, in a reaction that requires a free N-terminal amino group, C-terminal carboxyl group or both.

label: ligand-gated monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a specific ligand has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: endoplasmic reticulum signal peptide binding
definition: Binding to an endoplasmic reticulum signal peptide, a specific peptide sequence that acts as a signal to localize the protein within the endoplasmic reticulum.

label: dimethyl selenide methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + dimethyl selenide = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + trimethylselenonium.

label: D(-)-tartrate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-tartrate = H2O + oxaloacetate.

label: ABC-type carbohydrate transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate, to directly drive the transport of carbohydrates and their derivatives across a membrane.

label: mannosyl-oligosaccharide mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal alpha-D-mannose residues in oligo-mannose oligosaccharides.

label: thiosulfate binding
definition: Binding to a thiosulfate, a sulfur oxide that has formula O3S2.

label: histone H2AK15ac reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A acetylated at lysine 15.

label: asparagine-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine + ATP + tRNA(Asn) = AMP + Asn-tRNA(Asn) + diphosphate + 2 H+.

label: (E,E)-geranyllinalool synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate + H2O = (6E,10E)-geranyllinalool + diphosphate.

label: UFM1 ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of UFM1 to a substrate protein via the reaction X-UFM1 + S = X + S-UFM1, where X is either an E2 or E3 enzyme, the X-UFM1 linkage is a thioester bond, and the S-UFM1 linkage is an isopeptide bond between the C-terminal amino acid of UFM1 and the epsilon-amino group of lysine residues in the substrate.

label: glycine amidinotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + glycine = L-ornithine + guanidinoacetate.

label: myristoyl-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + myristic acid + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + myristoyl-CoA.

label: inositol-1-diphosphate-2,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol 2,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,3,4,5,6-hexakisphosphate + phosphate + 2 H+.

label: NAD+-histone H2BE35 glutamate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ADP-ribose groups to the glutamate-35 residue of the N-terminal tail of histone H2B (or an equivalent residue).

label: procollagen-proline 3-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: procollagen L-proline + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = procollagen trans-3-hydroxy-L-proline + succinate + CO2.

label: exoribonuclease activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of an exoribonuclease.

label: FMN transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of flavine mononucleotide (FMN) from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: endopolyphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: polyphosphate + n H2O = (n+1) oligophosphate. The product contains 4 or 5 phosphate residues.

label: type 1 cysteinyl leukotriene receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 cysteinyl leukotriene receptor.

label: cis-1,2-dihydroxy-4-methylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydroxy-4-methylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1-carboxylate + NADP+ = 4-methylcatechol + NADPH + H+ + CO2.

label: choriogonadotropin hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with the choriogonadotropin hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: sodium:iodide symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: iodide(out) + Na+(out) = iodide(in) + Na+(in).

label: monoatomic cation:bicarbonate symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: monoatomic cation(out) + HCO3-(out) = monoatomic cation(in) + HCO3-(in).

label: phosphoglycerate kinase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glycerate + GTP = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + GDP + H+.

label: structural constituent of chromatin
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of chromatin.

label: glucose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + ATP = ADP-glucose + diphosphate.

label: neutral sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sphingomyelin = ceramide + choline phosphate + H+ in a neutral environment.

label: putrescine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + putrescine = N-carbamoylputrescine + H+ + phosphate.

label: ubiquitin-protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ubiquitin from one protein to another via the reaction X-Ub + Y = Y-Ub + X, where both X-Ub and Y-Ub are covalent linkages.

label: mannose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate + GTP = diphosphate + GDP-alpha-D-mannose.

label: phloroisovalerophenone synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isovaleryl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA = 4 CoASH + 3 CO2 + 3-methyl-1-(2,4,6-trihydroxyphenyl)butan-1-one.

label: glycine binding
definition: Binding to glycine, aminoethanoic acid.

label: arrestin family protein binding
definition: Binding to a member of the arrestin family, proteins involved in agonist-mediated desensitization of G protein-coupled receptors.

label: dimethylallyltranstransferase activity
