definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylallyl diphosphate + isopentenyl diphosphate = (2E)-geranyl diphosphate + diphosphate.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-NH group of donors, NAD or NADP as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH-NH group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces NAD or NADP.

label: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: (S)-dihydroorotate + a quinone = orotate + a quinol.

label: carbazole 1,9a-dioxygenase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9H-carbazole + H+ + NAD(P)H + O2 = 2'-aminobiphenyl-2,3-diol + NAD(P)+.

label: aspartate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + ATP = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + ADP + H+.

label: prephenate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + prephenate = (4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + CO2 + NADH.

label: high molecular weight B cell growth factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a high molecular weight B cell growth factor receptor.

label: deoxyguanosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyguanosine + ATP = ADP + dGMP + 2 H+.

label: guanylate cyclase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of guanylate cyclase.

label: lipase binding
definition: Binding to a lipase.

label: 3,4-dihydroxyphthalate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxyphthalate + H+ = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + CO2.

label: protein-lysine lysyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein-lysine + protein-lysine = protein N6-(lysyl)-L-lysine + protein. This reaction is the addition of lysine group from one protein to a lysine residue in a second protein, producing N6-(lysyl)-L-lysine.

label: interleukin-11 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-11.

label: cytosine/thymine mispair binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing a C/T mispair.

label: L-leucine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-leucine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-leucine is 2-amino-4-methylpentanoic acid.

label: histone H4K16 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 16) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 16). This reaction represents the addition of an acetyl group to the lysine at position 16 of histone H4.

label: RNA polymerase III hybrid type promoter sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to a sequence of DNA that is a part of a hybrid type promoter that controls transcription by RNA polymerase III (Pol III). A hybrid Pol III promoter contains both regulatory elements both upstream and downstream of the transcription initiation site. An example gene with such a promoter is the S. cerevisiae U6 gene.

label: steroid 9-alpha-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + O2 + pregna-4,9(11)-diene-3,20-dione = 9,11alpha-epoxypregn-4-ene-3,20-dione + A + H2O.

label: alpha-2B adrenergic receptor binding
definition: Binding to an alpha-2B adrenergic receptor.

label: histone H4S1 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4-serine (position 1) + ATP = histone H4-phosphoserine (position 1) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 1 of histone H4.

label: protein methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group (CH3-) to a protein.

label: muconate cycloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = cis,cis-hexadienedioate.

label: 1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + 1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate = NADH + CO2 + catechol.

label: dichloromethane dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dichloromethane + H2O = 2 chloride + formaldehyde + 2 H+.

label: azobenzene reductase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aniline + N,N-dimethyl-1,4-phenylenediamine + 2 NADP+ = 4-(dimethylamino)azobenzene + 2 H+ + 2 NADPH.

label: amylopectin binding
definition: Binding to amylopectin.

label: xylan 1,3-beta-xylosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of successive xylose residues from the non-reducing termini of (1->3)-beta-D-xylans.

label: phosphopantetheine binding
definition: Binding to phosphopantetheine, the vitamin pantetheine 4'-(dihydrogen phosphate).

label: homoserine O-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homoserine + succinyl-CoA = O-succinyl-L-homoserine + CoA.

label: formate dehydrogenase (cytochrome-c-553) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ferricytochrome C-553 + formate = ferrocytochrome C-553 + CO2.

label: molybdate ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of molybdate (MoO4 2-) ions from one side of a membrane to the other. Molybdate is the bivalent anion derived from molybdic acid.

label: CDP-glycerol glycerophosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycerophosphate(n) + CDP-glycerol = glycerophosphate(n+1) + CMP.

label: tyrosine-based site-specific recombinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of new phosphodiester bonds between a pair of short, unique DNA target sequences; occurs through a phosphotyrosyl intermediate in which the target sequence is first cleaved by the nucleophilic attack by a tyrosine in the active site.

label: single-stranded 3'-5' DNA helicase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate, in the presence of single-stranded DNA; drives the unwinding of the DNA helix in the direction 3' to 5'.

label: selenocysteine insertion sequence binding
definition: Binding to a selenocysteine insertion sequence (SECIS), a regulatory sequence within mRNA which directs incorporation of a selenocysteine at a stop codon (UGA) during translation.

label: bis(monoacylglycero)phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) = 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(3'-acyl-1'-sn-glycerol) + sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol).

label: D-iditol 2-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-iditol + NAD+ = D-sorbose + NADH.

label: aconitate delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-aconitate = cis-aconitate.

label: galactosamine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of galactosamine from one side of a membrane to the other. Galactosamine is an aminodeoxysugar; D-galactosamine is a constituent of some glycolipids and glycosaminoglycans, commonly as its N-acetyl derivative.

label: aspartate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = fumarate + NH3.

label: carbonyl reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a secondary alcohol + NADP+ = a ketone + H+ + NADPH.

label: hydrolase activity, acting on ether bonds
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any ether or thioether bond, -O- or -S- respectively.

label: C-rich strand telomeric DNA binding
definition: Binding to C-rich, single-stranded, telomere-associated DNA.

label: intraciliary transport particle A binding
definition: Binding to an intraciliary transport particle A (IFT A) complex.

label: NAD+-protein-glutamate ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamyl-[protein] + NAD+ = 5-O-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-glutamyl-[protein] + nicotinamide.

label: phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate) + H2O = 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3,4-bisphosphate) + phosphate.

label: cysteine desulfurase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + [enzyme]-cysteine = L-alanine + [enzyme]-S-sulfanylcysteine.

label: copper-dependent protein binding
definition: Binding to a protein or protein complex, in the presence of copper.

label: transposase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transposition of transposable elements or transposons. Transposases are involved in recombination required for transposition and are site-specific for the transposon/transposable element.

label: trans-cinnamate-CoA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (E)-cinnamate + ATP + CoA = (E)-cinnamoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate.

label: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA thioesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA + H+.

label: scutellarein 7-O-glucuronosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: scutellarein + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate = scutellarin + UDP.

label: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + H2O = 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutarate + CoA + H+.

label: chloramphenicol O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chloramphenicol + acetyl-CoA = chloramphenicol 3-acetate + CoA.

label: nitroalkane oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a primary nitroalkane + H2O + O2 = an aldehyde + H+ + H2O2 + nitrite; also converts secondary nitroalkanes to a ketone.

label: virus receptor activity
definition: Combining with a virus component and mediating entry of the virus into the cell.

label: Ala-tRNA(Thr) deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanyl-tRNA(Thr) + H2O = tRNA(Thr) + L-alanine + H+.

label: DNA-DNA tethering activity
definition: Bridging together two regions of a DNA molecule.

label: L-methionine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-methionine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-methionine is 2-amino-4-(methylthio)butanoic acid.

label: thebaine 6-O-demethylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thebaine + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = neopinone + formaldehyde + succinate + carbon dioxide.

label: interleukin-17 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-17 receptor.

label: phosphatidylethanolamine lysophospholipase A1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + a fatty acid + H+.

label: histone methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + histone = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + methyl-histone. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue.

label: zinc ion sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of zinc.

label: aryl-alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aromatic alcohol + NAD+ = an aromatic aldehyde + NADH + H+.

label: D-aspartate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of D-aspartate from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: (-)-borneol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (-)-borneol + NAD+ = (1S,4S)-camphor + H+ + NADH.

label: thiamine binding
definition: Binding to thiamine (vitamin B1), a water soluble vitamin present in fresh vegetables and meats, especially liver.

label: 1-(4-iodo-2,5-dimethoxyphenyl)propan-2-amine binding
definition: Binding to the amine 1-(4-iodo-2,5-dimethoxyphenyl)propan-2-amine, a serotonin receptor agonist that can act as a psychedelic drug.

label: GTP-dependent polynucleotide 5'-hydroxyl-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + 5'-dephosphopolynucleotide = GDP + 5'-phosphopolynucleotide. The polynucleotide may be DNA or RNA.

label: spermidine:caffeoyl CoA N-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a caffeoyl group to a nitrogen atom on the spermidine molecule.

label: retroviral integrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent insertion of double-stranded retroviral DNA into host DNA. Proceeds by an endonucleolytic cleavage at each 3'-OH extremity of the viral genome, named 3'-processing, followed by a strand transfer reaction leading to the insertion of the processed viral DNA into the target DNA by a trans-esterification mechanism.

label: acyl-CoA 6-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the introduction of a cis double bond at carbon 6 of acyl-CoAs, introducing a new double bond between a pre-existing double bond and the carboxyl-end of the fatty acid. Specific reactions include: (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = (6Z,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O; and (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + O2 + 2 H+ = (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl-CoA + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

label: hydrogenase (acceptor) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2 + A = AH2.

label: quercetin-3-sulfate 3'-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + quercetin 3-sulfate = adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + H+ + quercetin 3,3'-disulfate.

label: N-(4-aminobenzoyl)-L-glutamate synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzoate + L-glutamate + ATP = N-(4-aminobenzoyl)-L-glutamate + AMP + diphosphate + H+.

label: G-protein gated monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: A cation channel activity that is gated by binding of a G-protein beta-gamma dimer.

label: alpha-actinin binding
definition: Binding to alpha-actinin, one of a family of proteins that cross-link F-actin as antiparallel homodimers. Alpha-actinin has a molecular mass of 93-103 KDa; at the N-terminus there are two calponin homology domains, at the C-terminus there are two EF-hands. These two domains are connected by the rod domain. This domain is formed by triple-helical spectrin repeats.

label: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bisphosphate + H2O = 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + phosphate.

label: dGTPase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dGTP + H2O = 2'-deoxyguanosine + 2 H+ + triphosphate.

label: taxoid 7beta-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: taxusin + [reduced NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = 7beta-hydroxytaxusin + [oxidized NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] + H2O. Also converts 2alpha-hydroxytaxusin to 2alpha,7beta-dihydroxytaxusin.

label: N-acetyllactosaminide 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-R + UDP-galactose = alpha-D-galactosyl-(1,3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-R + UDP.

label: 4-(hydroxymethyl)benzenesulfonate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(hydroxymethyl)benzenesulfonate + NAD+ = 4-formylbenzenesulfonate + H+ + NADH.

label: L-serine-pyruvate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + pyruvate = 3-hydroxypyruvate + L-alanine.

label: C2 domain binding
definition: Binding to the C2 domain of a protein, a protein structural domain involved in targeting proteins to cell membranes.

label: toxin activity
definition: Interacting selectively with one or more biological molecules in another (target) organism, initiating pathogenesis (leading to an abnormal, generally detrimental state) in the target organism. The activity should refer to an evolved function of the active gene product, i.e. one that was selected for. Examples include the activity of botulinum toxin, and snake venom.

label: lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of C-C, C-O, C-N and other bonds by other means than by hydrolysis or oxidation, or conversely adding a group to a double bond. They differ from other enzymes in that two substrates are involved in one reaction direction, but only one in the other direction. When acting on the single substrate, a molecule is eliminated and this generates either a new double bond or a new ring.

label: peptidyl-dipeptidase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a peptidyl-dipeptidase. Peptidyl-dipeptidase activity catalyzes the release of C-terminal dipeptides from a polypeptide chain.

label: histone H4K91 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 4 at the lysine-91 residue.

label: limonin-D-ring-lactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: limonoate D-ring-lactone + H2O = limonoate.

label: formaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formaldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = formate + 2 H+ + NADH.

label: snoRNP binding
definition: Binding to a small nucleolar ribonucleoprotein particle.

label: phosphoprotein binding
definition: Binding to a phosphorylated protein.

label: iron-sulfur cluster chaperone activity
definition: Binding to an iron-sulfur cluster and delivering it to an acceptor molecule.

label: CXCR6 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CXCR6 chemokine receptor.

label: UDP-D-xylose:beta-D-glucoside alpha-1,3-D-xylosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalyzes the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-xylose + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine = UDP + [protein with EGF-like domain]-3-O-(alpha-D-xylosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-glucosyl)-L-serine.

label: 2-hydroxypyridine 5-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxypyridine + AH(2) + O2 = 2,5-dihydroxypyridine + A + H2O.

label: pheromone activity
definition: The activity of binding to and activating specific cell surface receptors, thereby inducing behavioral, developmental, or physiological response(s) from a responding organism or cell. The substance may be released or retained on the cell surface. Pheromones may serve as a specific attractant, social communicator, or sexual stimulant.

label: protein-hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with a protein hormone to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: indole-3-pyruvate monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(indol-3-yl)pyruvate + NADPH + O2 + H+ = indole-3-acetate + carbon dioxide + NADP + H2O.

label: polyketide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of a multistep reaction that produce polyketides through decarboxylative condensation of carboxylic acids. The key chain-building reaction, a C-N bond-forming reaction, involves the generation of the characteristic peptide bond by nucleophilic attack of the amino group of an amino-acyl donor unit covalently bound to a downstream peptidyl carrier protein module (amino acyl-S-PCP) on the acyl group of an upstream electrophilic acyl- or peptidyl acyl-S-PCP chain, catalyzed by a condensation (C) domain. Supplementing these core chain-elongation domains are variable numbers of auxiliary domains that are responsible for modification of the growing polypeptide chain by a small set of iterated reactions including epimerization, N-methylation, and heterocyclization.

label: phosphoribosylamine-glycine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-phospho-D-ribosylamine + ATP + glycine = N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

label: 5'-flap-structured DNA binding
definition: Binding to a 5'-flap structure in DNA. A DNA flap structure is one in which a single-stranded 5'-end of DNA or RNA protrudes from a double-stranded DNA molecule. 5'-flap structures can be formed during DNA repair or lagging strand synthesis; in the latter case RNA flaps form from lagging strand RNA primers.

label: threo-3-hydroxyaspartate ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-aspartate = NH4 + oxaloacetate.

label: beta-carotene 3-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-beta-carotene + 4 H+ + 2 O2 + 4 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = all-trans-zeaxanthin + 2 H2O + 4 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

label: initiator methionyl aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of N-terminal initiator methionine from peptides.

label: tRNA transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of tRNA, transfer ribonucleic acid, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: steviolmonoside glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: steviolmonoside + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = rubusoside + UDP.

label: second spliceosomal transesterification activity
definition: Catalysis of the second transesterification reaction of spliceosomal mRNA splicing. Ligation of the two exons occurs via a transesterification reaction where the free 3'-hydroxyl group of the 5' exon is the nucleophile attacking the 3' splice site. Non-expressed sequences are now detached from the exons. In cis splicing, the intron is in a lariat structure.

label: quinone reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 a quinone + NADPH + H+ = 2 a 1,4-benzosemiquinone + NADP+.

label: protein-cysteine S-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an acyl group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule.

label: glucosyl-DNA beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a beta-D-glucosyl residue from UDP-glucose to a glucosylhydroxymethylcytosine residue in DNA.

label: cardiolipin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylglycerol + phosphatidylglycerol = diphosphatidylglycerol (cardiolipin) + glycerol.

label: dihydrofolate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NADP+ = 7,8-dihydrofolate + NADPH + H+.

label: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate-serine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + L-serine = products of ATP breakdown + N-(2,3-dihydroxybenzoyl)-L-serine.

label: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + CoA + 2 NAD+ = 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + 2 NADH.

label: nitrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 16 ATP + 16 H2O + N2 + 8 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = 16 ADP + 6 H+ + H2 + 2 NH4+ + 8 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 16 phosphate.

label: DNA endonuclease activity, producing 3'-phosphomonoesters
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acids by creating internal breaks to yield 3'-phosphomonoesters.

label: DNA nucleotidylexotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deoxynucleoside triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); template-independent extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one nucleotide at a time.

label: titin binding
definition: Binding to titin, any of a family of giant proteins found in striated and smooth muscle. In striated muscle, single titin molecules span half the sarcomere, with their N- and C-termini in the Z-disc and M-line, respectively.

label: phosphatidyl-N-methylethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phosphatidyl-N-methylethanolamine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + phosphatidyl-N-dimethylethanolamine. Also catalyzes the transfer of a further methylgroup, producing phosphatidylcholine.

label: UDP-glucose 4,6-dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-D-glucose = H2O + UDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-glucose.

label: tagatose-6-phosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-tagatose 6-phosphate = ADP + D-tagatose 1,6-bisphosphate.

label: putrescine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + O2 + putrescine = 4-aminobutanal + H2O2 + NH4+.

label: ganglioside GM3 binding
definition: Binding to ganglioside GM3.

label: protein histidine pros-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein L-histidine = ADP + protein N(pi)-phospho-L-histidine.

label: galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a galactosyl group to an acceptor molecule, typically another carbohydrate or a lipid.

label: guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + guanidinoacetate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + creatine + H+.

label: deoxyribonuclease (pyrimidine dimer) activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage near pyrimidine dimers to products with 5'-phosphate.

label: type 3 metabotropic glutamate receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 3 metabotropic glutamate receptor.

label: 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4-hydroxyphenyl)acetaldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + 2 H+ + NADH.

label: GPI mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichol-P-mannose to GlcN-acyl-PI bearing 0-3 mannoses during formation of the GPI precursor.

label: psychosine sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + galactosylsphingosine = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + psychosine sulfate.

label: ABC-type ferric-enterobactin transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + ferric-enterobactin(out) = ADP + phosphate + ferric-enterobactin(in).

label: polypeptide conformation or assembly isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of a reaction that alters the conformation or assembly of a polypeptide.

label: carbon dioxide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of carbon dioxide (CO2) from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: dethiobiotin binding
definition: Binding to dethiobiotin.

label: snRNA pseudouridine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: uridine in snRNA = pseudouridine in snRNA. Conversion of uridine in an snRNA molecule to pseudouridine by rotation of the C1'-N-1 glycosidic bond of uridine in RNA to a C1'-C5.

label: 2-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone reductase (NADH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone + 2 H+ + NADH = benzene-1,2,4-triol + NAD+.

label: phenylacetone monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + O2 + phenylacetone = benzyl acetate + H2O + NADP+.

label: dipeptide uniporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the transport of a dipeptide across a membrane; transport is independent of the movement of any other molecular species.

label: tetrapyrrole binding
definition: Binding to a tetrapyrrole, a compound containing four pyrrole nuclei variously substituted and linked to each other through carbons at the alpha position.

label: chemokine (C-C motif) ligand 5 binding
definition: Binding to chemokine (C-C motif) ligand 5.

label: ATPase-coupled antimonite transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + antimonite(in) = ADP + phosphate + antimonite(out).

label: galactosylxylosylprotein 3-beta-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-beta-D-galactosyl-O-beta-D-xylosylprotein + UDP-galactose = 3-beta-D-galactosyl-4-beta-D-galactosyl-O-beta-D-xylosylprotein + UDP.

label: (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate + acceptor = 2-oxoglutarate + reduced acceptor.

label: 2-alkenal reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: n-alkanal + NADP+ = alk-2-enal + NADPH + H+.

label: 9,12-octadecadienoate 8-hydroperoxide 8S-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (8R,9Z,12Z)-8-hydroperoxyoctadeca-9,12-dienoate = (7S,8S,9Z,12Z)-7,8-dihydroxyoctadeca-9,12-dienoate.

label: L-phenylalanine N-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + 2 NADPH + 2 O2 + 2 H+ = (E)-phenylacetaldehyde oxime + 2 NADP + 3 H2O + carbon dioxide.

label: calmodulin-activated 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin.

label: CD27 receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CD27, a receptor found on the surface of T cells and some B cells and NK cells.

label: histidine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidine = urocanate + NH3.

label: kynurenate-7,8-dihydrodiol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydro-7,8-dihydroxykynurenate + NAD+ = 7,8-dihydroxykynurenate + H+ + NADH.

label: cyclohexanone monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexanone + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 6-hexanolide + NADP+ + H2O.

label: cullin family protein binding
definition: Binding to a member of the cullin family, hydrophobic proteins that act as scaffolds for ubiquitin ligases (E3).

label: 2-oxo-hept-3-ene-1,7-dioate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2-oxohept-3-ene-1,7-dioate + H2O = 2,4-dihydroxy-hept-trans-2-ene-1,7-dioate.

label: 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-(D-ribitylimino)-5,6-dihydrouracil + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5'-deoxyadenosine + 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin + H+ + L-methionine + NH4+.

label: inositol 3-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + myo-inositol = 1D-3-O-methyl-myo-inositol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: cyanidin 3-O-glucoside 5-O-glucosyltransferase (acyl-glucose) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyanidin 3-O-beta-D-glucoside betaine + 1-O-feruloyl-beta-D-glucose = cyanin betaine + ferulate + H+.

label: histone H4K20me2 reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H4 dimethylated at lysine 20.

label: L-seryl-tRNA(Thr) hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of misacylated Ser-tRNA(Thr).

label: orexin receptor activity
definition: Combining with orexin to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: D-lactate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + A = AH(2) + pyruvate.

label: L-kynurenine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-kynurenine from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: (S)-nandinine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-scoulerine + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = (S)-nandinine + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 H2O + H+.

label: rhamnose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: rhamnose(out) + H+(out) = rhamnose(in) + H+(in).

label: indole-3-acetaldehyde reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-ethanol + NADP+ = (indol-3-yl)acetaldehyde + H+ + NADPH.

label: trichothecene 3-O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the 3-O-acetylation of a trichothecene. Trichothecenes are sesquiterpene epoxide mycotoxins that act as potent inhibitors of eukaryotic protein synthesis.

label: signaling receptor activator activity
definition: The function of interacting (directly or indirectly) with receptors such that the proportion of receptors in the active form is increased.

label: succinylglutamate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-succinyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + H2O + NAD+ = N-succinyl-L-glutamate + 2 H+ + NADH.

label: chlordecone reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chlordecone alcohol + NADP+ = chlordecone + H+ + NADPH.

label: pentraxin receptor activity
definition: Combining with a pentraxin and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: primary methylamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a primary methyl amine + H2O + O2 = an aldehyde + H2O2 + NH4+.

label: putrescine--2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: putrescine + 2-oxoglutarate = L-glutamate + 1-pyrroline + H2O. The enzymatic part of the reaction produces 4-aminobutanal that spontaneously cyclizes to form 1-pyrroline.

label: silver ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of silver (Ag+) ions from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: cobalt-precorrin-5B C1-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 5B + S-adenosylmethionine = S-adenosylhomocysteine + cobalt-precorrin 6A.

label: DNA end binding
definition: Binding to DNA ends exposed by the creation of double-strand breaks (DSBs).

label: pyrogallol hydroxytransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene + 1,2,3-trihydroxybenzene = 1,3,5-trihydroxybenzene + 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene.

label: dCMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + dCMP = ADP + dCDP.

label: dopamine neurotransmitter receptor activity
definition: Combining with the neurotransmitter dopamine to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: phenylalanine 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = L-tyrosine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin.

label: aldose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aldose 1-phosphate + ADP = phosphate + ADP-aldose.

label: xanthosine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of xanthosine, xanthine riboside, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: digestive hormone activity
definition: The action characteristic of a hormone that takes part in the digestion process.

label: benzoin aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoin = 2 benzaldehyde.

label: small RNA binding translational repressor activity
definition: A translational repressor activity that binds to a single-stranded small regulatory RNA (either a miRNA or a siRNA) to guide it to its target mRNA.

label: dibenzofuran 4,4a-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzofuran + NADH + H+ + O2 = 2,2',3-trihydroxybiphenyl + NAD+.

label: acylpyruvate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-acylpyruvate + H2O = a carboxylate + pyruvate.

label: phosphatidylinositol deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + H2O = 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol + a carboxylate + H+.

label: alpha-1B adrenergic receptor binding
definition: Binding to an alpha-1B adrenergic receptor.

label: nucleoside:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: nucleoside(out) + Na+(out) = nucleoside(in) + Na+(in).

label: cellodextrin binding
definition: Binding to a cellodextrin, a glucose polymer of 2 or more glucose monomers.

label: raffinose:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: raffinose(out) + H+(out) = raffinose(in) + H+(in).

label: GUA codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a GUA codon.

label: lactosylceramide 4-alpha-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-D-glucosylceramide + UDP-galactose = alpha-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-D-glucosylceramide + UDP.

label: P2Y9 nucleotide receptor binding
definition: Binding to a P2Y9 nucleotide receptor.

label: phosphatidylglycerol-prolipoprotein diacylglyceryl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of the diacylglyceryl group from phosphatidylglycerol to the sulfhydryl group of the prospective N-terminal cysteine residue in an unmodified prolipoprotein.

label: prostaglandin F synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + prostaglandin F2alpha = H+ + NADPH + prostaglandin D2.

label: apelin receptor binding
definition: Binding to an apelin receptor.

label: 1-phosphatidylinositol-5-phosphate 4-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bisphosphate + ADP + H+.

label: glutamate-gated receptor activity
definition: Catalysis of the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when glutamate has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: high-affinity copper ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a copper ions (Cu2+) from one side of a membrane to the other. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.

label: acetate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of acetate from one side of a membrane to the other. Acetate is the 2-carbon carboxylic acid ethanoic acid.

label: myosin VI heavy chain binding
definition: Binding to a heavy chain of a myosin VI complex.

label: NAD+-histone H2BS6 serine ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of ADP-ribose groups to the serine-6 or an equivalent residue of the N-terminal tail of histone H2B.

label: ubiquitin-like protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin-like from one protein to another via the reaction X-ULP + Y = Y-ULP + X, where both X-ULP and Y-ULP are covalent linkages. ULP represents a ubiquitin-like protein.

label: protein-glutamine gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutaminyl-[protein] + L-lysyl-[protein] = [protein]-L-lysyl-N(6)-5-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4+. This reaction is the formation of the N6-(L-isoglutamyl)-L-lysine isopeptide, resulting in cross-linking polypeptide chains; the gamma-carboxamide groups of peptidyl-glutamine residues act as acyl donors, and the 6-amino-groups of peptidyl-lysine residues act as acceptors, to give intra- and intermolecular N6-(5-glutamyl)lysine cross-links.

label: ecdysteroid 25-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydroxylation of an ecdysteroid at carbon position 25.

label: IMP binding
definition: Binding to IMP, inosine monophosphate.

label: methylated-DNA-[protein]-cysteine S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA (containing 6-O-methylguanine) + (protein)-L-cysteine = DNA (without 6-O-methylguanine) + protein S-methyl-L-cysteine.

label: amino-acid dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-alpha-amino acid +NAD(P)+ + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NH4+ + NAD(P)H + H+.

label: aminobutyraldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobutanal + NAD+ + H2O = 4-aminobutanoate + NADH + 2 H+.

label: L-lysine efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-lysine from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane.

label: RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain S5 O-GlcNAc transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (YSPTSPS) = UDP + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat 3-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-serine (position 5).

label: RNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages immediately 5' to an apurinic/apyrimidinic (AP; also called abasic) site within a ribonucleic acid molecule by creating internal breaks, generating a single-strand break with 5'-ribose phosphate and 3'-hydroxyl ends.

label: P2Y5 nucleotide receptor binding
definition: Binding to a P2Y5 nucleotide receptor.

label: protein-cysteine S-oleoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an oleoyl (systematic name, (9Z)-octadecenoyl) group to a sulfur atom on the cysteine of a protein molecule, in the reaction: (9Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA + L-cysteinyl-[protein] = CoA + S-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-L-cysteinyl-[protein].

label: CAP-Gly domain binding
definition: Binding to a CAP-Gly domain of a protein. The CAP_Gly domain is a conserved, glycine-rich domain of about 42 residues found in some cytoskeleton-associated proteins, and features a novel protein fold containing three beta-sheets.

label: 3-aminobutyryl-CoA ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-aminobutanoyl-CoA = crotonoyl-CoA + NH4.

label: phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding
definition: Binding to phosphatidylinositol phosphate.

label: galactolipid galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 mono-beta-D-galactosyldiacylglycerol = alpha-D-galactosyl-beta-D-galactosyldiacylglycerol + 1,2-diacylglycerol.

label: ADP transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of ADP, adenosine diphosphate, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: histone H2AK9 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H2A L-lysine (position 9) = CoA + histone H2A N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 9).

label: dolichyl-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dolichyl phosphate + H2O = dolichol + phosphate.

label: cytosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytosine + H2O = uracil + NH3.

label: 3'-5'-DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 3' terminus of a DNA molecule.

label: 6-amino-6-deoxyfutalosine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aminodeoxyfutalosinate + H2O = dehypoxanthine futalosine + adenine.

label: 4-deoxy-L-threo-5-hexosulose-uronate ketol-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronate = 3-deoxy-D-glycero-2,5-hexodiulosonate.

label: tricyclene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate(3-) = tricyclene + diphosphoric acid.

label: alpha-1,3-mannosylglycoprotein 4-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + (N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3-(beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6)-beta-D-mannosyl-R = UDP + N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,4-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1,2)-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,3-(beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1,2-alpha-D-mannosyl-1,6)-beta-D-mannosyl-R.

label: phthalate 4,5-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + phthalate = cis-4,5-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,6-diene-1,2-dicarboxylate + NAD+.

label: L-cysteine transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + 2-oxoglutarate = mercaptopyruvate + L-glutamate.

label: ionotropic salty taste receptor activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when a soluble salty compound has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the joining of two molecules, or two groups within a single molecule, using the energy from the hydrolysis of ATP, a similar triphosphate, or a pH gradient.

label: prostaglandin binding
definition: Binding to prostaglandin.

label: high molecular weight B cell growth factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with a high molecular weight B cell growth factor and transmitting the signal to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: ubiquitin ligase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a ubiquitin ligase.

label: 7-deoxyloganetic acid glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-alpha-D-glucose + 7-deoxyloganetate = H+ + 7-deoxyloganate + UDP.

label: ATPase-coupled phosphate ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + phosphate(out) = ADP + phosphate + phosphate(in).

label: 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate = 5-carboxy-2-oxohept-3-enedioate.

label: DNA polymerase binding
definition: Binding to a DNA polymerase.

label: single-stranded RNA binding
definition: Binding to single-stranded RNA.

label: type 2A serotonin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 2A serotonin receptor.

label: sinapine esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-sinapoylcholine + H2O = choline + H+ + sinapate.

label: 17-O-deacetylvindoline O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1R,9R,10S,11R,12R,19R)-12-ethyl-10,11-dihydroxy-5-methoxy-10-(methoxycarbonyl)-8-methyl-8,16-diazapentacyclo[10.6.1.0^{1,9}.0^{2,7}.0^{16,19}]nonadeca-2(7),3,5,13-tetraen-16-ium + acetyl-CoA = (1R,9R,10S,11R,12R,19R)-11-(acetyloxy)-12-ethyl-10-hydroxy-5-methoxy-10-(methoxycarbonyl)-8-methyl-8,16-diazapentacyclo[10.6.1.0^{1,9}.0^{2,7}.0^{16,19}]nonadeca-2(7),3,5,13-tetraen-16-ium + CoA.

label: CNBH domain intrinsic ligand binding
definition: Interacting selectivity and noncovalently with a cyclic nucleotide mimicking protein motif that is part of the same protein. The CNBHD is a domain on KCNH channels that creates a binding pocket on the KCNH channel that resembles the cyclic nucleotide- binding domain on other ion channels. It binds to a peptide motif that is part of the same protein rather than a cyclic nucleotide.

label: 6-methylthiopropyl glucosinolate S-oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-methylthiopropyl-glucosinolate = 6-methylsulfinylpropyl-glucosinolate.

label: (S)-usnate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6R)-2-acetyl-6-(3-acetyl-2,4,6-trihydroxy-5-methylphenyl)-3-hydroxy-6-methylcyclohexa-2,4-dien-1-one + NAD+ = (S)-usnate + 2 H+ + NADH.

label: spindle pole body-nuclear membrane anchor activity
definition: The binding activity of a molecule that brings together a mitotic spindle pole body and the nuclear membrane, in order to maintain specific membrane location of the spindle pole body.

label: lysine:cadaverine antiporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lysine(out) + cadaverine(in) = lysine(in) + cadaverine(out).

label: allantoin:proton symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: allantoin(out) + H+(out) = allantoin(in) + H+(in) by secondary active transport.

label: adenine nucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of adenine nucleotides (AMP, ADP, and ATP) from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: 2-octaprenyl-6-methoxyphenol hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-octaprenyl)phenol + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 2-methoxy-6-all-trans-octaprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol + H2O + NADP+.

label: calcitonin family receptor activity
definition: Combining with any member of the calcitonin family (e.g. adrenomedullin, adrenomedullin 2 (intermedin), amylin, calcitonin and calcitonin gene-related peptides (CGRPs)) to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: histone H1-4S187 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H1-4-serine (position 27) + ATP = histone H1-4-phosphoserine (position 27) + ADP.

label: glutathionylspermidine amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N1-(gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-glycyl)-spermidine + H2O = gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteinyl-glycine + spermidine.

label: phosphoethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + ethanolamine phosphate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + N-methylethanolamine phosphate.

label: pterin-4alpha-carbinolamine dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 10-formyltetrahydrofolate-4a-carbinolamine = H2O + a 10-formyldihydrofolate.

label: tRNA nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tRNA(n+1) + phosphate = tRNA(n) + a nucleoside diphosphate.

label: UDP-galactose-UDP-N-acetylglucosamine galactose phosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + UDP-D-galactose = H+ + UDP-N-acetyl-6-(D-galactose-1-phospho)-D-glucosamine + UMP.

label: inositol-1,3,4,6-tetrakisphosphate 6-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: inositol-1,3,4,6-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = inositol-1,3,4-trisphosphate + phosphate.

label: single-subunit type RNA polymerase binding
definition: Binding to a single subunit RNA polymerase enzyme, which is composed of a single catalytic subunit similar to the RNA polymerase enzymes from phages T3, T7, and SP6.

label: squalene synthase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + H+ + NAD(P)H = 2 diphosphate + NAD(P)+ + squalene.

label: CCR11 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a CCR11 chemokine receptor.

label: arachidonate epoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of an NADPH- and oxygen-dependent reaction that converts arachidonic acid to a cis-epoxyeicosatrienoic acid.

label: adenosylselenohomocysteinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Se-Adenosyl-L-selenohomocysteine + H2O = Adenosine + Selenohomocysteine.

label: phenanthrol glycosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrol + glucose = phenanthryl-beta-D-glucopyranoside + H2O.

label: receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase.

label: calcium-induced calcium release activity
definition: Enables transmembrane transfer of calcium ions from an intracellular store to the cytosol on induction by increased calcium concentration.

label: S-nitrosoglutathione binding
definition: Binding to S-nitrosoglutathione, a nitrosothiol considered to be a natural nitric oxide (NO) donor involved in S-nitrosylation, and in the storage and transport of nitric oxide in biological systems.

label: violaxanthin de-epoxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: violaxanthin + 2 ascorbate = zeaxanthin + 2 dehydroascorbate + 2 H2O; and antheraxanthin + ascorbate = zeaxanthin + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

label: indole-3-butyrate beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-butyrate + UDP-D-glucose = indole-3-butyryl-beta-1-D-glucose + UDP.

label: phenylalkylamine binding
definition: Binding to phenylalkylamine or one of its derivatives.

label: lactoyl-CoA dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactoyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

label: L-phenylalanine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-phenylalanine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-phenylalanine is 2-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid.

label: dimethylglycine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N-dimethylglycine + electron-transfer flavoprotein + H2O = sarcosine + formaldehyde + reduced electron-transfer flavoprotein.

label: structural constituent of cutaneous appendage
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of cutaneous epidermal structures such as hairs, scales, or feathers.

label: glycine betaine-activated nonselective monoatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a monoatomic cation by a channel that opens when glycine betaine has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: tau-protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + tau-protein = ADP + O-phospho-tau-protein on serine and threonine residues.

label: peptide dopaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dopamine + L-glutaminyl-[protein] = 5-dopaminyl-L-glutamyl-[protein] + NH4(+).

label: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate = pyruvate + D-glyceraldehyde.

label: interleukin-20 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-20.

label: sinapate 1-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + sinapate = UDP + 1-sinapoyl-D-glucose.

label: 3-hydroxypimeloyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypimelyl-CoA + NAD+ = 3-oxopimelyl-CoA + H+ + NADH.

label: growth hormone-releasing hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a growth hormone-releasing hormone receptor.

label: metal ion sequestering activity
definition: Binding to a metal ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active.

label: cyclohexa-1,5-dienecarbonyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA + H2O = 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-enecarbonyl-CoA.

label: sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding
definition: Binding to double-stranded DNA of a specific nucleotide composition, e.g. GC-rich DNA binding, or with a specific sequence motif or type of DNA, e.g. promotor binding or rDNA binding.

label: succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + succinate + CoA = ADP + succinyl-CoA + phosphate.

label: cholesterol 7-desaturase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + H+ + NAD(P)H + O2 = 7-dehydrocholesterol + 2 H2O + NAD(P)+.

label: muramyl dipeptide binding
definition: Interacting selectively and non-covalently, in a non-covalent manner, with muramyl dipeptide; muramyl dipeptide is derived from peptidoglycan.

label: isopentenyl-diphosphate delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isopentenyl diphosphate = dimethylallyl diphosphate.

label: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile 4-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile + NADPH +O2=4-hydroxyindole-3- carbonyl nitrile + NADP+ + H20.

label: corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor activity
definition: Combining with corticotropin-releasing hormone and transmitting the signal to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: coenzyme F420-2 alpha-glutamyl ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coenzyme F420-2 + L-glutamate + GTP = coenzyme F420-3 + GDP + orthophosphate.

label: trans-epoxysuccinate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-2,3-epoxysuccinate + H2O = (2R,3S)-tartrate.

label: ammonia monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + NH4+ + O2 = A + H+ + H2O + hydroxylamine.

label: cholesterol 25-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + cholesterol + O2 = 25-hydroxycholesterol + A + H2O.

label: tetrahydroxypteridine cycloisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tetrahydroxypteridine = H+ + xanthine-8-carboxylate.

label: unfolded protein binding
definition: Binding to an unfolded protein.

label: orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + orotidine 5'-phosphate = CO2 + UMP.

label: rRNA (cytosine-2'-O-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + rRNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + rRNA containing 2'-O-methylcytosine.

label: molecular function inhibitor activity
definition: A molecular function regulator that inhibits or decreases the activity of its target via non-covalent binding that does not result in covalent modification to the target.

label: glyoxylate dehydrogenase (acylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CoA + glyoxylate + NADP+ = H+ + NADPH + oxalyl-CoA.

label: phenol O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phenol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + anisole + H+.

label: protein N-terminal-serine acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + N-terminal L-seryl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal Nalpha-acetyl-L-seryl-[protein].

label: minus-end directed microfilament motor activity
definition: A motor activity that generates movement along a microfilament towards the minus end, driven by ATP hydrolysis. The minus end of an actin filament is the end that does not preferentially add actin monomers.

label: neurexin family protein binding
definition: Binding to a neurexin, a synaptic cell surface protein related to latrotoxin receptor, laminin and agrin. Neurexins act as cell recognition molecules at nerve terminals.

label: tumor necrosis factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to a tumor necrosis factor receptor.

label: 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate 4-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,4-bisphosphate + ADP + H+.

label: XCR1 chemokine receptor binding
definition: Binding to a XCR1 chemokine receptor.

label: N-acylneuraminate-9-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acylneuraminate 9-phosphate + H2O = N-acylneuraminate + phosphate.

label: tyrosine sensor activity
definition: Binding to and responding, e.g. by conformational change, to changes in the cellular level of tyrosine.

label: G protein-coupled estrogen receptor activity
definition: Combining with estrogen and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

label: berbamunine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-N-methylcoclaurine + (R)-N-methylcoclaurine + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = berbamunine + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 H2O.

label: ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity, thioredoxin disulfide as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyribonucleoside diphosphate + thioredoxin disulfide + H2O = ribonucleoside diphosphate + thioredoxin. Thioredoxin disulfide is the oxidized form of thioredoxin.

label: kininogen binding
definition: Binding to a kininogen, a kinin precursor.

label: L-aspartate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-aspartate from one side of a membrane to the other. L-aspartate is the anion derived from aspartic acid.

label: sphingolipid 8-(E/Z)-desaturase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acyl-(4R)-4-hydroxysphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = a (4R,8E)-4-hydroxysphingenine ceramide + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O or an N-acyl-(4R)-4-hydroxysphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = (4R,8Z)-4-hydroxysphing-8-enine ceramide + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O. This results in the formation of a double bond between C8 and C9 of the long chain base of a sphingolipid.

label: histone H2AT120pho reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H2A phosphorylated at threonine 120.

label: hydroxyacylglutathione hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an S-(2-hydroxyacyl)glutathione + H2O = a 2-hydroxy carboxylate + glutathione + H+.

label: formylglycine-generating oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A [sulfatase]-L-cysteine + O2 + 2 a thiol = a [sulfatase]-3-oxo-L-alanine + hydrogen sulfide + a disulfide + H2O.

label: phosphotransferase activity, phosphate group as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphorus-containing group from one compound (donor) to a phosphate group (acceptor).

label: patched binding
definition: Binding to a patched (ptc) protein, a receptor for hedgehog proteins.

label: lipoprotein lipase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a lipoprotein lipase, an enzyme that catalyzes of the hydrolysis of a lipid within a lipoprotein.

label: flavone 3'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3'-hydroxyflavone + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 3'-methoxyflavone + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: guanidinoacetate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + guanidinoacetate = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphoguanidinoacetate.

label: malate:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: malate(out) + Na+(out) = malate(in) + Na+(in).

label: AAC codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes an AAC codon.

label: histone H2AK13 ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a ubiquitin molecule to histone 2A at the lysine-13 residue.

label: L-lysine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-lysine from one side of a membrane to the other. L-lysine is 2,6-diaminohexanoic acid.

label: beta3-adrenergic receptor activity
definition: Combining with epinephrine or norepinephrine to initiate a change in cell activity via activation of a G protein, with pharmacological characteristics of beta3-adrenergic receptors.

label: LPPG:FO 2-phospho-L-lactate transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin + lactyl-2-diphospho-5'-guanosine = coenzyme F420-0 + GMP.

label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-maltose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + maltose(out) = protein histidine + maltose phosphate(in). This differs from primary and secondary active transport in that the solute is modified during transport.

label: endogenous lipid antigen binding
definition: Binding to an endogenous cellular lipid antigen.

label: epidermal growth factor receptor binding
definition: Binding to an epidermal growth factor receptor.

label: interleukin-1 receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-1 receptor.

label: flavonol-3-O-glucoside L-rhamnosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: flavonol 3-O-D-glucoside + UDP-L-rhamnose = flavonol 3-O-L-rhamnosylglucoside + UDP.

label: vitamin D 23-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydroxylation of C-23 of any form of vitamin D.

label: delta(3,5)-delta(2,4)-dienoyl-CoA isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (3E,5Z)-dienoyl-CoA = a (2E,4E)-(5,6-saturated)-dienoyl-CoA.

label: DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific
definition: A DNA-binding transcription factor activity that modulates the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

label: benzoate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of benzoate, the anion of benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid) from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: MDA-5 binding
definition: Binding to MDA-5, a cytoplasmic pattern recognition receptor that initiates an antiviral signaling pathway upon binding to viral dsRNA.

label: tetrapeptide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of tetrapeptide from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: ATPase-coupled ectoine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + ectoine(out/in) = ADP + phosphate + ectoine(in/out).

label: adenylate cyclase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of adenylate cyclase.

label: light-driven active monoatomic ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Active transport of an ion across a membrane, driven by light.

label: loganate O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + loganate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + loganin.

label: protein serine pyrophosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein phospho-serine + inositol 5-triphosphate pentakisphosphate = protein diphospho-serine + inositol 5-diphosphate pentakisphosphate.

label: voltage-gated sodium channel activity involved in Purkinje myocyte action potential
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of a Purkinje myocyte contributing to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: histone H3K14 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 14) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 14).

label: voltage-gated sodium channel activity involved in AV node cell action potential
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of an AV node cardiac muscle cell contributing to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: phosphomethylpyrimidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4-amino-2-methyl-5-(phosphooxymethyl)pyrimidine + CO + 5'-deoxyadenosine + formate + L-methionine + 3 H+.

label: monoamine:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(out) + monoamine(in) = H+(in) + monoamine(out).

label: daphnetin-8-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydroxycoumarin + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 7-hydroxy-8-methoxycoumarin + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: sulfur oxygenase/reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 sulfur + 4 H2O + O2 = 2 hydrogen sulfide + 2 bisulfite + 2 H+.

label: histone H2B kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group to a histone H2B.

label: arginine 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + O2 = 4-guanidinobutanamide + CO2 + H2O.

label: pre-mRNA 3'-splice site binding
definition: Binding to a pre-mRNA 3' splice site sequence.

label: serine-type aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single N-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine).

label: carbohydrate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of carbohydrate from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: 4-methyleneglutamate-ammonia ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-methylene-L-glutamate + ATP + NH4 = 4-methylene-L-glutamine + AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+.

label: tripeptide aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single N-terminal amino acid residue from a tripeptide.

label: salicyl-alcohol beta-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: salicyl alcohol + UDP-D-glucose = H+ + salicin + UDP.

label: histone H4K12 deacetylase activity, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12) + H2O = histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) + acetate. This reaction represents the removal of an acetyl group from lysine at position 12 of the histone H4 protein.

label: deoxyribonucleoside binding
definition: Binding to a deoxyribonucleoside, a compound consisting of a purine or pyrimidine nitrogenous base linked to deoxyribose.

label: cysteamine dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cysteamine + O2 = H+ + hypotaurine.

label: D-glucose binding
definition: Binding to D-enantiomers of glucose.

label: mechanosensitive monoatomic ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an monoatomic ion by a channel that opens in response to a mechanical stress.

label: UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-mannosamine + 2 NAD+ + H2O = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-mannosaminuronate + 2 NADH + 2 H+.

label: lipopolysaccharide 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + lipopolysaccharide = UDP + 1,3 alpha-D-galactosyl-lipopolysaccharide.

label: phosphatidylinositol lysophospholipase A1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol) + H2O = sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol + a fatty acid + H+.

label: ethylene binding
definition: Binding to ethylene (C2-H4, ethene), a simple hydrocarbon gas that can function in plants as a growth regulator.

label: coenzyme F420 binding
definition: Binding to F420, the coenzyme or the prosthetic group of various flavoprotein oxidoreductase enzymes.

label: trimethylamine-oxide aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + trimethylamine N-oxide = dimethylamine + formaldehyde.

label: alpha-(1->3)-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an L-fucosyl group from GDP-beta-L-fucose to an acceptor molecule to form an alpha-(1->3) linkage.

label: anaphase-promoting complex binding
definition: Binding to an anaphase-promoting complex. A ubiquitin ligase complex that degrades mitotic cyclins and anaphase inhibitory protein, thereby triggering sister chromatid separation and exit from mitosis.

label: repressor of RNA polymerase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of an RNA polymerase inhibitor.

label: disordered domain specific binding
definition: Binding to a disordered domain of a protein.

label: dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the incorporation of both atoms of molecular oxygen (O2) into the substrate.

label: glutathione dehydrogenase (ascorbate) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dehydroascorbate + 2 glutathione = L-ascorbate + glutathione disulfide.

label: dGDP binding
definition: Binding to dGDP, deoxyguanosine diphosphate.

label: 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+.

label: zinc ion sequestering activity
definition: Binding to a zinc ion to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active.

label: N-acetylgalactosaminoglycan deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N-acetyl-D-galactosaminoglycan = acetate + D-galactosaminoglycan.

label: gibberellin carboxyl-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a gibberellin = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a gibberellin methyl ester.

label: macromolecule transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a macromolecule from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: AMP-thymidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + thymidine = adenosine + thymidine 5'-phosphate.

label: pyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + pyruvate = ADP + 2 H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate.

label: purine-specific nucleoside:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: purine(out) + Na+(out) = nucleoside(in) + Na+(in).

label: N-succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a succinyl group to a nitrogen atom on the acceptor molecule.

label: cysteine-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which the sulfhydryl group of a cysteine residue at the active center acts as a nucleophile.

label: RAGE receptor binding
definition: Binding to a RAGE receptor, the receptor for advanced glycation end-products.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-CH group of donors, iron-sulfur protein as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH-CH group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces an iron-sulfur protein.

label: poly-glutamine tract binding
definition: Binding to a polyglutamine tract, i.e. a series of consecutive glutamine residues, in a protein.

label: competence pheromone activity
definition: A small peptide excreted by a naturally transformable bacterium (e.g. Bacillus subtilis) that transmits a signal required for the establishment of competence.

label: geranyl-diphosphate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranyl diphosphate = (2S)-bornyl diphosphate.

label: galactose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: galactose(out) + Na+(out) = glucose(in) + Na+(in).

label: gamma-glutamyl-gamma-aminobutyrate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(L-gamma-glutamylamino)butanoate + H2O = 4-aminobutanoate + L-glutamate.

label: lipoprotein lipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: triacylglycerol + H2O = diacylglycerol + a carboxylate, where the triacylglycerol is part of a lipoprotein. May also hydrolyze diacylglycerol and phospholipids present in lipoproteins.

label: phosphoribosyl 1,2-cyclic phosphate phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-ribose 1,2-cyclic phosphate 5-phosphate + H2O = alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate + H+.

label: 2-hydroxymuconate-semialdehyde hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate + H2O = 2-oxopent-4-enoate + formate + H+.

label: UAG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a UAG codon.

label: ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of 2'-deoxyribonucleoside diphosphate from ribonucleoside diphosphate, using either thioredoxin disulfide or glutaredoxin disulfide as an acceptor.

label: neutral amino acid, sodium:proton antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: H+(in) + amino acid(out) + Na+(out) = H+(out) + amino acid(in) + Na+(in).

label: double-stranded DNA exodeoxyribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a double-stranded DNA molecule.

label: intracellularly phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate-gated monatomic cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of cations by a channel that opens when phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: XTP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: XTP + H2O = XMP + H+ + diphosphate.

label: N-acetylcitrulline deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-L-citrulline + H2O = citrulline + acetate.

label: O-malonyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a malonyl group to an oxygen atom on the acceptor molecule.

label: D-pinitol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5D-5-O-methyl-chiro-inositol + NADP+ = 2D-5-O-methyl-2,3,5/4,6-pentahydroxycyclohexanone + H+ + NADPH.

label: 5-aminolevulinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycine + H+ + succinyl-CoA = 5-aminolevulinate + CO2 + CoA.

label: SH2 domain binding
definition: Binding to a SH2 domain (Src homology 2) of a protein, a protein domain of about 100 amino-acid residues and belonging to the alpha + beta domain class.

label: mechanosensitive voltage-gated sodium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel whose activity is modulated in response to mechanical stress. Response to mechanical stress and voltage gating together is different than the sum of individual responses. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: prostaglandin E2 9-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,13E)-(15S)-9-alpha,11-alpha,15-trihydroxyprosta-5,13-dienoate + NADP+ = (5Z,13E)-(15S)-11-alpha,15-dihydroxy-9-oxoprosta-5,13-dienoate + NADPH.

label: alpha-1,6-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a mannose residue to an oligosaccharide, forming an alpha-(1->6) linkage.

label: taurine binding
definition: Binding to taurine.

label: D-alanine [D-alanyl carrier protein] ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the ATP-dependent activation of D-alanine and its transfer as a thiol ester to the phosphopantheinyl prosthetic group of a D-alanyl carrier protein, according to the reaction: ATP + D-alanine + a [D-alaninyl carrier protein] = a D-alanyl-[D-alanyl carrier protein] + AMP + diphosphate.

label: mycophenolic acid acyl-glucuronide esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: mycophenolic acid O-acyl-glucuronide(1-) + H2O = mycophenolate + H+ + D-glucopyranuronate.

label: growth hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a growth hormone receptor.

label: ATPase-coupled monoatomic cation transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + cation(out) = ADP + phosphate + cation(in).

label: 3-hydroxybenzoate 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxybenzoate + AH(2) + O2 = 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + A + H2O.

label: cholesterol-protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cholesterol + glycyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein] + H+ = [protein]-C-terminal glycyl cholesterol ester + N-terminal L-cysteinyl-[protein].

label: histamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + histamine = N(tau)-methylhistamine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: homomethionine N-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an L-polyhomomethionine + 2 O2 + 2 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an (E)-omega-(methylsulfanyl)-alkanal oxime + CO2 + 2 H(+) + 3 H2O + 2 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

label: gamma-glutamyl-peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of a gamma-linked glutamate bond.

label: HNK-1 sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the synthesis of the HKK-1 carbohydrate epitope; adds a sulfate group to a precursor, GlcA-beta-(1->3)-Gal-beta-(1->4)-GlcNAc-beta-(1->R), forming sulfo-3GlcA-beta-(1->3)-Gal-beta-(1->4)-GlcNAc-beta-(1->R).

label: 4-aminobutyrate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
