To be a substrate, the first residue must be unsubstituted, the second residue may bear a xylosyl group, whether further glycosylated or not, and the third residue, which becomes the new terminus by the action of the enzyme, is preferably xylosylated, but this xylose residue must not be further substituted.

label: netrin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a netrin receptor.

label: HLA-A specific inhibitory MHC class I receptor activity
definition: Combining with a MHC class I molecule of the HLA-A subclass to mediate signaling that inhibits activation of a lymphocyte.

label: sinapoylglucose-choline O-sinapoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-O-sinapoyl-beta-D-glucose + choline = O-sinapoylcholine + D-glucose.

label: endo-xylogalacturonan hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of xylogalacturonate by cleavage of the alpha-(1,4)-linkage. Xylogalacturonate (XGA) is composed of a chain of alpha-(1,4)-linked D-galacturonic acid residues with beta-D-xylose substituted at the O3 position.

label: structural constituent of chitin-based cuticle
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a chitin-based cuticle. An example of this is found in Drosophila melanogaster.

label: melibiose:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: melibiose(out) + Na+(out) = melibiose(in) + Na+(in).

label: tryptophan 2-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + O2 = CO2 + H2O + indole-3-acetamide.

label: protoporphyrinogen oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protoporphyrinogen IX + acceptor = protoporphyrin IX + reduced acceptor.

label: (S)-citramalyl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3S)-citramalyl-CoA = acetyl-CoA + pyruvate.

label: (R)-2-hydroxyglutarate-pyruvate transhydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-2-hydroxyglutarate + pyruvate = (R)-lactate + 2-oxoglutarate.

label: vitamin D 24-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydroxylation of C-24 of any form of vitamin D.

label: erythronolide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6 malonyl-CoA + propionyl-CoA = 7 CoA + 6-deoxyerythronolide B.

label: cAMP binding
definition: Binding to cAMP, the nucleotide cyclic AMP (adenosine 3',5'-cyclophosphate).

label: deacetyl-[citrate-(pro-3S)-lyase] S-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deacetyl-[citrate-oxaloacetate-lyase ((pro-3S)-CH(2)COO(-)-acetate)] + S-acetylphosphopantetheine = [citrate oxaloacetate-lyase ((pro-3S)-CH(2)COO(-)-acetate)] + pantetheine 4'-phosphate.

label: L-ribulose-5-phosphate 3-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ribulose 5-phosphate = L-xylulose 5-phosphate.

label: bicyclomycin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of bicyclomycin from one side of a membrane to the other. Bicyclomycin (or bicozamycin) is an antibacterial drug often used as a livestock feed additive.

label: CDP-diacylglycerol-serine O-phosphatidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-diacylglycerol + L-serine = CMP + O-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine.

label: TFIIF-class transcription factor complex binding
definition: Binding to a general RNA polymerase II transcription factor belonging to the TFIIF complex, one of the factors involved in formation of the preinitiation complex (PIC) by RNA polymerase II.

label: RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (consensus YSPTSPS) = ADP + H+ + phosphorylated RNA polymerase II.

label: inositol 1,4,5 trisphosphate binding
definition: Binding to inositol 1,4,5 trisphosphate.

label: dihydrolipoamide branched chain acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + 2-methylpropanoyl-CoA = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-2-methylpropanoyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CoA. In addition to transferring the 2-methylpropanoyl group when acting on the oxoacid corresponding with valine, this activity also transfers the 3-methylbutanoyl and S-2-methylbutanoyl groups when acting on the oxo acids corresponding with leucine and isoleucine.

label: bromoxynil nitrilase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzonitrile + 2 H2O = 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoate + NH4. Involved in the bacterial degradation of the herbicide bromoxynil.

label: galactolipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-3-O-(beta-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol + 2 H2O = 3-beta-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol + 2 a fatty acid + 2 H+.

label: apolipoprotein receptor activity
definition: Combining with an apolipoprotein to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: monoacylglycerol lipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a monoacylglycerol + H2O = a fatty acid + glycerol + H+.

label: methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group to an acceptor molecule.

label: netrin receptor activity involved in chemoattraction
definition: Combining with a netrin signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to contribute to the directed movement of a motile cell towards a higher concentration of netrin.

label: intramolecular oxidoreductase activity, transposing C=C bonds
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which the hydrogen donor and acceptor are the same molecule, one or more carbon-carbon double bonds in the molecule are rearranged, and no oxidized product appears.

label: exoxylanase activity
definition: A xylanase activity that acts on one of the ends of a xylan polymer which does not contain side chains.

label: 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA = (R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA.

label: catechin binding
definition: Binding to a catechin, a polyphenolic antioxidant plant metabolite with a flavonoid or flavan-3-ol structure.

label: epoxyqueuosine reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: epoxyqueuosine in tRNA + reductant = queuosine in tRNA + oxidised reductant.

label: histone H3K56 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H3 L-lysine (position 56) = CoA + histone H3 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 56).

label: interleukin-17E receptor binding
definition: Binding to an interleukin-17E receptor.

label: tryptophan-tRNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-tryptophan + tRNA(Trp) = AMP + diphosphate + L-tryptophanyl-tRNA(Trp).

label: RNA polymerase III type 2 promoter sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to a sequence of DNA that is a part of a type 2 promoter that controls transcription by RNA polymerase III. Type 2 promoters consist of an A box and a B box downstream of the transcription start site within the sequence within the sequence of the mature RNA. Type 2 promoters are found in many tRNA genes as well as in other small RNAs.

label: interleukin-8 receptor activity
definition: Combining with interleukin-8 and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: misfolded protein binding
definition: Binding to a misfolded protein.

label: 3-beta-hydroxysteroid 3-dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-betahydroxyl sterol + NADP+ = a 3-oxosterol sterol + NADPH + H+.

label: interleukin-22 binding
definition: Binding to interleukin-22.

label: salutaridine reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (7S)-salutaridinol + NADP+ = H+ + NADPH + salutaridine.

label: protein-N(PI)-phosphohistidine-D-glucosamine phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein N-phosphohistidine + D-glucosamine(out) = protein histidine + glucosamine-6-phosphate(in).

label: toxin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a toxin from one side of a membrane to the other. A toxin is a poisonous compound (typically a protein) that is produced by cells or organisms and that can cause disease when introduced into the body or tissues of an organism.

label: ubiquitin-modified protein reader activity
definition: A molecular adaptor recognizes and binds a target protein containing a ubiquitination modification and brings the target protein into contact with another protein to allow those proteins to function in a coordinated way.

label: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2/guanine(27)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: guanosine(26)/guanosine(27) in tRNA + 4 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 4 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26)/N(2)-dimethylguanosine(27) in tRNA + 4 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: histone H1-4S35 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H1-4-serine (position 35) + ATP = histone H1-4-phosphoserine (position 35) + ADP.

label: ACG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes an ACG codon.

label: endopeptidase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of an endopeptidase.

label: mannosylglycerate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2-O-(alpha-D-mannosyl)-glycerate + H2O = (R)-glycerate + D-mannose.

label: phosphofructokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a phosphofructose substrate molecule.

label: ATPase-coupled 2-aminoethylphosphonate transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of 2-aminoethylphosphonate from one side of a membrane to the other by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + 2-aminoethylphosphonate(out) = ADP + phosphate + 2-aminoethylphosphonate(in).

label: GARP complex binding
definition: Binding to a GARP complex.

label: L-glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + NADP+ + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + NH4+ + NADPH + H+.

label: 5-formyluracil DNA N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the removal of 5-formyluracil bases by cleaving the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the oxidized pyrimidine and the deoxyribose sugar.

label: 2,6-beta-fructan 6-levanbiohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (2->6)-beta-D-fructofuranan, to remove successive disaccharide residues as levanbiose, i.e. 6-(beta-D-fructofuranosyl)-D-fructose, from the end of the chain.

label: SUMO conjugating enzyme activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of SUMO from one protein to another via the reaction X-SUMO + Y = Y-SUMO + X, where both the X-SUMO and Y-SUMO linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal amino acid of SUMO and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue.

label: L-fuculokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-fuculose + ATP = L-fuculose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

label: beta-glucogallin-tetrakisgalloylglucose O-galloyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2,3,6-tetrakis-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose + 1-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose = 1,2,3,4,6-pentakis-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose + D-glucose.

label: phosphatidylcholine-sterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + a sterol = a sterol ester + 1-acylglycerophosphocholine.

label: arachidonate omega-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = 20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid is also known as arachidonic acid is also and 20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate as 20-HETE.

label: 10-oxogeraniol oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (6E)-8-oxogeraniol + NADP = (6E)-8-oxogeranial + NADPH + H+.

label: alanine-glyoxylate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-alanine + glyoxylate = pyruvate + glycine.

label: sevenless binding
definition: Binding to a sevenless (sev) protein, a receptor tyrosine kinase.

label: G protein-coupled nucleotide receptor activity
definition: Combining with a nucleotide and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

label: histone H4 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a histone H4 = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a methylated histone H4. Histone methylation generally occurs on either an arginine or a lysine residue.

label: type 3 melanocortin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 3 melanocortin receptor.

label: nicotianamine aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + nicotianamine = 3''-deamino-3''-oxonicotianamine + L-glutamate.

label: retinol dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + retinol = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + anhydroretinol.

label: histone H3K9me2 methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6,N6-dimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = H+ + N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysyl9-[histone H3] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine. This reaction is the addition of a single methyl group to the dimethylated lysine residue at position 9 of histone H3, producing histone H3K9me3.

label: dihydrosanguinarine 10-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dihydrosanguinarine + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 10-hydroxydihydrosanguinarine + H2O + NADP+.

label: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetoacetyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA + H2O = (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + CoA + H+.

label: secondary active transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute from one side of a membrane to the other, up its concentration gradient. The transporter binds the solute and undergoes a series of conformational changes. Transport works equally well in either direction and is driven by a chemiosmotic source of energy, not direct ATP coupling. Secondary active transporters include symporters and antiporters.

label: L-cysteine binding
definition: Binding to L-cysteine.

label: indole-3-acetonitrile nitrilase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-acetonitrile + 2 H2O = indole-3-acetic acid + NH3.

label: tubulin N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + (alpha-tubulin) L-lysine = CoA + (alpha-tubulin) N6-acetyl-L-lysine. In most organisms it acetylates L-lysine at position 40 of alpha- tubulin.

label: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + H2O = CoA + H+ + methylmalonate.

label: pyridoxine binding
definition: Binding to pyridoxine, 4,5-bis(hydroxymethyl)-2-methylpyridin-3-ol, a form of vitamin B6.

label: NAD+ nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + H2O = ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide + H+.

label: insulin receptor binding
definition: Binding to an insulin receptor.

label: blood-group-substance endo-1,4-beta-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-galactosidic linkages in blood group A and B substances.

label: nitric-oxide synthase binding
definition: Binding to nitric-oxide synthase.

label: phosphatidylserine-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate exchange activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate)(out) + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(in) = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate)(in) + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(out). This reaction results in the exchange of phosphatidylserine (PS) for phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate (PI(4)P) between membranes.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on metal ions, NAD or NADP as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction in which the metal ion is reduced and NAD+ or NADP+ acts as an electron acceptor.

label: gap junction hemi-channel activity
definition: A wide pore channel activity that enables the transport of a solute across a membrane via a gap junction hemi-channel. Two gap junction hemi-channels coupled together form a complete gap junction.

label: kaempferol 4'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + kaempferol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + kaempferide.

label: hydroxylysine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: erythro-5-hydroxy-L-lysine + GTP = 5-phosphonooxy-L-lysine + GDP + 2 H+.

label: adenosylcobyric acid synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 L-glutamine + adenosylcob(III)yrinate a,c-diamide + 4 ATP + 4 H2O = 4 L-glutamate + adenosylcobyrate + 4 ADP + 8 H+ + 4 phosphate.

label: ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity
definition: Isoenergetic transfer of ubiquitin from one protein to an existing ubiquitin chain via the reaction X-ubiquitin + Y-ubiquitin = Y-ubiquitin-ubiquitin + X, where both the X-ubiquitin and Y-ubiquitin-ubiquitin linkages are thioester bonds between the C-terminal glycine of ubiquitin and a sulfhydryl side group of a cysteine residue.

label: glutamate-cysteine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + L-glutamate + ATP = L-gamma-glutamyl-L-cysteine + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

label: Delta14-sterol reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + 4,4-dimethyl-5-alpha-cholesta-8,24-dien-3-beta-ol = NADPH + H+ + 4,4-dimethyl-5-alpha-cholesta-8,14,24-trien-3-beta-ol.

label: ABC-type phosphonate transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + phosphonate(out) = ADP + phosphate + phosphonate(in). A phosphonate is any salt, anion, or ester of phosphonic acid (HPO(OH)2).

label: tubulin-glycine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the posttranslational transfer of one or more glycine residues to a specific glutamate residue on a target tubulin molecule; acts on alpha or beta tubulin.

label: galactoside 2-alpha-L-fucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-L-fucose + beta-D-galactosyl-R = GDP + alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2)-beta-D-galactosyl-R.

label: U12 snRNA binding
definition: Binding to a U12 small nuclear RNA (U12 snRNA).

label: dethiobiotin transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of dethiobiotin from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: phosphomannan mannosephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphomannan(n) + GDP-mannose = phosphomannan(n+1) + GMP.

label: structural constituent of myelin sheath
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of the myelin sheath of a nerve.

label: (R)-4-hydroxyphenyllactate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + (R)-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)lactate = NADPH + H+ + 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate.

label: beta-glucogallin O-galloyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 1-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose = 1,6-bis-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose + D-glucose.

label: dTDP-4-dehydrorhamnose reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-6-deoxy-L-mannose + NADP+ = dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose + H+ + NADPH.

label: antiporter activity
definition: Enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported in opposite directions in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy. The reaction is: solute A(out) + solute B(in) = solute A(in) + solute B(out).

label: fumarylpyruvate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: fumarylpyruvate + H2O = fumarate + pyruvate + H+.

label: deaminase binding
definition: Binding to an enzyme that catalyzes the removal of an amino group from a substrate, producing ammonia (NH3).

label: pyrimidine nucleotide transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a pyrimidine nucleotide, any compound consisting of a pyrimidine nucleoside esterified with (ortho)phosphate, from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: 5'-3' DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' terminus of a DNA molecule.

label: 5'-3' RNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1); the synthesis of RNA from ribonucleotide triphosphates in the presence of a nucleic acid template, via extension of the 3'-end.

label: zinc:bicarbonate:selenite symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: zinc(out) + HCO3-(out) + HO3Se-(out) = zinc(in) + HCO3-(in) + HO3Se-(out).

label: lipoyl(octanoyl) transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + octanoyl-[ACP] = H+ + holo-[ACP] + N6-octanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein].

label: protein-phosphocysteine-mannosylglycerate-phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein S-phosphocysteine + mannosylglycerate(out) = protein cysteine + mannosylglycerate phosphate(in).

label: casbene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = casbene + diphosphate.

label: biuret amidohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biuret + H2O = urea + CO2 + NH3.

label: MAP kinase serine/threonine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: MAP kinase threonine phosphate + H2O = MAP kinase threonine + phosphate and MAP kinase serine phosphate + H2O = MAP kinase serine + phosphate.

label: borate efflux transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of borate from the inside of the cell to the outside of the cell across a membrane.

label: UDP-glucose:4-aminobenzoate acylglucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzoate + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = 1-O-(4-aminobenzoyl)-beta-D-glucose + UDP.

label: 6-hydroxynicotinate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4,5,6-tetrahydro-6-oxonicotinate + oxidized ferredoxin = 6-hydroxynicotinate + reduced ferredoxin.

label: ethanol binding
definition: Binding to ethanol, CH(3)-CH(2)-OH.

label: UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine-4-sulfate sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 4-sulfate = adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + H+ + UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 4,6-disulfate.

label: genkwanin 6-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: genkwanin + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + scutellarein 7-methyl ether.

label: syntaxin-3 binding
definition: Binding to a syntaxin-3 SNAP receptor.

label: squalene-hopene cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: squalene = hop-22(29)-ene.

label: neuropeptide activity
definition: The receptor ligand activity of any polypeptide expressed in, and secreted from a neuron.

label: 2-methoxy-6-polyprenolphenol 4-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-polyprenyl)phenol + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + O2 + 2 H+ = 2-methoxy-6-(all-trans-polyprenyl)benzene-1,4-diol + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O.

label: type 1 neuromedin U receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1 neuromedin U receptor.

label: ribitol 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribitol + NAD+ = D-ribulose + H+ + NADH.

label: alpha-1,3-glucan synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + [alpha-D-glucosyl-(1,3)]n = UDP + [alpha-D-glucosyl-(1,3)]n+1.

label: myosin VI head/neck binding
definition: Binding to the head/neck region of a myosin VI heavy chain.

label: ABC-type doxorubicin transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + doxorubicin(in) = ADP + phosphate + doxorubicin(out).

label: 15-cis-phytoene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 geranylgeranyl diphosphate = 15-cis-phytoene + 2 diphosphate.

label: butyrate-acetoacetate CoA-transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetoacetate + butanoyl-CoA = acetoacetyl-CoA + butanoate.

label: cyclic nucleotide-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cNMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

label: type 1E serotonin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a type 1E serotonin receptor.

label: voltage-gated calcium channel activity involved in regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium levels
definition: Regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentrations via the action of voltage-gated calcium ion channels.

label: thiosulfate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of thiosulfate ions, HS2O3(1-), from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: sn-glycerol-3-phosphate 1-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + UDP-D-galactose = 1-O-alpha-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + H+ + UDP.

label: O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an acetyl group to an oxygen atom on the acceptor molecule.

label: chenodeoxycholic acid binding
definition: Binding to chenodeoxycholic acid.

label: alpha-1,4-glucan glucosyltransferase (UDP-glucose donor) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n+1) + H+ + UDP.

label: acid sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + sphingomyelin = ceramide + choline phosphate + H+ in an acidic environment.

label: NuRD complex binding
definition: Binding to a NuRD complex.

label: histone H3S28 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H3-serine (position 28) + ATP = histone H3-phosphoserine (position 28) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 28 of histone H3.

label: ATPase binding
definition: Binding to an ATPase, any enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of ATP.

label: acyl-lipid omega-6 desaturase (cytochrome b5) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a (9Z)-octadecenoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H+ + O2 = a (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl-containing glycerolipid + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O.

label: fumarate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of fumarate from one side of a membrane to the other. Fumarate is a key intermediate in metabolism and is formed in the TCA cycle from succinate and converted into malate.

label: D-alanine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of D-alanine from one side of a membrane to the other. D-alanine is the D-enantiomer of 2-aminopropanoic acid.

label: hydroxybutyrate-dimer hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-3-[(R)-3-hydroxybutanoyloxy]butanoate + H2O = 2 (R)-3-hydroxybutanoate + H+.

label: hydroxyectoine binding
definition: Binding to hydroxyectoine.

label: protein serine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate.

label: broad specificity neutral L-amino acid:basic L-amino acid antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out) = basic L-amino acid(in) + neutral L-amino acid(out).

label: protein-lysine-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[protein] + acetyl-CoA = N6-acetyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + CoA + H+.

label: UUG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a UUG codon.

label: rhamnose transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of rhamnose from one side of a membrane to the other. Rhamnose occurs commonly as a compound of plant glycosides, in polysaccharides of gums and mucilages, and in bacterial polysaccharides. It is also a component of some plant cell wall polysaccharides and frequently acts as the sugar components of flavonoids.

label: alpha-1,2-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a mannose residue to an oligosaccharide, forming an alpha-(1->2) linkage.

label: RNA lariat debranching enzyme activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of an RNA lariat debranching enzyme.

label: squalene cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: squalene = triterpene.

label: histone H3K18cr reader activity
definition: A histone reader that recognizes a histone H3 crotonylated at lysine 18.

label: ubiquitin-like modifier activating enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the activation of small proteins, such as ubiquitin or ubiquitin-like proteins, through the formation of an ATP-dependent high-energy thiolester bond.

label: all-trans-retinol 13,14-reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinol + A = all-trans-retinol + AH(2). Note that this reaction has only been observed to occur in the opposite direction.

label: denatured protein binding
definition: Binding to a denatured protein.

label: alpha-cuprenene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = (-)-alpha-cuprenene + diphosphoric acid.

label: corticotrophin-releasing factor receptor activity
definition: Combining with the corticotrophin-releasing factor family of ligands, including the urocortins, to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: (+)-delta-cadinene-8-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + (+)-delta-cadinene + NADPH + O2 = 8-hydroxy-(+)-delta-cadinene + NADP + H2O.

label: L-glutamine:sodium symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: L-glutamine(out) + Na+(out) = L-glutamine(in) + Na+(in).

label: glycerol-3-phosphate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glycerol-3-phosphate from one side of a membrane to the other. Glycerol-3-phosphate is a phosphoric monoester of glycerol.

label: protein kinase B binding
definition: Binding to protein kinase B, an intracellular kinase that is important in regulating glucose metabolism.

label: homocysteine desulfhydrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homocysteine + H2O = sulfide + NH3 + 2-oxobutanoate.

label: ADP-ribosylglutamate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-glutamyl-[protein] + H2O = L-glutamyl-[protein] + ADP-ribose.

label: N-box binding
definition: Binding to an N-box, a DNA motif with the consensus sequence CACNAG that is found in the promoters of genes expressed preferentially at synapses.

label: gibberellin 3-beta-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a gibberellin + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = a 3-beta-hydroxy-gibberellin + succinate + CO2.

label: platelet-derived growth factor binding
definition: Binding to platelet-derived growth factor.

label: L-arabinitol 4-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arabinitol + NAD+ = L-xylulose + H+ + NADH.

label: 4-methylthiopropyl glucosinolate S-oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-methylthiopropyl-glucosinolate = 4-methylsulfinylpropyl-glucosinolate.

label: RNA endonuclease activity producing 5'-phosphomonoesters, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within ribonucleic acids by creating internal breaks to yield 5'-phosphomonoesters.

label: chromatin binding
definition: Binding to chromatin, the network of fibers of DNA, protein, and sometimes RNA, that make up the chromosomes of the eukaryotic nucleus during interphase.

label: iron-sulfur transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a iron-sulfur cluster from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

label: 5-hydroxyfuranocoumarin 5-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5-hydroxyfurocoumarin + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5-methoxyfurocoumarin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: pyruvate, phosphate dikinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + phosphate + pyruvate = AMP + diphosphate + 2 H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate.

label: nucleoside transmembrane transporter activity, against a concentration gradient
definition: Enables the transfer of a nucleoside, from one side of a membrane to the other, up a concentration gradient.

label: primary fluorescent dioxobilin-type chlorophyll catabolite methylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + primary fluorescent dioxobilin-type chlorophyll catabolite = H+ + methanol + O13(4)-desmethyl pFCC.

label: phosphomannomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate = D-mannose 6-phosphate.

label: GMP synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + XMP + L-glutamine + H2O = AMP + diphosphate + GMP + L-glutamate + 2H+.

label: chromium ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of chromium (Cr) ions from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: vinculin binding
definition: Binding to vinculin, a protein found in muscle, fibroblasts, and epithelial cells that binds actin and appears to mediate attachment of actin filaments to integral proteins of the plasma membrane.

label: 4-hydroxy-3-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoate oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxy-3-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoate + 2 H+ + O2 + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = 3,4-dihydroxy-5-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoate + H2O + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

label: kynurenine-oxoglutarate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-kynurenine = H2O + kynurenate + L-glutamate. The product 4-(2-aminophenyl)-2,4-dioxobutanoate is converted into kynurenate by a spontaneous reaction. Also acts on 3-hydroxykynurenine to form xanthurenate.

label: racemase and epimerase activity, acting on carbohydrates and derivatives
definition: Catalysis of a reaction that alters the configuration of one or more chiral centers in a carbohydrate molecule.

label: L-cysteine desulfhydrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + H2O = hydrogen sulfide + pyruvate + NH4+ + H+.

label: aliphatic desulfoglucosinolate sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate + an aliphatic (Z)-desulfo-glucosinolate = a (Z)-omega-(methylsulfanyl)-N-sulfo-alkylhydroximate S-glucoside + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + H+.

label: 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + O2 = 2 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + 2 CO2.

label: inositol monophosphate 1-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate + H2O = myo-inositol + phosphate.

label: RNA-directed RNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1); uses an RNA template, i.e. the catalysis of RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of an RNA strand by one nucleotide at a time.

label: tRNA (guanine(26)-N2)-dimethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:guanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2 H+ + N(2)-dimethylguanosine(26) in tRNA + 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: protein phosphatase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a protein phosphatase.

label: 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate + H+ = 4-guanidinobutanal + CO2.

label: aminoacyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an amino-acyl group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

label: lipase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of a lipase, an enzyme that catalyzes of the hydrolysis of a lipid.

label: histone H3K18 decrotonylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + N6-(2E)-butenoyl-L-lysyl-[histone H3 position 18] + NAD+ = 2''-O-(2E)-but-2-enoyl-ADP-D-ribose + L-lysyl-[histone H3] + nicotinamide.

label: extracellularly glutamate-gated ion channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an ion by a channel that opens when glutamate is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane.

label: single-stranded DNA exodeoxyribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a single-stranded DNA molecule.

label: beta-pinacene synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = beta-pinacene + diphosphate.

label: mating type region replication fork barrier binding
definition: Binding to the replication fork barrier found in the mating type region of fission yeast.

label: estradiol 17-beta-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: estradiol-17-beta + NAD(P)+ = estrone + NAD(P)H + H+. The activity can use NAD+ or NADP+ as the acceptor.

label: dihydrolipoyllysine-residue glutaryltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + glutaryl-CoA = CoA + N6-[(R)-S8-glutaryldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein].

label: protein histidine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein histidine phosphate + H2O = protein histidine + phosphate.

label: sialic acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of sialic acid from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: tyrosine-ester sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + L-tyrosine methyl ester = L-tyrosine methyl ester 4-sulfate + adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + H+.

label: AGA codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes an AGA codon.

label: very long-chain fatty acid omega-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an omega-methyl-very-long-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = an omega-hydroxy-very-long-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase]. A very long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing more than 22 carbons.

label: Skp1-protein-hydroxyproline N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine + Skp1-protein-hydroxyproline = UDP + Skp1-protein-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)hydroxyproline.

label: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate 2-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-fructose 2,6-bisphosphate + H2O = D-fructose-6-phosphate + phosphate.

label: aminomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-aminomethyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate = N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NH4+.

label: basic amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of basic amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Basic amino acids have side chains with a positive charge at pH 7.3.

label: L-aspartate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + O2 = iminosuccinate + H2O2. Can also use fumatate as electron acceptor under anaerobic conditions, yielding succinate.

label: calcium- and calmodulin-responsive adenylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP = 3',5'-cyclic AMP + diphosphate, stimulated by calcium-bound calmodulin.

label: eclosion hormone activity
definition: The action characteristic of eclosion hormone, a peptide hormone that, upon receptor binding, triggers the death of certain muscles and neurons during insect metamorphosis.

label: hydroxyproline O-arabinosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-4-hydroxy-L-prolyl-[protein] + UDP-beta-L-arabinofuranose = H+ + O-(beta-L-arabinofuranosyl)-trans-4-hydroxy-L-prolyl-[protein] + UDP.

label: thiosulfate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 thiosulfate + 2 ferricytochrome c = tetrathionate + 2 ferrocytochrome c.

label: trehalose synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an NDP-alpha-D-glucose + D-glucose = a ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate + alpha,alpha-trehalose + H+.

label: calcium oxalate binding
definition: Binding to calcium oxalate, CaC2O4, a salt of oxalic acid. In animals, it may be excreted in urine or retained in the form of urinary calculi.

label: 2-alkenal reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: n-alkanal + NAD(P)+ = alk-2-enal + NAD(P)H + H+.

label: DDEL sequence binding
definition: Binding to a KDEL sequence, the C terminus tetrapeptide sequence Asp-Asp-Glu-Leu found in proteins that are to be retained in the endoplasmic reticulum.

label: 13-lipoxin reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 15-oxo-(5S,6R)-dihydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z,13E)-eicosatetraenoate + NADH + H+ = 15-oxo-(5S,6R)-dihydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z)-eicosatrienoate + NAD+.

label: AMPylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein = diphosphate + adenylyl-protein; mediates the addition of an adenylyl (adenosine 5'-monophosphate; AMP group) to L-serine, L-threonine, and L-tyrosine residues in target proteins.

label: 3-hydroxyphenyl propanoate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of 3-hydroxyphenyl propanoate from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: Rab geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 geranylgeranyl diphosphate + protein-cysteine = 2 S-geranylgeranyl-protein + 2 diphosphate. This reaction is the formation of two thioether linkages between the C-1 atom of the geranylgeranyl groups and two cysteine residues within the terminal sequence motifs XXCC, XCXC or CCXX. Known substrates include Ras-related GTPases of a single family and the Rab family.

label: sphingolipid transporter activity
definition: Enables the directed movement of sphingolipids into, out of or within a cell, or between cells. Sphingolipids are a class of lipids containing the long-chain amine diol sphingosine or a closely related base (a sphingoid).

label: cobalt-precorrin-3 C17-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cobalt-precorrin 3 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = cobalt-precorrin 4 + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: C-C motif chemokine 21 receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C-C motif chemokine 21 (CCL21) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: ethanolamine-phosphate phospho-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + phosphoethanolamine = acetaldehyde + NH4 + phosphate.

label: IAA-Leu conjugate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-acetyl-leucine + H2O = indole-3-acetate + L-leucine.

label: O-acetylhomoserine aminocarboxypropyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-acetyl-L-homoserine + methanethiol = L-methionine + acetate. Also reacts with other thiols and H2S, producing homocysteine or thioethers.

label: serine-type peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine).

label: N-acetylglucosaminyldiphosphoundecaprenol glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyldiphosphoundecaprenol + UDP-D-glucose = beta-D-glucosyl-1,4-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyldiphosphoundecaprenol + UDP.

label: L-ribulose-phosphate 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

label: acyl-CoA oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-CoA + O2 = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2.

label: pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotide binding
definition: Binding to a pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotide, any compound consisting of a pyrimidine deoxyribonucleoside that is esterified with (ortho)phosphate or an oligophosphate at any hydroxyl group on the deoxyribose moiety.

label: aminoglycoside 6'-N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + kanamycin B = N(6')-acetylkanamycin B + CoA + H+. This is acetylation of the 6'-amino group of the 6-deoxy-6-aminoglucose ring.

label: magnesium ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of magnesium (Mg) ions from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: mycothiol-arsenate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arsenate + mycothiol = mycothiol-arsenate conjugate + H2O.

label: nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids.

label: ribonuclease U2 activity
definition: Catalysis of the two-stage endonucleolytic cleavage to nucleoside 3'-phosphates and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides ending in Ap or Gp with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

label: ganglioside GT1b binding
definition: Binding to ganglioside GT1b.

label: RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain O-GlcNAc transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat (YSPTSPS) = UDP + RNA polymerase II large subunit CTD heptapeptide repeat 3-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-serine.

label: structural constituent of synapse
definition: The action of a molecule that contributes to the structural integrity of a synapse.

label: intramolecular transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a functional group from one position to another within a single molecule.

label: mRNA regulatory element binding translation repressor activity
definition: Antagonizes the ribosome-mediated translation of mRNA into a polypeptide via direct binding (through a selective and non-covalent interaction) to nucleic acid.

label: thiosulfate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-decylubiquinone + 2 thiosulfate = 6-decylubiquinol + tetrathionate.

label: narrow pore channel activity
definition: Enables the transport of a solute across a membrane via a narrow pore channel that may be gated or ungated.

label: short-chain fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a short-chain fatty acyl-CoA + H2O = a short fatty acid + CoA + H+. A short-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail of less than 6 carbons.

label: ATP:coenzyme F420 adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + factor gamma-F420-2 + H+ = coenzyme F390-A + diphosphate.

label: acetylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acetic ester + H2O = an alcohol + acetate.

label: neuromedin K receptor activity
definition: Combining with neuromedin K, the peptide Asp-Met-His-Asp-Phe-Phe-Val-Gly-Leu-Met to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: microtubule minus-end binding
definition: Binding to the minus end of a microtubule.

label: ornithine decarboxylase regulator activity
definition: Binds to and modulates the activity of the enzyme ornithine decarboxylase.

label: histone H2BS14 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: histone H2B-serine (position 14) + ATP = histone H2B-phosphoserine (position 14) + ADP. This reaction is the addition of a phosphate group to the serine residue at position 14 of histone H2B.

label: leghemoglobin reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe(III)-[leghemoglobin] + NAD(P)H = 2 Fe(II)-[leghemoglobin] + NAD(P)+ + H+.

label: actin monomer sequestering activity
definition: Binding to an actin monomer to prevent it from interacting with other partners or to inhibit its localization to the area of the cell or complex where it is active.

label: UDP-glucose 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

label: peptidoglycan muralytic activity
definition: A catalytic activity that contributes to the degradation of peptidoglycan.

label: glycerate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glycerate from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: tricarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of tricarboxylic acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Tricarboxylic acid are organic acids with three COOH groups.

label: aromatic-L-amino-acid decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-amino acid + H+ = R-H + CO2.

label: RNA polymerase II C-terminal domain phosphoserine binding
definition: Binding to phosphorylated serine residues in the C-terminal domain of RNA polymerase II.

label: 3-keto-5-aminohexanoate cleavage activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-keto-5-aminohexanoate + acetyl-CoA = L-3-aminobutyryl-CoA + acetoacetate.

label: ABC-type quaternary ammonium compound transporting activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + quaternary ammonium(out) = ADP + H+ + phosphate + quaternary ammonium(in).

label: prenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a prenyl group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

label: chemokine receptor activity
definition: Combining with a chemokine, and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity. Chemokines are a family of small chemotactic cytokines; their name is derived from their ability to induce directed chemotaxis in nearby responsive cells. All chemokines possess a number of conserved cysteine residues involved in intramolecular disulfide bond formation. Some chemokines are considered pro-inflammatory and can be induced during an immune response to recruit cells of the immune system to a site of infection, while others are considered homeostatic and are involved in controlling the migration of cells during normal processes of tissue maintenance or development. Chemokines are found in all vertebrates, some viruses and some bacteria.

label: ATPase-coupled nonpolar-amino acid transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: ATP + H2O + nonpolar amino acid(out) = ADP + phosphate + nonpolar amino acid(in).

label: voltage-gated sodium channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: lipoarabinomannan binding
definition: Binding to lipoarabinomannan.

label: mimosinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-mimosine + H2O = 3-hydroxy-4H-pyrid-4-one + L-serine.

label: tRNA-4-demethylwyosine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyruvate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine + N1-methylguanine37 in tRNAPhe = L-methionine + 5'-deoxyadenosine + carbon dioxide + H2O + 4-demethylwyosine37 in tRNAPhe.

label: mRNA phosphatase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of mRNA phosphatase.

label: AP-2 adaptor complex binding
definition: Binding to an AP-2 adaptor complex. The AP-2 adaptor complex is a heterotetrameric AP-type membrane coat adaptor complex that consists of alpha, beta2, mu2 and sigma2 subunits and links clathrin to the membrane surface of a vesicle. In at least humans, the AP-2 complex can be heterogeneric due to the existence of multiple subunit isoforms encoded by different alpha genes (alphaA and alphaC).

label: 23S rRNA (adenosine(1067)-2'-O)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine(1067) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyladenosine(1067) in 23S rRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: laricitrin 5'-O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + laricitrin = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + syringetin.

label: pyridoxamine-phosphate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate + 2-oxoglutarate = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + D-glutamate.

label: RNA 2',3'-cyclic 3'-phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis the reaction: a 3'-end 2',3'-cyclophospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + H2O = a 3'-end 2'-phospho-ribonucleotide-RNA + H+.

label: protein heterodimerization activity
definition: Binding to a nonidentical protein to form a heterodimer.

label: AAG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes an AAG codon.

label: ribosomal S6-glutamic acid ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the posttranslational transfer of one or more glutamic acid residues to the C-terminus of ribosomal protein S6.

label: chloride:bicarbonate antiporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: chloride(in) + HCO3-(out) = chloride(out) + HCO3-(in).

label: endochitinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of nonterminal (1->4)-beta linkages of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (GlcNAc) polymers of chitin and chitodextrins. Typically, endochitinases cleave randomly within the chitin chain.

label: ribonuclease M5 activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 21 and 42 nucleotides, respectively, from the 5'- and 3'-termini of a 5S-rRNA precursor.

label: precorrin-6Y C5,15-methyltransferase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine + precorrin-6Y = 2 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + precorrin-8X + CO2.

label: kojibiose phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: kojibiose + phosphate = beta-D-glucose 1-phosphate + D-glucose.

label: quercetin 4'-O-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a glucosyl group from UDP-glucose to the 4'-hydroxy group of a quercetin molecule.

label: long-chain fatty acid binding
definition: Binding to a long-chain fatty acid. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

label: ATP-dependent protein disaggregase activity
definition: An ATP-dependent molecular chaperone activity that mediates the solubilization of ordered protein aggregates.

label: beta,beta-carotene-9',10'-cleaving oxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-carotene + O2 = 10'-apo-beta-carotenal + beta-ionone.

label: C-C motif chemokine 19 receptor activity
definition: Combining with the C-C motif chemokine 19 (CCL19) and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: germacrene-A synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate = (+)-(R)-germacrene A + diphosphate.

label: ethanolamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + ethanolamine = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphoethanolamine.

label: xylanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of xylans, homopolysaccharides composed of xylose residues.

label: ammonium ion binding
definition: Binding to ammonium ions (NH4+).

label: transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an amino group to an acceptor, usually a 2-oxo acid.

label: peptide YY receptor activity
definition: Combining with gut peptide YY to initiate a change in cell activity.

label: protein-arginine rhamnosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dTDP-beta-L-rhamnose + L-arginyl-[protein] = dTDP + H+ + N(omega)-(L-rhamnosyl)-L-arginyl-[protein].

label: ecdysteroid 2-hydroxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydroxylation of an ecdysteroid at carbon position 2.

label: gamma-tubulin complex binding
definition: Binding to a gamma-tubulin complex.

label: G protein-coupled GABA receptor activity
definition: Combining with the amino acid gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4-aminobutyrate) and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein; promotes the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit of a heterotrimeric G-protein complex.

label: tRNA (uracil(54)-C5)-methyltransferase activity, S-adenosyl methionine-dependent
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + uridine54 in tRNA = 5-methyluridine54 in tRNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: inositol pentakisphosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: inositol pentakisphosphate + ATP = inositol hexakisphosphate + ADP + H+.

label: phospholipase A2 inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of phospholipase A2.

label: phosphate:acyl-[acyl carrier protein] acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fatty acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + orthophosphate = acyl phosphate + [acyl-carrier protein].

label: thyrotropin-releasing hormone receptor binding
definition: Binding to a receptor for thyrotropin-releasing hormone, a tripeptide hormone that is produced by the hypothalamus and stimulates the release of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) and prolactin by the anterior pituitary.

label: RNA polymerase II intronic transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding
definition: Binding to an RNA polymerase II intronic DNA sequence that regulates the transcription of the transcript it is contained within.

label: propanoyl-CoA C-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: choloyl-CoA + propanoyl-CoA = 3alpha,7alpha,12alpha-trihydroxy-24-oxo-5beta-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA + CoA.

label: GDP-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-D-glucose + H2O = D-glucose + GDP + H+.

label: rRNA (adenine(2503)-C2-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine2503 in 23S rRNA + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2-methyladenosine2503 in 23S rRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

label: racemase and epimerase activity, acting on amino acids and derivatives
definition: Catalysis of a reaction that alters the configuration of one or more chiral centers in an amino acid.

label: FMN-binding domain binding
definition: Binding to the FMN-binding domain of a protein.

label: glutarate dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction glutarate + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate + succinate + CO2.

label: heparanase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-glycosidic bonds of heparan sulfate chains in heparan sulfate proteoglycan.

label: inositol-3-diphosphate-1,2,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol 1,2,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,3,4,5,6-hexakisphosphate + phosphate + 2 H+.

label: nuclear glucocorticoid receptor binding
definition: Binding to a nuclear glucocorticoid receptor.

label: N-acetyl-gamma-aminoadipyl-phosphate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-acetyl-L-aminoadipate-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = N(2)-acetyl-L-gamma-aminoadipyl phosphate + NADPH.

label: fucose binding
definition: Binding to fucose, the pentose 6-deoxygalactose.

label: CD154 receptor binding
definition: Binding to CD154, a receptor found on the surface of some activated lymphocytes.

label: 2,4-dihydroxy-7-methoxy-2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one 2-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dihydroxy-7-methoxy-2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one + UDP-D-glucose = 2,4-dihydroxy-7-methoxy-2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one 2-D-glucoside + UDP.

label: phosphoethanolamine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphoethanolamine + H2O = ethanolamine + phosphate.

label: metalloendopeptidase inhibitor activity
definition: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of metalloendopeptidases, enzymes that catalyze the hydrolysis of nonterminal peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain and contain a chelated metal ion at their active sites which is essential to their catalytic activity.

label: histone crotonyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: crotonyl-CoA + histone = CoA + crotonyl-histone.

label: cholest-5-ene-3-beta,7-alpha-diol 3-beta-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + 7-alpha-hydroxycholesterol = NADH + H+ + 7-alpha-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one.

label: glucose dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + acceptor = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + reduced acceptor.

label: methyltransferase cap1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(2'-O-methyl-ribonucleoside) in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+. This activity catalyzes the methylation of the ribose on the first transcribed nucleotide of mRNAs and snRNAs.

label: myosin VI light chain binding
definition: Binding to a light chain of a myosin VI complex.

label: carboxyvinyl-carboxyphosphonate phosphorylmutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-carboxyvinyl carboxyphosphonate = 3-(hydrohydroxyphosphoryl)pyruvate + CO2.

label: trans-activation response element binding
definition: Binding to a trans-activation response (TAR) element, a hairpin RNA structure located at the 5' end of all HIV-1 transcripts, and which is required for trans-activation of a viral promoter.

label: eukaryotic elongation factor-2 kinase activator activity
definition: Binds to and increases the activity of the enzyme eukaryotic elongation factor-2 kinase.

label: gamma-aminobutyric acid:sodium:chloride symporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: gamma-aminobutyric acid(out) + Na+(out) + Cl-(out) = gamma-aminobutyric acid(in) + Na+(in) + Cl(in).

label: leukotriene B4 receptor activity
definition: Combining with leukotriene B4, LTB4, to initiate a change in cell activity. Leukotriene B4 is also known as (6Z, 8E, 10E, 14Z)-(5S, 12R)-5,12-dihydroxyicosa-6,8,10,14-tetraen-1-oate.

label: pivalyl-CoA mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methylbutanoyl-CoA = 2,2-dimethylpropanoyl-CoA.

label: extracellularly glycine-gated chloride channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a chloride ion by a channel that opens when glycine is bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts on the extracellular side of the plasma membrane.

label: lycopene beta cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cyclization of beta rings at one or both ends of the lycopene molecule (psi, psi-carotene) to form gamma-carotene or the bicyclic beta-carotene (beta, beta-carotene), respectively.

label: neuroligin family protein binding
definition: Binding to a member of the neuroligin protein family, neuronal cell surface proteins that mediate synapse formation.

label: alpha-amyrin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene = alpha-amyrin.

label: mast cell secretagogue receptor activity
definition: Combining with basic secretagogues to initiate pseudo-allergic reactions in mast cells.

label: dihydroxy-acid dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate = 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + H2O.

label: sphingolipid transfer activity
definition: Removes a sphingolipid from a membrane or a monolayer lipid particle, transports it through the aqueous phase while protected in a hydrophobic pocket, and brings it to an acceptor membrane or lipid particle.

label: deoxyuridine phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyuridine + phosphate = 2-deoxy-alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate + uracil.

label: beta-amyrin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene = beta-amyrin.

label: thioether S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) + dimethyl sulfide = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + trimethylsulfonium.

label: cADPR-sensitive calcium-release channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a calcium ion by a channel that opens when cyclic adenosine diphosphate ribose (cADPR) has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: maltose alpha-D-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: maltose = trehalose.

label: deacetoxycephalosporin-C synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + O2 + penicillin N = CO2 + deacetoxycephalosporin C + H2O + succinate.

label: UCC codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a UCC codon.

label: anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate + diphosphate = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + anthranilate.

label: aminocarboxymuconate-semialdehyde decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-amino-3-carboxymuconate 6-semialdehyde + H+ = 2-aminomuconate 6-semialdehyde + CO2.

label: leukotriene-A4 hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + leukotriene A(4) = leukotriene B(4).

label: molecular tag activity
definition: A molecular function exhibited by a protein that is covalently attached (AKA tagged or conjugated) to another molecule (for example a protein or a lipid) where it acts as a marker, recognized by the cellular apparatus to target the tagged protein for some cellular process such as modification, sequestration, transport or degradation.

label: 8-demethylnovobiocate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-amino-4,7-dihydroxycoumarin + 3-dimethylallyl-4-hydroxybenzoate + ATP(4-) = H+ + 8-desmethylnovobiocic acid(1-) + AMP(2-) + diphosphoric acid.

label: calcium-activated cation channel activity
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of an inorganic cation by a channel that opens when a calcium cation has been bound by the channel complex or one of its constituent parts.

label: ammonia ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the ligation of ammonia (NH3) to another substance via a carbon-nitrogen bond with concomitant breakage of a diphosphate linkage, usually in a nucleoside triphosphate.

label: peptidoglycan beta-N-acetylmuramidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing N-acetylmuramic residues.

label: arachidonate binding
definition: Binding to arachidonic acid, a straight chain fatty acid with 20 carbon atoms and four double bonds per molecule. Arachidonic acid is the all-Z-(5,8,11,14)-isomer.

label: 6-carboxymethyl-5-methyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol 3-C-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-carboxymethyl-5-methyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 6-carboxymethyl-3,5-dimethyl-4-hydroxypyridin-2-ol + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+.

label: peptidyl-lysine 4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein L-lysine + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = protein 4-hydroxy-L-lysine + succinate + CO2.

label: sucrose-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + D-fructose 6-phosphate = UDP + sucrose 6-phosphate.

label: saccharopine dehydrogenase (NAD+, L-lysine-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-saccharopine + H2O + NAD+ = 2-oxoglutarate + L-lysine + H+ + NADH.

label: 3-beta-hydroxy-5-beta-steroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-beta-hydroxy-5-beta-pregnane-20-one + NADP+ = 5-beta-pregnan-3,20-dione + H+ + NADPH.

label: coenzyme F420 hydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coenzyme F420 + H(2) + H+ = reduced coenzyme F420.

label: poly-purine tract binding
definition: Binding to a stretch of purines (adenine or guanine) in an RNA molecule.

label: linear primary-alkylsulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a primary linear alkyl sulfate ester + H2O = a primary alcohol + H+ + sulfate.

label: FACT complex binding
definition: Binding to a FACT complex.

label: voltage-gated sodium channel activity involved in cardiac muscle cell action potential
definition: Enables the transmembrane transfer of a sodium ion by a voltage-gated channel through the plasma membrane of a cardiac muscle cell contributing to the depolarization phase of an action potential. A voltage-gated channel is a channel whose open state is dependent on the voltage across the membrane in which it is embedded.

label: 4alpha-hydroxymethyl-stigmasta-7,24(241)-dien-3beta-ol-methyl oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4alpha-hydroxymethyl-stigmasta-7,24(241)-dien-3beta-ol + NADH + O2 + H+ = 4alpha-formyl-stigmasta-7,24(241)-dien-3beta-ol + NAD + 2 H2O.

label: aminoacyl-tRNA deacylase activity
definition: The hydrolysis of an incorrectly aminoacylated tRNA.

label: symporter activity
definition: Enables the active transport of a solute across a membrane by a mechanism whereby two or more species are transported together in the same direction in a tightly coupled process not directly linked to a form of energy other than chemiosmotic energy.

label: DNA-1,N6-ethenoadenine N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA with 1-N6-ethenoadenine + H2O = DNA with abasic site + 1-N6-ethenoadenine. This reaction is the removal of 1,N6-ethenoadenine by cleaving the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the target damaged DNA base and the deoxyribose sugar.

label: linolenate 9R-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoate + O2 = (9R,10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoate. Also converts linoleate to (9R,10E,12Z)-9- hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12-dienoate.

label: solanapyrone synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the cyclization of double bonds in prosolanapyrone II to form (-)-solanapyrone A.

label: verbascose galactinol:ajugose galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: verbascose + alpha-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-1D-myo-inositol = ajugose + myo-inositol.

label: single cytosine insertion binding
definition: Binding to a double-stranded DNA region containing a single cytosine insertion or a deletion that results in an unpaired cytosine.

label: ABC-type transporter activity
definition: Primary active transporter characterized by two nucleotide-binding domains and two transmembrane domains. Uses the energy generated from ATP hydrolysis to drive the transport of a substance across a membrane.

label: beta-2-microglobulin binding
definition: Binding to beta-2-microglobulin.

label: glycerol transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of glycerol from one side of a membrane to the other. Glycerol is 1,2,3-propanetriol, a sweet, hygroscopic, viscous liquid, widely distributed in nature as a constituent of many lipids.

label: indolylacetylinositol arabinosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1L-1-O-(indol-3-yl)acetyl-myo-inositol + UDP-L-arabinose = (indol-3-yl)acetyl-myo-inositol 3-L-arabinoside + H+ + UDP.

label: secretin receptor binding
definition: Binding to a secretin receptor.

label: acyloxyacyl hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(acyloxy)acyl group of bacterial toxin = 3-hydroxyacyl group of bacterial toxin + a fatty acid.

label: TIR domain binding
definition: Binding to a Toll-Interleukin receptor (TIR) domain of a protein. The TIR domain is an intracellular 200 residue domain that is found in the Toll protein, the interleukin-1 receptor (IL-1R), and MyD88; it contains three highly-conserved regions, and mediates protein-protein interactions between the Toll-like receptors (TLRs) and signal-transduction components.

label: citramalate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-citramalate = acetate + pyruvate.

label: low-affinity ferric iron ion transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of a solute or solutes from one side of a membrane to the other according to the reaction: Fe2+(out) = Fe2+(in). In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

label: RNA endonuclease activity producing 3'-phosphomonoesters, hydrolytic mechanism
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within ribonucleic acids by creating internal breaks to yield 3'-phosphomonoesters.

label: methyl farnesoate epoxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methyl (2E,6E)-farnesoate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = H+ + H2O + juvenile hormone III + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

label: 2,5-dichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1,4-diol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-dichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1,4-diol + NAD+ = NADH + H+ + 2,5-dichlorohydroquinone.

label: growth factor binding
definition: Binding to a growth factor, proteins or polypeptides that stimulate a cell or organism to grow or proliferate.

label: formimidoylglutamase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate + H2O = L-glutamate + formamide.

label: O-fucosylpeptide 3-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a beta-D-GlcNAc residue from UDP-D-GlcNAc to the fucose residue of a fucosylated protein acceptor.

label: trichloro-p-hydroquinone reductive dehalogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3,6-trichlorohydroquinone + 2 glutathione = 2,6-dichlorohydroquinone + glutathione disulfide + HCl.

label: thiamine pyrophosphate transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of thiamine pyrophosphate a substance from one side of a membrane to the other.

label: ErbB-3 class receptor binding
definition: Binding to the protein-tyrosine kinase receptor ErbB-3/HER3.

label: prenylcysteine methylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein C-terminal S-farnesyl-L-cysteine methyl ester + H2O = protein C-terminal S-farnesyl-L-cysteine + methanol + H+.

label: toluene-sulfonate methyl-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene-4-sulfonate + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + OH- + 4-sulfobenzyl alcohol.

label: fibrinogen binding
definition: Binding to fibrinogen, a highly soluble hexameric glycoprotein complex that is found in blood plasma and is converted to fibrin by thrombin in the coagulation cascade.

label: isopropanol dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + propan-2-ol = acetone + H+ + NADPH.

label: type II site-specific deoxyribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to give specific double-stranded fragments with terminal 5'-phosphates and 3' hydroxyls. Cleavage is dependent on the presence in the DNA of a specific recognition site; cleavage occurs at or very near this recognition site.

label: mycothiol synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol-2-(L-cysteinylamido)-2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucopyranoside + acetyl-CoA = mycothiol + coA + H+. Mycothiol is also known as AcCys-GlcN-Ins and 1-D-myo-inosityl-2-L-cysteinylamido-2-deoxy-alpha-D-glucopyranoside as Cys-GlcN-Ins or desacetylmycothiol.

label: oxidoreductase activity, acting on CH or CH2 groups, with an iron-sulfur protein as acceptor
definition: Catalysis of an oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction in which a CH2 group acts as a hydrogen or electron donor and reduces an iron-sulfur protein.

label: thiamine oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: thiamine + 2 O2 = thiamine acetic acid + 2 H2O2.

label: protein-phosphocysteine-N,N'-diacetylchitobiose phosphotransferase system transporter activity
definition: Catalysis of the PEP-dependent, phosphoryl transfer-driven transport of substances across a membrane. The transport happens by catalysis of the reaction: protein S-phosphocysteine + N,N'-diacetylchitobiose(out) = protein cysteine + N,N'-diacetylchitobiose phosphate(in).

label: N-acyl-D-glutamate deacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acyl-D-glutamate + H2O = D-glutamate + a carboxylate.

label: heteroglycan alpha-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: heteroglycan + GDP-mannose = alpha-D-mannosylheteroglycan + GDP. 1,2- and 1,3-mannosyl bonds are formed.

label: mycothione reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD(P)+ + mycothiol = NAD(P)H + H+ + mycothione.

label: peptidoglycan endopeptidase activity
definition: An endopeptidase activity that uses peptidoglycan as a substrate.

label: histone H4K12 acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + histone H4 L-lysine (position 12) = CoA + histone H4 N6-acetyl-L-lysine (position 12).

label: viomycin kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + viomycin = ADP + O-phosphoviomycin.

label: low-affinity L-arginine transmembrane transporter activity
definition: Enables the transfer of L-arginine from one side of a membrane to the other. In low-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute only if it is present at very high concentrations.

label: CENP-A containing nucleosome binding
definition: Binding to a centromere-specific nucleosome, a form of nucleosome located only at the centromere, in which the histone H3 is replaced by the variant form CENP-A (sometimes known as CenH3).

label: GGG codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: A triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity that recognizes a GGG codon.

label: beta-galactosidase activity (lactose isomerization)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-lactose = beta-(1->6)-galactobiose.

label: triplet codon-amino acid adaptor activity
definition: The codon binding activity of a tRNA that positions an activated amino acid, mediating its insertion at the correct point in the sequence of a nascent polypeptide chain during protein synthesis.

label: C-acyltransferase activity
